entry.title: 译 - LESS is More for I/O-Efficient Repairs in Erasure-Coded Storage
entry.content:
原论文 LESS is More for I/O-Efficient Repairs in Erasure-Coded Storage 发表于 FAST 2026 (第 24 届 USENIX 文件与存储技术会议), 中文题名为 "以 LESS 提升纠删码存储修复的 I/O 效率".

纠删码修复不只受读取总量影响, 非连续 I/O 次数也会拖慢恢复. LESS 将这两个目标放在一起考虑, 同时兼顾不同数据块的修复收益:

编码构造

  • 叠加多个由 Reed-Solomon 编码形成的扩展子条带, 用可配置参数在修复读取量与非连续 I/O 次数之间取舍.

性质与实现

  • 论文给出 MDS 性质等证明, 并讨论单块修复时如何保持各块收益均衡.

实验结果

  • HDFS 上的评估表明, 相较文中对比的 I/O 最优纠删码, LESS 缩短了单块修复和整节点恢复时间.

LESS 讨论纠删码存储中的修复 I/O 效率. 故障后读取或恢复数据时, 系统不仅要控制从健康节点读取的数据总量, 还要减少非连续 I/O 次数; 只优化其中一项, 可能无法缩短实际修复时间. 这篇 FAST 2026 论文提出一族便于修复的编码构造, 将多个由 Reed-Solomon 编码形成的扩展子条带叠加, 并提供参数在读取量与 I/O 次数之间取舍. 设计还考虑不同数据块是否能获得相近的修复收益, 避免某些块代价明显更高. 论文给出编码公式和 MDS 性质证明, 讨论系统码形式, 子分块数量及单块修复过程, 并通过数值分析说明不同参数的影响. HDFS 集群中的实验将 LESS 与文中对比的 I/O 最优纠删码比较, 报告单块修复和整节点恢复时间均缩短. 文章的特点是把修复数据量, 访问连续性与各块收益放在同一设计中分析, 而非只给出一个修复带宽指标; 具体收益仍取决于编码参数和测试环境. 可配置的子分块数量也为不同修复粒度提供了选择.

repair I/O 指修复读取量, I/O seeks 指非连续读取次数, 不仅指机械磁盘寻道. 原文第 3.3 节将 α 范围写为 2 ≤ α ≤ n, 与设计概述的 2 ≤ α ≤ n - k 不同; 第 3.4 节单块修复写 1 ≤ z ≤ α, 而分组共有 α + 1 组. 此外, 该节优先读取量 |Gz|(α - 1) 与第 3.5 节用于推导 I/O 次数的 α(|Gz| - 1) 写法不同. 译文保留这些表述, 不擅自改动原论文. .

0. 摘要

I/O efficiency is critical for erasure-coded repair performance in modern distributed storage. We propose LESS, a family of repair-friendly erasure code constructions that reduces both the amount of data accessed and the number of I/O seeks in single-block repairs, while ensuring balanced reductions across blocks. LESS layers multiple extended sub-stripes formed by widely deployed Reed-Solomon coding, and is configurable to balance the trade-off between the amount of data accessed and I/O seeks. Evaluation shows that LESS on HDFS reduces both single-block repair and full-node recovery times compared to state-of-the-art I/O-optimal erasure codes.

现代分布式存储中, I/O 效率是纠删码修复性能的关键. 本文提出 LESS, 一族便于修复的纠删码构造, 在单块修复时同时减少读取的数据量和非连续 I/O 次数, 并使不同数据块获得较均衡的收益. LESS 将多个由广泛使用的 Reed-Solomon 编码构成的扩展子条带叠加, 通过可配置参数权衡数据读取量与 I/O 次数. 在 HDFS 上的评估表明, 相较先进的 I/O 最优纠删码, LESS 缩短了单块修复和整节点恢复时间.

1. 引言

Erasure coding is widely adopted in modern distributed storage systems (e.g., [3, 5, 10, 21]) to ensure fault tolerance with significantly lower storage overhead than traditional replication [37]. However, erasure coding incurs high repair costs. Reconstructing a single failed block needs to access and transfer much more data than the block size, leading to amplified bandwidth and I/O costs. Recent surveys [1, 33] highlight extensive studies, from both coding theory and systems communities, that aim to improve repair efficiency in erasure-coded storage. These studies focus on improving access performance (e.g., optimizing degraded reads [6, 13]) and storage reliability (e.g., reducing mean-time-to-data-loss [9, 10]). In particular, extensive research has proposed repair-friendly erasure code constructions to mitigate bandwidth and I/O costs (see §2.2 for related work).

现代分布式存储广泛采用纠删码 [3, 5, 10, 21], 以明显低于传统多副本的空间开销提供容错 [37]. 但修复代价很高: 重建单个失效块也要读取和传输远多于该块大小的数据, 放大带宽与 I/O 开销. 近期综述 [1, 33] 总结了编码理论与系统领域的大量研究, 涉及优化降级读 [6, 13] 等访问性能, 以及降低数据丢失风险等可靠性指标 [9, 10]. 其中一条主要路线是设计便于修复的编码, 减少带宽和 I/O 成本, 相关工作见原文第 2.2 节.

In modern distributed storage systems, I/O efficiency has become an increasingly critical design factor compared to bandwidth efficiency due to rapid advancements in network technologies (e.g., InfiniBand, RDMA, and CXL) that support high-speed interconnects. However, I/O performance cannot match such network improvements, especially under random-access workloads. This motivates us to construct repair-friendly erasure codes that make I/O efficiency a "first-class citizen" for high repair performance.

InfiniBand, RDMA, CXL 等高速互连发展迅速, 相比之下存储 I/O 性能提升较慢, 随机访问尤其如此. 因而相较网络带宽效率, I/O 效率已成为越来越重要的设计因素. 本文以 I/O 效率为核心, 构造修复性能更好的纠删码.

Existing repair-friendly erasure codes often have suboptimal I/O performance in repairs (§2.2). For example, Clay codes [36] are state-of-the-art minimum-storage regenerating (MSR) codes that provably minimize the amount of data accessed from local storage in single-block repairs, while minimizing storage redundancy for fault tolerance. Their core idea is sub-packetization, which divides an erasure-coded stripe (i.e., a set of blocks encoded together) into smaller sub-stripes composed of sub-blocks at the same block offset. During a single-block repair, Clay codes retrieve a minimum number of sub-blocks across sub-stripes for reconstruction. Despite minimizing data access, Clay codes require exponential sub-packetization for optimality, and issue numerous non-contiguous I/O seeks to retrieve sub-blocks in a repair. This significantly degrades repair performance in I/O-constrained environments due to amplified I/O requests. Locally repairable codes (e.g., Azure's LRC [10]) achieve I/O-efficient repairs, but incur higher storage redundancy. Other erasure codes support small sub-packetization with minimum storage redundancy [15, 16, 29, 35], yet they have various limitations in code constructions that lead to repair inefficiency.

现有便于修复的编码仍常有 I/O 不足, 见原文第 2.2 节. 例如 Clay [36] 是先进的最小存储再生码 (MSR), 在最小容错冗余下, 可证明地最小化单块修复读取量. 其基础是子分块, 将共同编码的一组块, 即条带, 划分为若干子条带, 每个子条带由各块相同偏移的子块组成. 修复时跨子条带取最少子块. 但最优性要求指数级子分块数, 导致大量不连续读取, 放大 I/O 请求, 在 I/O 受限环境中损害性能. Azure LRC [10] 等局部可修复码能改善 I/O, 却增加存储冗余. 其他小子分块 MDS 码 [15, 16, 29, 35] 也因构造限制而存在修复效率问题.

We present LESS, a family of erasure code constructions designed for I/O-efficient repairs, aiming to (i) reduce both the amount of data accessed and the number of I/O seeks with small sub-packetization (as low as two sub-stripes per stripe) and (ii) maintain balanced reductions across all blocks within a stripe (i.e., all blocks have similar data access and I/O seek costs). LESS builds on the notion of layering extended sub-stripes, by strategically stacking multiple extended sub-stripes (each with a longer stripe length) atop a regular stripe, such that a single-block repair (and some cases of multi-block repairs) can be done within an extended sub-stripe. LESS is designed with practicality in mind. It builds on the widely used Reed-Solomon (RS) codes [30] (§2.1) for a readily understandable design, and preserves the practical properties of RS codes. It further allows configurable sub-packetization to balance the trade-off between data access and I/O seeks.

LESS 有两个目标: 一是用较小的子分块数, 最低每条带仅两个子条带, 同时减少读取量和 I/O 次数; 二是使同一条带内所有块的修复代价接近. 核心是叠加扩展子条带: 在普通条带上安排多个更长的扩展子条带, 使单块以及部分多块修复仅在一个扩展子条带内完成. LESS 基于广泛采用的 RS 码 [30], 设计易于理解, 保留其实际应用属性, 并允许配置子分块数, 权衡读取量与 I/O 次数.

We implement and evaluate LESS on HDFS [34] in a local cluster. LESS reduces the single-block repair and full-node recovery times of Clay codes by up to 83.3% and 36.6%, respectively. We release the source code of LESS at: LESS.

我们在本地 HDFS [34] 集群实现 LESS. 相较 Clay, 单块修复和整节点恢复时间最多分别降低 83.3% 与 36.6%. 源代码已公开: LESS.

2. 背景

2.1 纠删码基础

We consider distributed storage systems that organize data in large fixed-size blocks (e.g., 128 MiB in HDFS [34] and 256 MiB in Facebook's f4 [21]) to mitigate I/O overhead. Such systems are typically I/O-bound, where network bandwidth and disk I/Os (on the order of MiB/s) are primary performance bottlenecks, rather than the computation overhead of encoding and decoding, as observed in prior work [6, 9, 18, 19]. Erasure coding ensures fault tolerance against block failures, which is essential for maintaining high data persistence in applications such as archival storage. We focus on RS codes [30], which are widely deployed in production [3, 5, 21, 23]. RS codes are configured by two parameters n and k (where n > k). An (n, k) RS code encodes k uncoded data blocks into n - k coded parity blocks, forming a stripe of n blocks, and ensures that any k out of n blocks can reconstruct all k data blocks (i.e., any n - k failed blocks are tolerable). In distributed storage systems, multiple stripes are independently encoded, with each stripe distributed across n nodes for tolerating any n - k node failures.

本文考虑按固定大小的大块组织数据的分布式系统, 如 HDFS 的 128 MiB [34] 和 Facebook f4 的 256 MiB [21], 以减少 I/O 开销. 这些系统通常受 I/O 限制, 主要瓶颈是网络与磁盘吞吐, 而非编码解码计算, 已有工作也观察到这一点 [6, 9, 18, 19]. 纠删码抵御块失效, 对归档等应用的数据持久性很重要. 本文聚焦生产中广泛部署的 RS 码 [3, 5, 21, 23, 30]. 参数 n > k, 将 k 个原始数据块编码为 n - k 个校验块, 共 n 块形成一个条带. 任取 k 块均可重建数据, 即容忍任意 n - k 块失效. 多个条带独立编码, 每条带分布到 n 个节点, 因而可容忍任意 n - k 节点失效.

RS codes satisfy three practical properties: (i) maximum distance separable (MDS), i.e., the redundancy (n/k times the data size) is minimized for tolerating any n - k failed blocks; (ii) general, i.e., any n and k (where n > k) can construct RS codes for a sufficiently large field size; and (iii) systematic, i.e., each stripe keeps k data blocks for direct access.

RS 码有三个实用属性: 1) 最大距离可分 (MDS), 容忍 n - k 块失效时, 总存储量为数据量的 n/k 倍, 达到最小冗余; 2) 参数通用, 对任意 n > k, 在足够大的有限域上均可构造; 3) 系统码, 保留 k 个原始数据块供直接访问.

RS encoding and decoding use linear combinations over a Galois Field GF(2w) with w-bit words, where n ≤ 2w + 1 [25]. Each block can be expressed as a linear combination of any k blocks under Galois Field arithmetic (see §3.1 for details).

RS 编解码在 w 位字的有限域 GF(2w) 上执行线性组合, 其中 n ≤ 2w + 1 [25]. 每块可表示为任意 k 块的有限域线性组合, 详见原文第 3.1 节.

RS codes incur high repair bandwidth, defined as the amount of data transferred across nodes during a repair. Repairing a single failed block needs to retrieve k blocks of the same stripe from other nodes; we call this process conventional repair, which applies to all (n, k) MDS codes. It also incurs high repair I/O, defined as the amount of data accessed from local storage during a repair. In high-speed networks, repair I/O becomes the dominant bottleneck (§1).

修复带宽指修复期间跨节点传输的数据量. RS 单块修复需从其他节点取同条带的 k 块, 本文称为常规修复, 适用于所有 (n, k) MDS 码. 它也带来较高的修复 I/O, 即从本地存储读取的数据量. 高速网络中, 后者成为主要瓶颈, 见原文第 1 节.

2.2 修复优化相关工作

Prior surveys [1, 33] review extensive research on optimizing single-block repair performance in erasure-coded storage. We review several representative repair-friendly erasure codes and their limitations.

已有综述 [1, 33] 总结了大量单块修复研究. 本节介绍代表性编码及其限制.

Minimum-storage regenerating (MSR) codes. MSR codes [4] minimize repair bandwidth for single-block repairs, while preserving the MDS property (i.e., minimum redundancy). They build on sub-packetization, which divides each block into α > 1 sub-blocks and forms α sub-stripes of n sub-blocks at the same offset across blocks. Each sub-block is a linear combination of other nα - 1 sub-blocks in the stripe over GF(2w). A single-block repair transfers a fraction of sub-blocks, with the minimum repair bandwidth.

最小存储再生码. MSR [4] 在保持 MDS 最小冗余的同时, 最小化单块修复带宽. 每块分成 α > 1 个子块, 各块相同偏移的 n 个子块组成一个子条带, 共 α 个. 每个子块在 GF(2w) 上是同条带其他 nα - 1 个子块的线性组合. 修复只传输部分子块, 达到最小带宽.

Traditional MSR codes [4] require nodes to read and encode all local sub-blocks, leading to high repair I/O. I/O-optimal MSR codes minimize repair I/O, by allowing accessed data to be sent directly without encoding. For example, Functional MSR (F-MSR) codes [6, 8] require n - k = 2 [8] or n - k = 3 [6], with a linear α = n - k, but are non-systematic. PM-RBT codes [27] are systematic but require n ≥ 2k - 1, while Butterfly codes [22] are also systematic but require n - k = 2 and incur an exponential α = 2k-1.

传统 MSR [4] 要求节点读取并编码本地全部子块, 修复 I/O 较高. I/O 最优 MSR 则允许直接发送读出的数据, 无须再编码. 例如 F-MSR [6, 8] 在 n - k 为 2 [8] 或 3 [6] 时, 采用线性 α = n - k, 但不是系统码. PM-RBT [27] 是系统码, 却要求 n ≥ 2k - 1; Butterfly [22] 也是系统码, 但要求 n - k = 2, 且 α = 2k-1 指数增长.

Clay codes [36] are state-of-the-art I/O-optimal MSR codes that are systematic, support general (n, k), and are deployed in Ceph [38]. However, Clay codes impose an exponential α = (n - k)⌈n/(n-k)⌉ (note that exponential sub-packetization is necessary for I/O-optimal MSR codes [2]). Even though Clay codes minimize repair I/O, they access numerous non-contiguous sub-blocks and incur substantial I/O seeks, defined as the number of non-contiguous reads to local storage in a repair. This leads to sub-optimal repair performance due to the overhead of handling extensive I/O requests [35].

Clay [36] 是先进的 I/O 最优 MSR, 支持通用 (n, k), 保持系统码形式, 已部署于 Ceph [38]. 但 α = (n - k)⌈n/(n-k)⌉, 呈指数增长, 而这对 I/O 最优 MSR 是必要条件 [2]. 虽读取量最少, 却要访问大量不连续子块. 本文将修复期间本地非连续读取次数称为 I/O seeks, 大量请求的处理开销会降低实际性能 [35].

Locally repairable codes (LRCs). LRCs [10, 12, 14, 31] reduce repair I/O for single-block repairs. For example, Azure-LRC [10] partitions data blocks into local groups and adds a local parity block per local group. Repairing a failed data or local parity block accesses only the blocks of its local group. However, Azure-LRC encodes all data blocks of a stripe into global parity blocks, whose repairs still rely on conventional repair. Some LRC variants support local repairs for global parity blocks [14], but LRCs are non-MDS and have higher redundancy than RS codes.

局部可修复码. LRC [10, 12, 14, 31] 降低单块修复 I/O. Azure LRC [10] 将数据分为局部组, 各增一个局部校验块, 修复数据块或局部校验块仅访问本组. 但全局校验块仍编码全条带数据, 需常规修复. 一些变体也支持全局校验块局部修复 [14], 但 LRC 不满足 MDS, 冗余高于 RS.

MDS codes with small sub-packetization. To limit I/O seeks, some MDS codes allow a small α with reduced repair I/O. Hitchhiker codes [29] use α = 2 sub-stripes of RS codes by combining sub-blocks across sub-stripes via piggybacking functions, and reduce repair I/O for data blocks by 25-45% compared to RS codes; however, parity-block repairs still follow conventional repair. HashTag codes [16] reduce repair I/O for data blocks with general (n, k) and α ≥ 2; their extended codes [15] reduce repair I/O for both data and parity blocks, but require α ≥ 4 and α as a multiple of n - k.

小子分块 MDS 码. Hitchhiker [29] 用 α = 2 的 RS 子条带和捎带函数组合子块, 将数据块修复 I/O 降低 25%-45%, 校验块仍用常规修复. HashTag [16] 支持通用 (n, k), α ≥ 2, 降低数据块读取量; 扩展版 [15] 同时优化数据和校验块, 但要求 α ≥ 4 且为 n - k 的倍数.

Elastic Transformation (ET) [35] converts an RS code into a repair-friendly code with a configurable α ≥ 2. However, the transformation restricts flexibility in code construction and limits further repair improvements.

弹性变换 ET [35] 将 RS 转为 α ≥ 2 可配置的便于修复编码, 但变换限制了构造灵活性与进一步优化空间.

Repair-efficient algorithms. Our study focuses on erasure code construction, while some studies design repair-efficient algorithms, such as search of minimum-I/O recovery for XOR-based erasure codes [13, 39] or repair parallelization [17, 18, 20, 32]. They do not minimize repair I/O due to constraints from underlying erasure codes.

高效修复算法. 本文研究编码构造; 其他工作研究 XOR 码最小 I/O 恢复搜索 [13, 39], 或修复并行化 [17, 18, 20, 32]. 受底层编码限制, 它们并不能最小化修复 I/O.

2.3 目标

Table 1 summarizes the repair-friendly codes and their limitations, including: non-MDS (e.g., Azure-LRC [10]), restrictive parameters (e.g., F-MSR [6, 8], PM-RBT [27], Butterfly [22]), non-systematic forms (e.g., F-MSR), exponential sub-packetization (e.g., Butterfly, Clay [36]), and data-block-only improvements (e.g., Hitchhiker [29], HashTag [16]).

表 1 汇总这些限制: 非 MDS, 如 Azure LRC; 参数受限, 如 F-MSR, PM-RBT, Butterfly; 非系统码, 如 F-MSR; 指数级子分块, 如 Butterfly, Clay; 只改善数据块, 如 Hitchhiker, HashTag.

Table 1: Comparisons of repair-efficient erasure codes.

表 1: 便于修复的纠删码比较.

The limitations inspire LESS, a family of repair-friendly erasure codes with I/O efficiency in mind. We observe that repair performance depends on both repair I/O and I/O seeks. Minimizing repair I/O introduces an exponential α [2, 36] (and hence high I/O seeks) and can negate repair performance gains. LESS targets near-minimum repair I/O with a small and configurable α to limit I/O seeks. Its design goals include:

修复性能同时取决于读取量与 I/O 次数. 极小化读取量需要指数级 α [2, 36], 从而增加 I/O 次数, 可能抵消收益. LESS 以较小且可配置的 α, 在接近最小读取量的同时限制 I/O 次数. 设计目标如下.

Preserving RS code properties: LESS is MDS, supports general (n, k), and remains systematic, as in RS codes.

保留 RS 属性: 满足 MDS, 支持通用 (n, k), 保持系统码形式.

I/O-efficient repair: LESS achieves I/O-efficient repairs in three aspects: (i) reduced repair I/O, (ii) reduced I/O seeks (e.g., α = 2, 3, or 4); and (iii) balanced reductions (i.e., similar reductions in repair I/O and I/O seeks across data and parity blocks). LESS also allows α to be configurable.

高效修复 I/O: 减少读取量, 减少非连续访问, 如 α 可取 2, 3, 4, 并让数据与校验块收益接近. α 也可配置.

Single- and multi-block repair efficiency: Earlier studies focus on optimizing single-block repairs, which dominate in practice (e.g., 98% of failures in (14, 10)-coded stripes [28]). However, wide-stripe codes (i.e., n and k are large) emerge and make multi-block repairs more common [12]. LESS addresses both scenarios.

兼顾单块与多块修复. 以往主要优化单块失效, 因其占多数, 如 (14, 10) 条带中占 98% [28]. 但 n, k 较大的宽条带逐渐普及, 多块修复更常见 [12]. LESS 同时考虑两类情况.

3. LESS 设计

LESS is constructed with configurable parameters (n, k, α), where k < n and 2 ≤ α ≤ n - k. Its key idea is to layer multiple extended sub-stripes, each constructed from sub-blocks and encoded using Vandermonde-based RS codes, such that a single-block repair always retrieves the sub-blocks from a single extended sub-stripe. LESS also enables I/O-efficient multi-block repairs if the failed blocks share the same extended sub-stripe.

LESS 参数为 (n, k, α), k < n, 2 ≤ α ≤ n - k. 它叠加多个由子块组成, 经 Vandermonde RS 编码的扩展子条带, 使单块修复始终只从一个扩展子条带取数据. 多块失效若属于同一扩展子条带, 也可高效修复.

3.1 基于 Vandermonde 矩阵的 RS 码

LESS builds on Vandermonde-based RS codes. An (n, k) Vandermonde-based RS code uses a parity-check matrix [24] to define the relationships between k data blocks B1, B2, ... , Bk and n - k parity blocks Bk+1, ... , Bn in GF(2w) based on the parity-check equation:

LESS 基于 Vandermonde RS 码. (n, k) 码用 GF(2w) 上的校验矩阵 [24], 定义 k 个数据块 B₁ 至 Bk 与 n - k 个校验块 Bk+1 至 Bn 的关系, 校验方程如下.

where vi = [1, vi, vi2, ..., vin-k-1]T is a column vector of length n - k, and vi is a distinct coding coefficient in GF(2w) associated with block Bi, for 1 ≤ i ≤ n. In GF(2w), an addition is equivalent to a bitwise-XOR operation. The (n - k) × n parity-check matrix [v1, v2, ..., vn] ensures that any n - k out of n columns are linearly independent, so as to allow reconstruction of any n - k blocks from the remaining k blocks.

其中粗体 vi = [1, vi, vi2, ..., vin-k-1]T 是长度 n - k 的列向量. 对 1 ≤ i ≤ n, vi 是 GF(2w) 中与 Bi 关联的互异系数. 域内加法等价于按位 XOR. (n - k) × n 校验矩阵的任意 n - k 列线性无关, 因而可由其余 k 块重建任意 n - k 块.

The encoding computes the n - k parity blocks from the k data blocks based on Equation (1):

根据式 (1), 从 k 个数据块计算 n - k 个校验块如下.

The decoding of any n - k blocks multiplies: (i) the inverted sub-matrix of their associated column vectors, (ii) the sub-matrix of the column vectors associated with the k remaining blocks, and (iii) the k remaining blocks, from Equation (1).

解码任意 n - k 块时, 依次相乘: 1) 这些块对应列向量子矩阵的逆; 2) 剩余 k 块对应的列向量子矩阵; 3) 剩余 k 块. 这同样由式 (1) 推出.

We consider LESS via an example. Figure 1 depicts an (n, k, α) = (6, 4, 2) LESS stripe, where each block Bi (1 ≤ i ≤ 6) has two sub-blocks bi, 1 and bi, 2. LESS organizes the 12 sub-blocks into three (8, 6) RS-coded extended sub-stripes, X1, X2, and X3. Each extended sub-stripe can tolerate any two sub-block failures, and the entire stripe can tolerate any two block failures due to the MDS property.

图 1 给出 (6, 4, 2) LESS. 每块 Bi 有两个子块 bi, 1, bi, 2, 共 12 个, 组织成三个 (8, 6) RS 扩展子条带 X₁, X₂, X₃. 每个扩展子条带容忍任意两个子块失效; 整个条带满足 MDS, 容忍任意两块失效.

图 1: (6, 4, 2) LESS 条带的编码设计.

Construction. First, we partition the 12 sub-blocks, such that each sub-block belongs to exactly two extended sub-stripes. This overlapping structure ensures that each extended substripe can be derived from the other two extended sub-stripes. For example, X3 comprises four data sub-blocks and four parity sub-blocks, each of which also belongs to either X1 or X2, but not both, so X3 can be derived from X1 and X2.

构造. 先让每个子块恰好属于两个扩展子条带. 这种交叠使任一扩展子条带都可由另外两个导出. 例如 X₃ 含四个数据子块和四个校验子块, 每个也只属于 X₁, X₂ 中的一个, 因而 X₃ 可由两者导出.

Next, we choose coding coefficients for the extended sub-stripes based on Vandermonde-based RS codes. We select 12 distinct coding coefficients vi, j's for bi, j's from GF(28) (1 ≤ i ≤ 6 and 1 ≤ j ≤ 2).

随后选择 Vandermonde RS 编码系数, 为 12 个 bi, j 从 GF(28) 选择互异 vi, j, 其中 1 ≤ i ≤ 6, 1 ≤ j ≤ 2.

Finally, we compute the parity blocks B5 and B6 by encoding the first two extended sub-stripes X1 and X2. We compute b5, 1 and b6, 1 with the six data blocks from X1, and b5, 2 and b6, 2 with the other six data blocks from X2 via (8, 6) Vandermonde-based RS encoding (based on Equation (1)) as:

最后编码 X₁ 与 X₂, 得到 B₅, B₆. 用 X₁ 的六个数据子块计算 b₅, ₁, b₆, ₁, 用 X₂ 的另外六个计算 b₅, ₂, b₆, ₂, 对应 (8, 6) Vandermonde RS, 方程如下.

where vi, j = [1, vi, j] T . This completes the encoding process. Our coding coefficients are carefully chosen to ensure that X3 inherently forms an (8, 6) Vandermonde-based RS stripe without being explicitly encoded. The reason is that X3 also satisfies the parity-check equation (Equation (1)), which is exactly the sum of the parity-check equations of X1 and X2:

其中粗体 vi, j = [1, vi, j]T, 编码至此完成. 精心选择的系数使 X₃ 无须显式编码就构成 (8, 6) Vandermonde RS 条带, 因为它的校验方程正好是 X₁ 和 X₂ 校验方程之和, 如下所示.

Single-block repair. Suppose B1 fails. LESS repairs b1, 1 and b1, 2 from X1 by retrieving six sub-blocks b2, 1, b2, 2, b3, 1, b4, 1, b5, 1, and b6, 1, with 25% less I/O than the conventional repair for the (6, 4) RS code (four full blocks). Note that LESS's repair I/O reductions apply to all data and parity blocks. For any block, its sub-blocks must reside in one of the extended sub-stripes. Thus, a single-block repair always retrieves six sub-blocks.

单块修复. 假设 B₁ 失效, 从 X₁ 读取 b₂, ₁, b₂, ₂, b₃, ₁, b₄, ₁, b₅, ₁, b₆, ₁ 六个子块, 即可恢复 b₁, ₁ 和 b₁, ₂. 相较 (6, 4) RS 常规修复的四个完整块, I/O 减少 25%. 这一收益适用于所有数据和校验块: 任一块的全部子块都属于某个扩展子条带, 因而单块修复总只需六个子块.

3.3 构造

We now elaborate on how to construct a LESS stripe for the configurable parameters (n, k, α), where k < n and 2 ≤ α ≤ n. An (n, k, α) LESS stripe comprises n blocks Bi's (1 ≤ i ≤ n), each with α sub-blocks bi, j's (1 ≤ j ≤ α) (i.e., α sub-stripes). LESS organizes the sub-blocks into α + 1 extended sub-stripes, each tolerating any n - k sub-block failures. Its construction process proceeds as follows.

下面详细说明可配置 (n, k, α) 的构造, 原文此处给出 k < n, 2 ≤ α ≤ n. n 个块各含 α 个子块, 即 α 个普通子条带. LESS 将其组织为 α + 1 个扩展子条带, 每个均容忍任意 n - k 子块失效, 步骤如下.

Step 1 (Grouping blocks). We partition n blocks into α + 1 block groups Gz's (1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1), whose numbers of blocks differ by at most one. The number of blocks in Gz (|Gz|) is:

步骤 1: 分组. 将 n 块分为 α + 1 组 Gz, 1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1, 各组块数最多相差一. 每组大小如下.

In Figure 1, we divide the six blocks into three block groups: G1 = {B1, B2}, G2 = {B3, B4}, and G3 = {B5, B6}.

图 1 的六块分成 G₁ = {B₁, B₂}, G₂ = {B₃, B₄}, G₃ = {B₅, B₆}.

Step 2 (Layering extended sub-stripes). We organize nα sub-blocks into α + 1 extended sub-stripes Xz's (1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1). Let gi be the index of the block group containing block Bi (i.e., if Bi ∈ Gz, then gi = z). Each of the first α Xz's (for 1 ≤ z ≤ α) includes all sub-blocks in Gz plus all sub-blocks in the z-th sub-stripe, while Xα+1 includes all sub-blocks in Gα+1 and all sub-blocks bi, j's where gi = j. The number of sub-blocks in Xz (|Xz|) is:

步骤 2: 叠加扩展子条带. 将 nα 子块组织为 α + 1 个 Xz. 令 gi 表示 Bi 所属组号. 前 α 个 Xz 各包含 Gz 全部子块, 以及第 z 个普通子条带的全部子块. Xα+1 包含最后一组全部子块, 以及所有满足 gi = j 的 bi, j. 其大小如下.

where n accounts for the sub-blocks in a sub-stripe, and (α - 1)|Gz| accounts for the remaining sub-blocks in Gz that do not belong to the same sub-stripe. Each sub-block belongs to exactly two extended sub-stripes. In particular, Xα+1 includes the sub-blocks from the first α extended sub-stripes, where each sub-block appears in exactly one of the first α extended sub-stripes. In Figure 1, we organize the sub-blocks into three extended sub-stripes (X1, X2 and X3), each of which contains eight sub-blocks.

其中 n 对应普通子条带的子块, (α - 1)|Gz| 对应该组不在同一普通子条带的其余子块. 每个子块恰好属于两个扩展子条带. 特别地, Xα+1 的每个子块也恰好属于前 α 个扩展子条带中的一个. 图 1 的 X₁, X₂, X₃ 各有八个子块.

Step 3 (Building MDS extended sub-stripes). Our goal is to make each extended sub-stripe Xz (1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1) form an (|Xz|, |Xz| - n + k) Vandermonde-based RS stripe that can tolerate any n - k sub-block failures. The encoding process proceeds as follows. First, we select nα distinct coding coefficients vi, j's (1 ≤ i ≤ n and 1 ≤ j ≤ α) from GF(2w), such that Xz must satisfy the parity-check equation:

步骤 3: 构造满足 MDS 的扩展子条带. 目标是让每个 Xz 形成 (|Xz|, |Xz| - n + k) Vandermonde RS, 容忍 n - k 子块失效. 先从 GF(2w) 选 nα 个互异系数 vi, j, 使 Xz 满足以下校验方程.

where vi, j = [1, vi, j, vi, j2, ..., vi, jn-k-1]T is a Vandermonde column vector of length n - k. The linear independence of any n - k Vandermonde column vectors ensures that Xz is an RS-coded stripe. Next, we compute the parity blocks Bi's (k + 1 ≤ i ≤ n) by encoding the first α extended sub-stripes Xz's in sequence (i.e., from X1 to Xα ). Specifically, for each Xz (1 ≤ z ≤ α), we compute the n - k parity sub-blocks bi, z (k +1 ≤ i ≤ n) using RS encoding (based on Equations (2) and (5)). Xα+1 does not require explicit encoding, as it automatically forms an Vandermonde-based RS stripe after the first α extended sub-stripes are encoded. In Figure 1, we compute B5 and B6 with X1 and X2 based on Vandermonde-based RS encoding, after which X3 also forms an (8, 6) Vandermondebased RS stripe.

其中粗体 vi, j = [1, vi, j, vi, j2, ..., vi, jn-k-1]T 是长度 n - k 的 Vandermonde 列向量. 任意 n - k 列线性无关, 保证 Xz 为 RS 条带. 再按 X₁ 至 Xα 顺序编码, 根据式 (2), (5) 计算各条带 n - k 个校验子块 bi, z, k + 1 ≤ i ≤ n. 最后一个扩展子条带无须显式编码, 会自动满足 Vandermonde RS. 图 1 中计算 B₅, B₆ 后, X₃ 也自动成为 (8, 6) 条带.

MDS property. For a LESS stripe to tolerate any n - k block failures, we must carefully select nα distinct coding coefficients vi, j's from a Galois Field. Theorem 1 shows that such coefficients can always be found in a sufficiently large field size. The detailed proof is in the Appendix.

MDS 属性. 为容忍任意 n - k 块失效, 需精心选择 nα 个互异有限域系数. 定理 1 表明, 有限域足够大时总能找到, 详细证明见附录.

Theorem 1. For (n, k, α) LESS, we can always find nα distinct coding coefficients vi, j (1 ≤ i ≤ n and 1 ≤ j ≤ α) in GF(2w) for MDS when 2w ≥ nα + (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k).

定理 1. 对 (n, k, α) LESS, 若 2w ≥ nα + (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k), 就能在 GF(2w) 找到 nα 个互异系数, 使编码满足 MDS. C(a, b) 表示二项式系数.

Theorem 1 provides a sufficient condition for the Galois Field size. In practice, for typical coding parameters, the required coefficients can be found in smaller fields (GF(28) or GF(216)). In our implementation, we can generate the nα coding coefficients using a primitive element p with a multiplicative approach:

定理 1 给出域大小的充分条件. 常见参数实际可在较小的 GF(28) 或 GF(216) 中找到系数. 实现用本原元 p 按以下乘幂方式生成 nα 个系数.

where hi (1 ≤ i ≤ |Gz|) is the position of Bi in its block group Gz (i.e., Bi is the hi-th block in Gz). For example, in Figure 1, B2 is the second block in G1, so g2 = 1 and h2 = 2. The primitive element is p = 2 for (6, 4, 2) LESS, while v2, 1 and v2, 2 are 215 and 216 in GF(28), respectively. We can find the feasible primitive elements based on brute-force search (i.e., checking linear independence by enumerating any possible sub-matrices of the parity-check matrix). Note that the search of feasible primitive elements is done only once for construction. In the Appendix, we show how the parity-check matrix is formed and provide the feasible primitive elements for common (n, k, α) (n - k ≤ 4 and 2 ≤ α ≤ 4).

其中 hi 为 Bi 在所属组中的位置. 例如图 1 中 B₂ 在 G₁ 排第二, g₂ = 1, h₂ = 2. (6, 4, 2) LESS 使用 p = 2, v₂, ₁ 和 v₂, ₂ 分别为 GF(28) 中的 215 和 216. 可通过穷举校验矩阵可能的子矩阵, 检查线性无关性来搜索可行本原元. 这一搜索在构造时只需执行一次. 附录给出校验矩阵和常见参数, 即 n - k ≤ 4, 2 ≤ α ≤ 4, 的可行本原元.

3.4 修复

LESS supports efficient repair of single-block failures within an extended sub-stripe and certain multi-block failures when the failed blocks reside in the same extended sub-stripe.

LESS 可在一个扩展子条带内高效修复单块失效; 多个失效块处于同一扩展子条带时, 部分情况也可高效修复.

Single-block repair. For a failed block Bi (1 ≤ i ≤ n) in Gz (1 ≤ z ≤ α), we repair Bi using sub-blocks within Xz, which contains all sub-blocks of Gz. Since Xz is an (|Xz|, |Xz| - n + k) RS-coded stripe, it tolerates any n - k ≥ α sub-block failures. The α failed sub-blocks can be reconstructed using the parity-check equation (Equation (5)) for Xz. To reduce accessed blocks, we prioritize transferring |Gz|(α - 1) available sub-blocks from Gz, followed by |Xz| - n + k - |Gz|(α - 1) available sub-blocks from other block groups.

单块修复. 对 Gz 中失效的 Bi, 原文此处写 1 ≤ z ≤ α, 使用包含该组全部子块的 Xz 修复. 其 RS 编码可容忍 n - k ≥ α 个子块失效, 因而可用式 (5) 恢复失效块的 α 个子块. 为减少访问块数, 优先传输本组 |Gz|(α - 1) 个可用子块, 再从其他组传输 |Xz| - n + k - |Gz|(α - 1) 个可用子块.

Multi-block repair. LESS is also beneficial for a multi-block repair, where we simultaneously repair multiple failed blocks on a single stripe. When ⌊(n - k)/α⌋ ≥ 2, LESS can repair any ⌊(n - k)/α⌋ block failures within one extended sub-stripe if all failed blocks reside in the same block group, say Gz (1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1). With all failed sub-blocks in Xz, since α⌊(n - k)/α⌋ ≤ n - k, the failed sub-blocks can be repaired within Xz. For other multi-block failure cases, LESS resorts to conventional repair (which retrieves k blocks). For example, in a (14, 10, 2) LESS stripe (Figure 2), repairing two failed blocks B1 and B2 in G1 (i.e., the sub-blocks b1, 1, b1, 2, b2, 1, and b2, 2 are in X1) can leverage X1's (19, 15) RS coding. This requires 15 sub-blocks, with 25% less repair I/O than the conventional repair of the (14, 10) RS code.

多块修复. 当 ⌊(n - k)/α⌋ ≥ 2, 且失效块属于同一组 Gz, 1 ≤ z ≤ α + 1, LESS 可在一个扩展子条带内修复任意 ⌊(n - k)/α⌋ 块失效. 因为所有失效子块均在 Xz, 且其数量 α⌊(n - k)/α⌋ ≤ n - k. 其他情况退回读取 k 个完整块的常规修复. 例如图 2 的 (14, 10, 2) 条带, 同组 B₁ 和 B₂ 失效时, 四个失效子块都在 X₁, 可利用其 (19, 15) RS 编码, 只读 15 子块, 比常规修复少 25%.

图 2: (14, 10, 2) LESS 的双块修复.

3.5 LESS 的高效修复 I/O

LESS achieves I/O-efficient repairs in three aspects: (i) repair I/O, (ii) I/O seeks, and (iii) balanced I/O reductions.

LESS 从读取量, I/O 次数和均衡收益三个方面提高效率.

Repair I/O. For block Bi (1 ≤ i ≤ n) in Gz (recall z = gi), We retrieve |Xz| - n + k sub-blocks, as we repair the block with the (|Xz|, |Xz| - n + k) RS code. From Equations (3) and (4), the repair I/O (in sub-blocks) of Bi is:

修复 I/O. 修复 Gz 中 Bi, 利用对应 RS 码读取 |Xz| - n + k 个子块. 根据式 (3), (4), 读取量如下.

This is strictly less than the I/O for the conventional repair of an (n, k) RS code when k > ⌈n/3⌉ (common in practice), as

当 k > ⌈n/3⌉ 时, 这一读取量严格小于常规 RS 修复; 该条件在实践中常见. 对应不等式如下.

IOi ≤ k + (α - 1)⌈n/(α + 1)⌉ ≤ k + (α - 1)⌈n/3⌉ < kα.

I/O seeks. For a single-block failure, LESS limits I/O seeks to k + α - 1. Repairing Bi in Gz requires |Xz| - n + k sub-blocks from Xz, including: (i) the α(|Gz| - 1) contiguous sub-blocks from Gz, which can be retrieved with |Gz| - 1 seeks, and (ii) |Xz| - n + k - α(|Gz| - 1) sub-blocks from other blocks, each requiring one seek. The total number of I/O seeks is (|Gz|-1)+|Xz|-n+k -α(|Gz|-1) = k +α -1, from Equations (3) and (4).

I/O 次数. 单块修复最多需要 k + α - 1 次非连续访问. 所需子块分两部分: 组内其他块的 α(|Gz| - 1) 个连续子块, 可通过 |Gz| - 1 次读取获得; 其余 |Xz| - n + k - α(|Gz| - 1) 个子块各需一次. 由式 (3), (4), 总次数为 (|Gz| - 1) + |Xz| - n + k - α(|Gz| - 1) = k + α - 1.

Balanced I/O reductions. The repair I/O is similar for the repair of any data or parity block in a stripe, and differs by at most α - 1 sub-blocks from Equation (7). Also, the repair incurs exactly one I/O seek from each of the k + α - 1 available blocks. Thus, LESS balances I/O reductions.

均衡收益. 由式 (7), 修复任意数据或校验块的读取量最多相差 α - 1 个子块. 每次修复也都恰好从 k + α - 1 个可用块各读取一次, 因而不同块的 I/O 收益较均衡.

4. 评估

We evaluate LESS via numerical analysis and testbed experiments, and address two questions: (i) Does LESS's empirical repair performance conform to its theoretical improvements? (ii) How do system configurations affect repair performance?

通过数值分析和测试集群回答: 实测修复性能是否符合理论优势? 系统配置如何影响修复性能?

4.1 数值分析

Exp#A1 (Single-block repair). We compare LESS against systematic MDS codes (RS, Clay, Hitchhiker, HashTag, and ET) in a single-block repair. We vary α from 2 to n - k for HashTag, ET, and LESS. We measure the average, minimum, and maximum repair I/O (in blocks) and total number of I/O seeks when repairing each of the n blocks. We focus on (n, k) = (14, 10), a default configuration in Facebook's f4 [21]. Table 2 shows that for α ≥ 3, LESS has less repair I/O than other codes (except Clay, which minimizes repair I/O) with limited I/O seeks. For α = 4, LESS reduces the average repair I/O of RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag (α = 4), and ET (α = 4) by 53.6%, 38.1%, 23.1%, and 20.7%, respectively, and reduces the average number of I/O seeks of Clay by 95.5%.

4.2 测试集群实验

Implementation. We implement LESS on OpenEC (an erasure coding middleware) [19] atop Hadoop 3.3.4 HDFS [7] and use Jerasure [26] for coding operations. We also include RS, Clay, Hitchhiker, HashTag, and ET in our comparisons. Our prototype adds 8.7 K LoC to OpenEC in C++.

实现. 在 Hadoop 3.3.4 HDFS [7] 上使用纠删码中间件 OpenEC [19], 以 Jerasure [26] 执行编码. 对比 RS, Clay, Hitchhiker, HashTag 和 ET. 原型为 OpenEC 增加约 8700 行 C++.

HDFS uses a NameNode for storage management and multiple DataNodes for storage. HDFS organizes data in fixed-size blocks, each further partitioned into multiple packets. The packets at the same block offset are encoded together, allowing pipelined coding operations across packets. Our prototype follows this packet-level pipelined implementation.

HDFS 用 NameNode 管理存储, 多个 DataNode 保存数据. 固定大小块进一步分为 packet, 相同块内偏移的 packet 共同编码, 可跨 packet 流水处理. 原型沿用这一实现.

Methodology. We conduct testbed experiments in a 15-machine local cluster connected via a 10 Gbps Ethernet switch. Each machine is equipped with a quad-core 3.4 GHz Intel i5-7500 CPU, 16 GiB RAM, a 7200 RPM 1 TB SATA HDD, and Ubuntu 22.04. We use Wondershaper [11] to configure the network bandwidth of each machine. We use one machine for the NameNode and 14 machines for DataNodes. By default, we set (n, k) = (14, 10), 64 MiB blocks, 256 KiB packets, and 1 Gbps network bandwidth as in prior work [19, 31, 35].

方法. 本地集群有 15 台机器, 经 10 Gbps 以太网交换机连接. 每台为四核 3.4 GHz Intel i5-7500, 16 GiB 内存, 7200 RPM 1 TB SATA HDD, Ubuntu 22.04. 使用 Wondershaper [11] 配置带宽, 一台 NameNode, 14 台 DataNode. 默认 (14, 10), 块大小 64 MiB, packet 大小 256 KiB, 每机带宽 1 Gbps, 与已有工作一致 [19, 31, 35].

We evaluate the (i) single-block repair time (i.e., the average time from issuing a repair request to a failed block until the failed block is repaired, averaged over n blocks) and (ii) full-node recovery time (i.e., the total time to repair all blocks in a single failed DataNode). In full-node recovery, we repair 20 blocks from different stripes (one block per stripe) [18], where node IDs are randomly assigned in the cluster across stripes, so that the lost blocks of a failed node correspond to different block positions across stripes. We average results over 10 runs, with 95% confidence intervals based on the Student's t-distribution.

评估单块修复时间, 即请求发出至修复完成的时长, 在 n 块上平均; 以及整节点恢复时间, 即修复失效 DataNode 全部块的总时长. 整节点实验恢复不同条带的 20 块, 每条带一块 [18], 跨条带随机分配节点 ID, 使失效节点对应不同块位置. 结果取 10 次平均, 用 Student t 分布计算 95% 置信区间.

Exp#B1 (Single-block repair). Figure 4(a) shows that LESS effectively reduces the single-block repair time due to the reductions in repair I/O and I/O seeks. For example, LESS (α = 4) reduces the single-block repair times of RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag (α = 4), ET (α = 4), and Clay by 50.8%, 35.9%, 21.5%, 21.5%, and 33.9%, respectively.

Exp#B1: 单块修复. 图 4(a) 中, LESS 减少读取量与 I/O 次数, 有效缩短时间. LESS-4 相较 RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag-4, ET-4, Clay, 分别降低 50.8%, 35.9%, 21.5%, 21.5%, 33.9%.

Exp#B2 (Full-node recovery). Figure 4(b) shows that LESS also reduces the full-node recovery time. For example, the reductions of LESS (α = 4) compared with RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag (α = 4), ET (α = 4), and Clay are 48.3%, 34.3%, 17.8%, 19.4%, and 36.6%, respectively.

Exp#B2: 整节点恢复. 图 4(b) 中 LESS-4 相较上述五种方案, 分别缩短 48.3%, 34.3%, 17.8%, 19.4%, 36.6%.

Exp#B3 (Encoding throughput). We measure the encoding throughput (i.e., the amount of data encoded per second) on a single machine. We construct a (14, 10) stripe in memory and put random bytes in the stripe for encoding. Figure 4(c) shows the results for packet sizes from 128 KiB to 1024 KiB. For 256 KiB packets, RS achieves 2.8 GiB/s, while LESS (α = 4) achieves 1.6 GiB/s. For wide stripes, say (124, 120) and 256 KiB packets, RS and LESS (α = 4) achieve 2.6 GiB/s and 1.1 GiB/s, respectively (not shown in the figure). The encoding throughput for both codes decreases with larger packet sizes, as more data needs to be fit into the CPU cache for encoding. LESS has lower encoding throughput than RS due to sub-packetization, yet its encoding throughput exceeds 1 GiB/s and its computational overhead remains limited compared to bandwidth and I/O bottlenecks (§2). Our evaluation measures single-threaded performance; the encoding throughput can be further improved via multi-threading across stripes.

Exp#B3: 编码吞吐量. 单机内存中构造 (14, 10) 条带, 用随机字节测试每秒编码量. 图 4(c) 将 packet 从 128 KiB 调至 1024 KiB. 256 KiB 时, RS 为 2.8 GiB/s, LESS-4 为 1.6 GiB/s. 未绘出的 (124, 120) 宽条带下, 两者分别为 2.6 和 1.1 GiB/s. packet 更大意味着更多数据需要放入 CPU 缓存, 两者吞吐量均下降. LESS 因子分块略慢, 但仍超过 1 GiB/s, 相比网络和 I/O 瓶颈, 计算开销有限. 实验为单线程, 可通过跨条带多线程进一步提高吞吐量.

Figure 4: Repair performance for (14, 10). In figures (a) and (b), we put α next to each code (e.g., LESS-4 has α = 4).

图 4: (14, 10) 的修复性能. (a), (b) 中编码名后的数字表示 α, 如 LESS-4 表示 α = 4.

Exp#B4 (Impact of network bandwidth). We study the impact of network bandwidth, varied from 1 Gbps to 10 Gbps via Wondershaper, on the single-block repair time. Figure 5(a) shows that as the network bandwidth increases, Clay suffers from significant I/O seek overhead, while LESS effectively reduces the single-block repair time due to small sub-packetization. For example, for 10 Gbps bandwidth, LESS (α = 4) reduces the single-block repair times of RS and Clay by 28.6% and 83.3%, respectively. Overall, LESS maintains a low single-block repair time for varying network bandwidth.

Exp#B4: 网络带宽. 用 Wondershaper 将带宽从 1 调到 10 Gbps, 测试单块修复. 图 5(a) 中网络越快, Clay 的非连续 I/O 开销越突出; LESS 凭较小子分块数保持较低修复时间. 10 Gbps 时, LESS-4 相较 RS 与 Clay 分别缩短 28.6% 和 83.3%. 各带宽下均保持较好表现.

Exp#B5 (Impact of packet size). We study the impact of packet size, varied from 128 KiB to 1024 KiB. Figure 5(b) shows that for small packet sizes, Clay incurs significant I/O overhead for processing a large number of sub-blocks, while LESS keeps stable repair performance. For example, for 128 KiB packets, LESS (α = 4) reduces the single-block repair times of RS and Clay by 59.1% and 50.4%, respectively.

Exp#B5: packet 大小. 图 5(b) 将 packet 从 128 KiB 调至 1024 KiB. 小 packet 下, Clay 处理大量子块的 I/O 开销明显, LESS 则较稳定. 128 KiB 时, LESS-4 相较 RS 与 Clay 分别缩短 59.1% 和 50.4%.

5. 结论

LESS is a family of erasure codes designed for I/O-efficient repairs by layering extended sub-stripes, so as to reduce both repair I/O and I/O seeks and ensure balanced reductions across blocks. It has several practical properties: MDS, general parameters, systematic, and configurable sub-packetization. Numerical analysis and testbed experiments show LESS's repair benefits over state-of-the-art repair-friendly codes.

LESS 通过叠加扩展子条带, 同时减少读取量与 I/O 次数, 并让各块收益均衡. 它满足 MDS, 支持通用参数, 保持系统码形式, 且子分块数可配置. 数值分析和集群实验表明, 修复性能优于先进的便于修复编码.

Proof of Theorem 1. To ensure LESS is MDS, we can verify the parity-check matrix of LESS, such that any n - k out of n parity sub-matrices can form an (n - k)α × (n - k)α square invertible matrix. Recall that any invertible square matrix has a non-zero determinant. To ensure that all possible square matrices from the parity-check matrix are invertible, we can multiply the determinants of the square matrices and ensure that the product is non-zero.

定理 1 的证明. 要保证 LESS 满足 MDS, 只需验证从 n 个校验子矩阵中任取 n - k 个, 都能组成 (n - k)α × (n - k)α 可逆方阵. 可逆方阵的行列式非零. 因此, 可以将所有可能方阵的行列式相乘, 只要乘积非零, 就能保证它们全部可逆.

There are C(n, n - k) cases for selecting n - k matrices out of the n parity-check sub-matrices to form a square matrix. The determinant of each square matrix can be viewed as a polynomial over the coding coefficients vi, j (1 ≤ i ≤ n and 1 ≤ j ≤ α). Each vi, j appears in only one parity-check sub-matrix, Hi, and there are C(n - 1, k) possible square matrices that contain Hi. Thus, the degree of vi, j in the determinant of such a square matrix is n - k - 1. By multiplying the determinants of all square matrices, the degree of each vi, j is (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k). We can choose nα distinct coding coefficients in GF(2w) to ensure the product of determinants is non-zero when 2w ≥ nα + (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k), which can be proven from Noga Alon's Combinatorial Nullstellensatz.

从 n 个校验子矩阵中选 n - k 个, 共 C(n, n - k) 种. 每个方阵的行列式可视为关于 vi, j 的多项式. 每个系数只出现在 Hi 中, 包含该子矩阵的方阵有 C(n - 1, k) 个. 该系数在每个相应行列式中的次数为 n - k - 1, 因而所有行列式相乘后, 次数为 (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k). 当 2w ≥ nα + (n - k - 1) C(n - 1, k) 时, 能从 GF(2w) 选出 nα 个互异系数, 使行列式乘积非零. 这一结论可由 Noga Alon 的组合零点定理证明.

Table 4 shows the feasible primitive elements for commonly used coding parameters n ≤ 127 and n - k ≤ 4 in GF(28) and GF(216) based on brute-force search.

表 4 给出穷举搜索得到的可行本原元, 对应常用参数 n ≤ 127, n - k ≤ 4, 有限域为 GF(28) 或 GF(216).

n - kαnGalois FieldPrimitive element
22≤127GF(28)2
32≤44GF(28)50
32≤127GF(216)2
33≤40GF(28)14
33≤127GF(216)2
42≤23GF(28)6
42≤127GF(216)46
43≤17GF(28)2
43≤127GF(216)1362
44≤16GF(28)14
44≤127GF(216)635
n - kαn有限域本原元 p

Table 4: Feasible primitive elements for commonly used coding parameters.

表 4: 常用编码参数下可行的本原元.

9. 附录 B: 实验材料

9.1 摘要

LESS is a family of erasure codes designed to improve repair I/O efficiency by layering extended sub-stripes, aiming to reduce both repair I/O and I/O seeks and maintain balanced reductions across all blocks. We implement LESS on OpenEC, an erasure coding middleware, atop Hadoop 3.3.4 HDFS.

LESS 通过叠加扩展子条带提高纠删码修复的 I/O 效率, 同时减少读取量与非连续 I/O 次数, 并使所有块获得均衡收益. 实现基于 Hadoop 3.3.4 HDFS 上的纠删码中间件 OpenEC.

9.2 范围

The artifact is a research-driven prototype that can be used to validate the concepts, designs, and evaluation results of LESS presented in the paper.

实验材料是研究原型, 用于验证论文提出的 LESS 概念, 设计与评估结果.

9.3 内容

The artifact has the following contents: src/, which includes the implementation of LESS as a patch to the OpenEC codebase; scripts/, which includes the evaluation scripts and configuration files to reproduce our evaluation results; README.md, which overviews the implementation and provides essential information to run the prototype; and AE_INSTRUCTION.md, which includes detailed instructions for artifact evaluation.

材料包括: src/, 以 OpenEC 补丁形式实现 LESS; scripts/, 保存复现实验所需脚本与配置; README.md, 介绍实现及运行原型的基本信息; AE_INSTRUCTION.md, 提供详细评估步骤.

9.4 托管

The artifact is hosted in GitHub at LESS. We use version v1.0.0 for artifact evaluation.

材料托管于 GitHub 的 LESS 仓库, 评估使用 v1.0.0.

9.5 依赖条件

Hardware Dependencies. We recommend 15 machines to run the experiments with our prototype and evaluation scripts. These machines need to be connected via a 10 Gbps network, such that they are reachable from each other. For each machine, we recommend a quad-core CPU, 16 GiB of memory, a 7200 RPM SATA HDD and above. We need a minimum of 15 machines to form a storage cluster for the default erasure coding parameters (n, k) = (14, 10). In particular, we use one machine to run the HDFS NameNode and the other machines to run the HDFS DataNodes.

硬件依赖. 建议使用 15 台机器运行原型与评估脚本, 经 10 Gbps 网络互连且能相互访问. 每台建议至少四核 CPU, 16 GiB 内存和 7200 RPM SATA HDD. 默认 (14, 10) 编码至少需要 15 台机器: 一台运行 HDFS NameNode, 其余运行 DataNode.

Software Dependencies. The artifact is developed and tested on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with the following software dependencies: OpenEC requires g++, cmake, redis, hiredis, ISA-L, and gf-complete; Hadoop HDFS requires openjdk-8-jdk and maven; scripts require expect, python3, and wondershaper.

软件依赖. 材料在 Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 开发测试. OpenEC 依赖 g++, cmake, redis, hiredis, ISA-L, gf-complete; Hadoop HDFS 依赖 openjdk-8-jdk, maven; 脚本依赖 expect, python3, wondershaper.

9.6 集群搭建

Please set up the testbed with the following steps: prepare the hardware dependencies as described; download the artifact, version v1.0.0, from LESS releases; extract the files with tar -zxvf less.tar.gz and run cd less to navigate to the project directory; follow AE_INSTRUCTION.md to set up the testbed and run experiments with our provided evaluation scripts. The testbed setup takes around 5 hours, depending on the hardware specifications.

按以下顺序搭建: 准备上述硬件; 从 LESS 发布页 下载 v1.0.0; 执行 tar -zxvf less.tar.gz 解压, 再用 cd less 进入项目; 按 AE_INSTRUCTION.md 配置集群, 使用配套脚本运行实验. 搭建约需 5 小时, 具体取决于硬件.

9.7 评估目标

Our goal is to demonstrate LESS's effectiveness in improving repair performance. For numerical analysis, Exp#A1 and Exp#A2, we expect the results to match those in our paper. For testbed experiments, Exp#B1 to Exp#B5, we expect that LESS reduces the single-block repair and full-node recovery times compared to the baseline erasure codes. However, the testbed experiment results may vary from those in our paper due to different factors, such as cluster sizes, machine specifications, operating systems, and software packages.

目标是验证 LESS 改善修复性能的效果. 数值分析 Exp#A1, A2 应与论文一致; 集群实验 Exp#B1 至 B5 应体现 LESS 相较基线缩短单块修复和整节点恢复时间. 具体数值可能因集群规模, 机器配置, 操作系统及软件包不同而变化.

9.8 实验

Exp#A1 (Single-block repair). Expected outcome: Exp#A1 produces the results as shown in Tables 2 and 3, which demonstrate that LESS reduces the average repair I/Os of RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag, and ET, and reduces the average number of I/O seeks of Clay. Approximate runtime: 2 compute minutes.

Exp#A1, 单块修复. 应复现表 2, 3: 相较 RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag, ET 减少平均读取量, 相较 Clay 减少平均 I/O 次数. 约需 2 分钟计算时间.

Exp#A2 (Multi-block repair). Expected outcome: Exp#A2 produces the results as shown in Figure 3, which demonstrate that LESS reduces the average repair I/O of RS, and achieves similar average numbers of I/O seeks as RS. Approximate runtime: 1 compute minute.

Exp#A2, 多块修复. 应复现图 3: 相较 RS 减少平均读取量, 平均 I/O 次数相近. 约需 1 分钟计算时间.

Exp#B1 (Single-block repair). Expected outcome: Exp#B1 produces the results as shown in Figure 4(a), which demonstrate that LESS reduces the single-block repair times of RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag, ET, and Clay. Approximate runtime: 2 compute hours.

Exp#B1, 单块修复. 应复现图 4(a), 相较上述五种基线缩短单块修复时间. 约需 2 小时计算时间.

Exp#B2 (Full-node recovery). Expected outcome: Exp#B2 produces the results as shown in Figure 4(b), which demonstrate that LESS reduces the full-node recovery times of RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag, ET, and Clay. Approximate runtime: 2 compute hours.

Exp#B2, 整节点恢复. 应复现图 4(b), 相较 RS, Hitchhiker, HashTag, ET, Clay 缩短整节点恢复时间. 约需 2 小时计算时间.

Exp#B3 (Encoding throughput). Expected outcome: Exp#B3 produces the results as shown in Figure 4(c), which demonstrate that LESS has lower single-stripe encoding throughput than RS, yet the coding computation overhead is limited compared to bandwidth and I/O operations. Approximate runtime: 5 compute minutes.

Exp#B3, 编码吞吐量. 应复现图 4(c): LESS 单条带编码吞吐低于 RS, 但相比网络和 I/O 操作, 编码计算开销有限. 约需 5 分钟计算时间.

Exp#B4 (Impact of network bandwidth). Expected outcome: Exp#B4 produces the results as shown in Figure 5(a). It shows that when the network bandwidth increases, while Clay suffers from significant I/O seek overhead, LESS still effectively reduces the single-block repair time due to small sub-packetization. Approximate runtime: 2 compute hours.

Exp#B4, 网络带宽影响. 应复现图 5(a): 带宽增加时, Clay 的非连续 I/O 开销突出, LESS 凭较少的子分块仍能有效缩短单块修复时间. 约需 2 小时计算时间.

Exp#B5 (Impact of packet size). Expected outcome: It shows that for small packet sizes, while Clay incurs significant I/O overhead for processing a large number of sub-blocks, LESS maintains stable repair performance due to small sub-packetization. Approximate runtime: 2 compute hours.

Exp#B5, packet 大小影响. 小 packet 下, Clay 处理大量子块带来明显 I/O 开销, LESS 凭较少的子分块保持稳定修复性能. 约需 2 小时计算时间.

entry.title: 译 - Lockify: Understanding Linux Distributed Lock Management Overheads in Shared Storage
entry.content:
原论文 Lockify: Understanding Linux Distributed Lock Management Overheads in Shared Storage 发表于 FAST 2026 (第 24 届 USENIX 文件与存储技术会议), 中文题名为 "Lockify: 理解共享存储中 Linux 分布式锁管理的开销".

共享磁盘文件系统创建文件或目录时, 即使锁竞争很少, Linux 分布式锁管理器仍可能随着客户端增多而产生更多远端通信. Lockify 针对的是低竞争情况下不必要的等待:

所有权管理

  • 本节点所有权通知让客户端在合适的情况下直接利用本地已知的锁所有权, 减少与远端锁目录节点的交互.

异步处理

  • 所有权确认异步进行, 避免把远端往返放在每次锁获取的关键路径上; 论文同时分析了这样做的一致性条件.

实验结果

  • Linux 内核实现使用 GFS2 和 OCFS2 评估. 在论文测试的实际负载下, 整体吞吐量最高达到内核 DLM 或 O2CB 对照的约 6.4 倍.

Lockify 研究共享磁盘文件系统在低锁竞争情况下仍然出现的分布式锁管理开销. GFS2 和 OCFS2 等系统允许多个客户端访问同一存储, 需要 DLM 协调锁所有权; 创建文件或目录时, 即使实际竞争很少, 随着客户端数量增加, 与远端锁目录节点的通信仍可能拖慢锁获取. 这篇 FAST 2026 论文从 Linux 内核 DLM 的测量出发, 提出本节点所有权通知, 让客户端在满足条件时利用本地已知的所有权信息, 避免不必要的远端往返. 异步所有权管理进一步把确认过程移出部分操作的等待路径, 同时必须维护原有锁语义与一致性. 文章解释了锁目录节点和所有者节点的不同职责, 给出机制分析与内核实现, 并在两种文件系统及实际负载中比较性能. 论文报告整体吞吐量最高达到内核 DLM 或 O2CB 对照的约 6.4 倍, 该倍数表示相对基线的比值. 文中的 RDMA 对比使用模拟的无通信延迟基线, 并非对真实 RDMA DLM 的直接测试.

directory node 译为锁目录节点, 指保存锁所有者映射的节点, 与文件系统中的目录区分; owner node 译为所有者节点, 不等同于所有持锁客户端. 吞吐倍数均表示相对于基线的比值. 原文服务器配置将 Xeon Gold 5115 写为每插槽 20 核, 译文保留原文记录, 未据此更改硬件参数. RDMA 对比采用模拟的无通信延迟基线, 并非直接测试真实 RDMA DLM.

0. 摘要

This paper presents Lockify, a novel distributed lock manager (DLM) for shared-disk file systems. Our key observation in shared-storage scenarios is that, for file or directory creation, lock acquisition overhead in the Linux kernel DLM increases with the number of clients, even in low-contention scenarios. Lockify minimizes this lock acquisition latency by avoiding unnecessary communication with remote directory nodes through self-owner notifications and asynchronous ownership management. We implement Lockify in the Linux kernel and evaluate its performance on real-world workloads using two representative shared-disk file systems, GFS2 and OCFS2. Our experimental results demonstrate that Lockify improves overall throughput by ∼6.4× compared to the kernel DLM and O2CB, consistently across different numbers of clients.

本文提出 Lockify, 一种面向共享磁盘文件系统的新型分布式锁管理器 (DLM). 我们发现, 在共享存储场景下创建文件或目录时, 即使锁竞争很少, Linux 内核 DLM 的锁获取开销仍会随着客户端数量增加而上升. Lockify 通过本节点所有权通知和异步所有权管理, 避免与远端锁目录节点进行不必要的通信, 从而降低锁获取延迟. 我们在 Linux 内核中实现 Lockify, 并使用 GFS2 和 OCFS2 两种代表性的共享磁盘文件系统, 在实际工作负载上评估性能. 实验表明, 相较内核 DLM 和 O2CB, Lockify 的整体吞吐量可达到约 6.4 倍, 并在不同客户端数量下保持良好表现.

1. 引言

Storage disaggregation has attracted significant attention in cloud datacenters for its ability to manage storage resources elastically through remote storage access technologies like NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF) [6, 23, 24, 28, 38]. These technologies enable efficient and flexible resource utilization across various services, including databases [8, 22, 25], storage sharing [29, 34], and high-availability systems [32, 36, 37]. To support these services, cloud providers deploy shared-disk file systems such as GFS2 [41], OCFS2 [19], and VMFS [30], which allow multiple clients to access shared storage simultaneously through a distributed lock manager (DLM) to coordinate locks across clients.

存储分离借助 NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF) 等远程访问技术 [6, 23, 24, 28, 38], 实现存储资源的弹性管理, 因而受到云数据中心的广泛关注. 这些技术让数据库 [8, 22, 25], 存储共享 [29, 34] 和高可用系统 [32, 36, 37] 等服务能够高效, 灵活地利用资源. 为支持这些服务, 云厂商部署 GFS2 [41], OCFS2 [19], VMFS [30] 等共享磁盘文件系统, 允许多个客户端同时访问共享存储, 并通过 DLM 协调客户端之间的锁.

Distributed locks in these file systems can degrade overall performance under high lock contention. Hence, they are typically used in scenarios where contention is well-managed. For example, in high-availability systems, storage is shared between a primary node and backup nodes, allowing services to be seamlessly migrated to backup nodes in the event of a system failure. However, during normal operation, only the primary node actively requires locks [32, 36, 37]. Given this, previous studies report that 76.1%-97.1% of files are rarely accessed by more than one client [29]. Therefore, DLMs are expected to be effective and avoid lock contention. However, our measurements reveal that it often degrades file system performance even in low-contention scenarios (§3). Our key observations are:

锁竞争激烈时, 这些文件系统的分布式锁可能拖累整体性能, 因而通常用于竞争受到良好控制的场景. 例如高可用系统中, 主节点与备份节点共享存储, 故障时可将服务平滑迁移至备份节点; 正常运行时, 只有主节点主动请求锁 [32, 36, 37]. 已有研究也指出, 76.1%-97.1% 的文件很少被多个客户端访问 [29]. 按理说, DLM 应能有效工作, 避免锁竞争带来的问题. 然而我们的测量发现, 即使竞争很少, 它也常常降低文件系统性能, 见原文第 3 节. 主要观察如下.

Limited scalability. Shared-disk file systems face scalability challenges under workloads that frequently create files and directories, even though they scale well for other normal I/O operations. This limitation persists even when only a single client is active among multiple clients.

扩展性受限. 共享磁盘文件系统在普通 I/O 操作上扩展良好, 但频繁创建文件和目录的负载会暴露扩展性问题. 即使多个客户端中只有一个处于活动状态, 这一限制也依然存在.

Bottlenecks in DLM operations. The bottleneck originates from DLM operations: before creating new files or directories, the DLM must look up and access the lock-owner node to acquire the necessary locks. This process introduces communication latency across clients, creating a performance bottleneck.

DLM 操作形成瓶颈. 创建文件或目录前, DLM 必须查找并访问锁的所有者节点, 才能取得所需锁. 这会引入客户端之间的通信延迟, 成为性能瓶颈.

We confirm that these performance issues occur across different DLM designs (e.g., Linux kernel DLM [1] and O2CB [7]), as DLMs manage lock-owner nodes in a distributed manner.

我们确认, Linux 内核 DLM [1] 和 O2CB [7] 等不同设计均存在这一问题, 因为它们都以分布式方式管理锁的所有者节点.

This paper presents Lockify, a novel distributed lock manager for shared-disk file systems. While looking up the owner node is a fundamental process in DLMs, our key insight is that when creating new files or directories, the node initiating the creation can designate itself as the owner, rather than querying other nodes. Based on this insight, Lockify introduces two novel mechanisms: self-owner notification and asynchronous ownership management. Self-owner notification allows a node that creates files or directories to immediately declare their ownership. This mechanism notifies relevant nodes (e.g., the corresponding directory node maintaining the owner-node list) and acquires the lock instantly, eliminating the need to wait for a response from the directory node (§4.1). To ensure that the directory node is correctly updated, Lockify maintains a wait-list, enabling the node to resend the notification if a timer expires. This asynchronous ownership management approach reduces communication latency while preserving the consistency of shared-disk file systems (§4.3). We implement Lockify in the Linux kernel and evaluate it using two representative shared-disk file systems, GFS2 and OCFS2, under both low- and high-contention scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our simple approach significantly improves file system throughput by ∼6.4× compared to existing DLMs across microbenchmarks and real-world workloads (§5).

本文提出面向共享磁盘文件系统的 Lockify. 查找所有者节点虽然是 DLM 的基本操作, 但我们注意到: 新建文件或目录时, 发起创建的节点可以直接将自己指定为所有者, 无须先询问其他节点. 基于这一点, Lockify 引入本节点所有权通知和异步所有权管理两项机制. 前者让创建文件或目录的节点立即声明自己拥有相应锁对象的所有权, 通知维护所有者列表的锁目录节点等相关节点, 并立即获取锁, 无须等待锁目录节点响应, 见原文第 4.1 节. 为确保锁目录节点正确更新, Lockify 维护等待列表, 超时后可重发通知. 这种异步管理既减少通信延迟, 又保持共享磁盘文件系统的一致性, 见原文第 4.3 节. 我们在 Linux 内核中实现该方案, 用 GFS2, OCFS2 在低竞争和高竞争场景下评估. 微基准和实际负载表明, 相较现有 DLM, 这一简单方案可将文件系统吞吐量提升至约 6.4 倍, 见原文第 5 节.

2. 背景

This section provides key background on distributed lock managers in shared and parallel file systems, and outlines our target systems.

本节介绍共享文件系统与并行文件系统中 DLM 的关键背景, 并说明本文针对的系统范围.

Linux kernel DLM. Linux provides an in-kernel DLM service [1] for shared-disk file systems (e.g., GFS2, OCFS2), cluster logical volume manager (LVM), and cluster multi-device (MD). Shared-disk file systems rely on this DLM to manage locks in a distributed manner through "owner" and "directory" nodes. Each lock object is assigned an owner node and a directory node. The directory node is determined based on a hash function and tracks which node currently serves as the owner for each lock object and helps route lock requests. The owner node is responsible for granting access and revoking locks as needed. Figure 1 illustrates a DLM operation example where Node 2 acquires a lock on file 'A'. Initially, Node 2 determines the appropriate directory node by hashing the lock object's name (step 2). It then asks the directory node (Node 1) for the current owner of the lock object (step 3). After looking up its lock table, the directory sends a response (step 4), and then Node 2 requests and acquires the lock from the owner node, Node 3 (steps 5-6). We note that when creating files or directories, no ownership has been established yet. In such cases, the directory node may assign the requesting node as the owner node, allowing lock acquisition (steps 5-6) to be handled locally (on Node 2).

Linux 内核 DLM. Linux 提供内核中的 DLM 服务 [1], 用于 GFS2, OCFS2 等共享磁盘文件系统, 集群逻辑卷管理器 LVM 和集群多设备 MD. 共享磁盘文件系统通过所有者节点和锁目录节点, 依靠 DLM 分布式管理锁. 每个锁对象均分配这两类节点. 锁目录节点由哈希函数确定, 记录各锁对象当前的所有者, 并协助转发锁请求; 所有者节点负责授予访问权, 必要时撤销锁. 图 1 展示节点 2 获取文件 A 的锁的过程. 节点 2 先对锁对象名称取哈希, 确定锁目录节点, 即步骤 2; 再询问节点 1 当前的所有者, 即步骤 3. 节点 1 查表后响应, 即步骤 4; 随后节点 2 向所有者节点 3 请求并取得锁, 即步骤 5, 6. 新建文件或目录时, 尚无已确定的所有者. 此时锁目录节点可将请求方指定为所有者, 从而使步骤 5, 6 在节点 2 本地完成.

Figure 1: DLM operation example for shared file I/O. Note that when creating files or directories, the directory node assigns the requester as the owner node since no ownership exists yet, allowing steps 5 and 6 to be handled locally on Node 2.

图 1: 共享文件 I/O 的 DLM 操作示例. 新建文件或目录时尚无所有者, 锁目录节点将请求方指定为所有者, 步骤 5, 6 因而可在节点 2 本地完成.

Other DLM designs. In high-performance computing (HPC) systems, file systems have introduced "client-cache" to address the imbalance between high-speed computation and relatively slower storage devices [14, 40]. Accordingly, parallel file systems (PFS) such as Clustered XFS (CXFS) [20] and Lustre [4] employ DLMs and owner nodes to ensure client-cache coherence under high-contention workloads, with a focus on reducing lock conflict resolution overhead [14, 17]. Some recent studies [18, 21, 33, 39, 42] proposed to leverage hardware-assisted solutions, such as Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA), to access shared objects in distributed systems. In particular, recent DLM designs [21, 42] incorporate one-sided RDMA to eliminate server-side CPU involvement and enable CPU-efficient operations in high-contention scenarios.

其他 DLM 设计. 高性能计算 (HPC) 文件系统引入客户端缓存, 缓解高速计算与相对较慢存储之间的不匹配 [14, 40]. 因此, Clustered XFS (CXFS) [20], Lustre [4] 等并行文件系统通过 DLM 和所有者节点, 保证高竞争负载下的客户端缓存一致性, 重点减少锁冲突处理开销 [14, 17]. 近期研究 [18, 21, 33, 39, 42] 还利用远程直接内存访问 RDMA 等硬件辅助方案访问分布式共享对象. 其中一些 DLM [21, 42] 使用单边 RDMA, 无须服务端 CPU 参与, 提高高竞争场景下的 CPU 效率.

Target DLM. This paper focuses on fully distributed DLMs, such as the Linux kernel DLM, which coordinate lock management across client nodes in shared-disk file systems. These DLMs avoid a single point of failure by eliminating centralized metadata servers (e.g., directory nodes) and can even bypass coordination overhead when the local client holds lock ownership. However, as demonstrated in §3, they often encounter scalability challenges due to directory-node lookups. In contrast, centralized architectures like Lustre [4] or Ceph [40] do not face this specific challenge, as their design lacks distributed directory nodes entirely. While such systems may introduce other scalability issues (e.g., single points of contention), those are outside the scope of this work.

目标 DLM. 本文关注 Linux 内核 DLM 这类完全分布式的管理器, 在共享磁盘文件系统的各客户端之间协调锁管理. 它们不依赖集中式元数据服务器, 例如集中式锁目录节点, 因而避免单点故障; 本地客户端拥有锁对象所有权时, 甚至可省去协调开销. 但原文第 3 节表明, 锁目录查询仍常造成扩展性问题. 相比之下, Lustre [4], Ceph [40] 等集中式架构没有分布式锁目录节点, 因而不会遇到这一特定问题. 这些系统可能存在其他扩展性问题, 如集中竞争点, 但不在本文范围内.

3. 动机: 理解低竞争场景下 Linux DLM 的开销

This section presents the performance evaluation of the Linux kernel DLM with two representative shared-disk file systems, GFS2 and OCFS2, to examine how DLM operations impact overall file system performance. While we explore a range of workloads and contention configurations in §5, this section focuses on a low-contention scenario where a single active application process operates among multiple clients (up to 5) sharing the same storage via shared file systems. In our setup, each client connects to a shared NVMe SSD via NVMe-over-TCP [10], and the kernel DLM also communicates over TCP connections. The active client then executes test workloads involving 35,000 file or directory creations and 4KB (sequential and random) reads and writes for a 1GB file using IOR [3]. Additional testbed configurations are detailed in §5. We discuss key observations in the following paragraphs.

本节使用 GFS2 和 OCFS2 评估 Linux 内核 DLM, 考察锁操作如何影响文件系统整体性能. 原文第 5 节将讨论多种负载与竞争程度; 本节聚焦低竞争场景: 最多五个客户端经共享文件系统访问同一存储, 只有一个客户端运行应用进程. 每个客户端通过 NVMe-over-TCP [10] 连接共享 NVMe SSD, 内核 DLM 也经 TCP 通信. 活动客户端使用 IOR [3] 创建 35000 个文件或目录, 并对一个 1 GB 文件执行 4 KB 顺序或随机读写. 其他集群配置见原文第 5 节. 下面介绍主要观察.

Low contention does not always translate to high throughput. Figure 2 presents the throughput of GFS2 with our test workloads as the number of clients increases, with only a single active client running the IOR process while the others remain idle. We observe that normal file I/O operations, such as reads and writes, remain unaffected by the number of clients (Figure 2(a)). This is because I/O overhead is much higher than lock acquisition overhead, as only one client requires locks. The throughput of normal I/O operations is only affected in scenarios with high-lock contention, which have been the focus of previous studies [16, 17, 21]. In contrast, when creating a large number of files or directories, throughput drops significantly by up to 86%, even in the absence of high lock contention, as shown in Figure 2(b). Our latency breakdown analysis in Figure 3 reveals that, under this workload, DLM operations (corresponding to steps 2-6 in Figure 1) account for 47% of the total latency, while the file system (create) operation contributes the remaining 53%. The lock acquisition time, excluding the communication latency with the directory node and owner node, accounts for only 15%. This indicates that the communication latency is the main bottleneck.

竞争少并不一定意味着吞吐量高. 图 2 展示客户端数量增加时的 GFS2 吞吐量, 其中始终只有一个客户端运行 IOR, 其他客户端空闲. 普通读写吞吐不受客户端数量影响, 见图 2(a), 因为只有一个客户端需要锁, I/O 开销远高于锁获取开销. 普通 I/O 吞吐只在锁竞争激烈时受影响, 这也是以往研究的重点 [16, 17, 21]. 但图 2(b) 中, 大量创建文件或目录时, 即使没有激烈竞争, 吞吐量仍最多下降 86%. 图 3 的延迟分解表明, DLM 操作, 即图 1 的步骤 2 至 6, 占总延迟 47%, 文件系统创建操作占其余 53%. 若排除与锁目录节点和所有者节点的通信, 锁获取本身仅占 15%. 因而主要瓶颈在通信延迟.

Figure 2: GFS2 performance with the kernel DLM in a low-contention scenario. (a) While file I/O throughput remains almost unchanged regardless of the number of clients, (b) directory and file creation operations are significantly impacted, even when only a single client is active.

图 2: 低竞争下 GFS2 使用内核 DLM 的性能. (a) 普通文件 I/O 吞吐几乎不随客户端数量变化; (b) 即使只有一个客户端活动, 创建文件或目录也受到明显影响.

图 3: 五客户端下的延迟分解. 图 2 的目录创建中, 全部 DLM 操作合计占总延迟 47%.

We note that this bottleneck can be mitigated when fewer clients are present, increasing the likelihood that the local node serves as the directory or owner node. For example, in an extreme scenario where only a single client exists, that client would always act as both the directory node and the owner node for all newly created files and directories, allowing lock acquisitions to be handled locally. Figure 4 illustrates the PDF of lock acquisition time distribution; in the single-client case, lock acquisition latency consistently remains below 20µs while maintaining high throughput (as shown in Figure 2). However, as the number of client nodes increases, the probability of the hashing function assigning a remote client as the directory node also increases, leading to longer lock acquisition latency and lower throughput. This explains reason behind GFS2's poor throughput in low-contention scenarios.

客户端较少时, 本地节点更可能兼任锁目录节点或所有者, 这一瓶颈会减轻. 极端情况下只有一个客户端, 它总是所有新文件和目录的锁目录节点及所有者, 锁获取完全在本地完成. 图 4 给出锁获取时间的概率密度分布: 单客户端下延迟始终低于 20 μs, 且保持较高吞吐量, 见图 2. 客户端增加后, 哈希函数将远端节点选为锁目录节点的概率上升, 锁获取延迟增加, 吞吐量降低. 这解释了 GFS2 在低竞争场景下吞吐不佳的原因.

Figure 4: PDF of lock acquisition time distribution. As the number of clients increases, the probability of assigning a remote directory node also increases, leading to longer lock acquisition latency.

图 4: 锁获取时间的概率密度分布. 客户端增加后, 选中远端锁目录节点的概率上升, 锁获取延迟随之增加.

Similar trends are observed across different file systems and DLMs. To verify that this phenomenon is not specific to a particular file system-DLM combination (i.e., GFS2 with the kernel DLM), we run the same experiments using OCFS2 with both O2CB (OCFS2's native DLM) and the kernel DLM, as shown in Figure 5. The overall trend remains consistent with Figure 2; throughput in the 5-client case is much lower than in the single-client case for both directory and file creation.

不同文件系统与 DLM 也有相似趋势. 为验证这一现象并非 GFS2 加内核 DLM 特有, 我们在 OCFS2 上分别使用其原生 DLM O2CB 和内核 DLM 重复实验, 如图 5. 趋势与图 2 一致: 无论创建目录还是文件, 五客户端吞吐都明显低于单客户端.

We observe that O2CB performs significantly worse than the kernel DLM in the 5-client case (Figures 5(a) and (b)). The primary reason is that O2CB lacks a "directory node" in its design. As a result, it must communicate with all clients to determine the owner node for a new lock object, whereas the kernel DLM requires at most a single interaction with the corresponding directory node. This additional communication overhead leads to lower performance in workloads involving frequent directory or file creation.

五客户端时, O2CB 比内核 DLM 更慢, 见图 5(a), (b). 主要原因是它没有锁目录节点, 必须与全部客户端通信, 才能确定新锁对象的所有者; 内核 DLM 至多只需与对应的锁目录节点交互一次. 额外通信使频繁创建文件或目录的负载性能更差.
