图 5: OCFS2 分别使用 O2CB 与内核 DLM 的性能. 趋势与图 2 一致, 客户端越多, 吞吐越低.

4. Lockify: 降低锁获取开销

Based on the observations from §3, we introduce Lockify, a simple yet effective approach to minimizing lock acquisition overhead. Figure 6 provides an overview of Lockify: since the DLM designates the creator of a new file or directory as its initial owner, Lockify explicitly declares self-ownership during create operations. The notification and response exchange is then handled asynchronously. We describe the three key components of Lockify in the following subsections (§4.1-§4.3), followed by case studies on DLM consistency (§4.4).

根据原文第 3 节的观察, 我们设计了简单而有效的 Lockify, 尽量减少锁获取开销. 图 6 展示其流程. DLM 本来就会将新文件或目录的创建者设为初始所有者, 因而 Lockify 在创建时直接声明本节点所有权, 后续通知与响应异步完成. 原文第 4.1 至 4.3 节介绍三个主要组成部分, 第 4.4 节分析 DLM 一致性.

Figure 6: Lockify overview. When creating new files or directories, the file system (Shared FS) can request a lock with the NOTIFY flag enabled via the extended DLM interface. It then acquires the lock immediately after sending the self-owner notification to the corresponding directory node. See §4 for more details.

图 6: Lockify 概览. 新建文件或目录时, 文件系统经扩展 DLM 接口设置 NOTIFY. 向对应锁目录节点发送本节点所有权通知后, 立即取得锁. 详见原文第 4 节.

4.1 本节点所有权通知

Lockify introduces self-owner notification for file and directory creation, leveraging the fact that the DLM does not track the lock owner of non-existent files or directories. Therefore, Lockify notifies the directory node of self-ownership rather than querying it (step 3 in Figure 6). It then returns control to the file system immediately without waiting for a confirmation from the directory node (step 4). This mechanism eliminates DLM overhead by allowing the node creating the file to declare the self-ownership. Meanwhile, upon receiving the notification, the directory node updates the lock-owner table and responds with a confirmation message (step 5). We note that this approach bypasses table lookup overhead, making it more CPU-efficient.

对于尚不存在的文件或目录, DLM 不会记录其锁的所有者. 利用这一点, Lockify 在创建文件或目录时直接通知锁目录节点本节点拥有所有权, 而不先查询, 对应图 6 步骤 3. 随后立即将控制权交还文件系统, 无须等待确认, 即步骤 4. 由创建节点直接声明所有权, 可省去相关 DLM 开销. 锁目录节点收到通知后更新所有者表, 返回确认消息, 即步骤 5. 这一方式还省去了查表操作, 提高 CPU 效率.

4.2 扩展锁获取接口

Lockify is beneficial in scenarios where self-ownership is applicable, particularly when a new lock object is initiated by file or directory creation. For other operations, if the file already exists, its ownership is likely already assigned, which necessitates a lookup to identify the owner. Therefore, the standard lock acquisition steps need to be followed. Nonetheless, the communication latency is relatively small compared to I/O overhead (§3). Since file systems have the necessary context to determine when self-ownership applies, Lockify introduces an extended lock acquisition interface with "NOTIFY" flag. Specifically, by using dlm_lock(..., NOTIFY), a file system can explicitly inform the DLM that the lock request pertains to a newly created object (step 1 in Figure 6). This approach minimizes the required modifications to file systems. Without the NOTIFY flag, Lockify follows the conventional procedure: it sends a request to the directory node, following the standard path in Figure 6, which then searches the lock-owner table to identify the owner node.

Lockify 适用于可由本节点直接声明所有权的情况, 尤其是创建文件或目录时产生新锁对象. 对其他操作, 如果文件已经存在, 其所有者通常已经确定, 仍需查询并遵循标准锁获取流程. 不过, 这类操作的通信延迟相对 I/O 开销较小, 见原文第 3 节. 文件系统具有足够上下文, 可以判断何时适用本节点所有权, 因而 Lockify 扩展锁接口, 增加 NOTIFY 标志. 文件系统调用 dlm_lock(..., NOTIFY), 即可明确告知 DLM 该请求针对新建对象, 对应图 6 步骤 1. 这样只需少量文件系统改动. 未设置 NOTIFY 时, Lockify 沿图 6 的标准路径发送查询, 由锁目录节点查所有者表, 确定所有者节点.

4.3 异步所有权管理

As explained above, Lockify receives an asynchronous confirmation for the notification from the directory node. While effective, Lockify still needs to ensure that the directory node has been updated with the notification to maintain DLM-level consistent lock ownership across clients. To achieve this, Lockify introduces a wait-list, where an entry is inserted for each lock request to track whether a corresponding confirmation message has been received (step 2 in Figure 6). If a confirmation is not received within a specified time due to node or network failures, Lockify resends the notification to the corresponding directory node. Once the confirmation is received, the corresponding wait-list entry is removed (step 5). Note that if another node takes over the role of the directory node (e.g., due to node crash recovery or mount/unmount operations), Lockify can resend any unconfirmed notifications to the new directory node (see §4.4). Furthermore, this design does not compromise file system-level consistency, as demonstrated in §5.4.

锁目录节点对通知的确认异步返回. 但 Lockify 仍须确保该节点已根据通知完成更新, 才能维持各客户端在 DLM 层面的所有权一致性. 为此, 每个锁请求都会在等待列表中插入一项, 跟踪对应确认是否到达, 即图 6 步骤 2. 若因节点或网络故障未在规定时间内收到确认, 就向相应锁目录节点重发通知; 收到后移除等待项, 即步骤 5. 若崩溃恢复, 挂载或卸载导致其他节点接管锁目录角色, 也可向新的锁目录节点重发尚未确认的通知, 见原文第 4.4 节. 这一设计也不会破坏文件系统层面的一致性, 评估见原文第 5.4 节.

4.4 DLM 一致性案例分析

This subsection examines how Lockify maintains DLM-level consistency in crash recovery and lock contention scenarios.

本节分析 Lockify 如何在崩溃恢复与锁竞争场景下保持 DLM 层面的一致性.

Crash recovery. Lockify extends the standard DLM recovery mechanism, where each client transmits ownership information to newly reassigned directory nodes after a crash. During recovery, Lockify also checks its wait-list and resends any unconfirmed self-ownership notifications to the new directory nodes. This design ensures consistency without adding communication overhead beyond that of the standard DLM.

崩溃恢复. 标准 DLM 在故障后由各客户端向重新分配的锁目录节点发送所有权信息. Lockify 扩展了这一机制: 恢复时同时检查等待列表, 将未确认的本节点所有权通知重发给新节点. 这样既保证一致性, 又不会在标准 DLM 之外增加额外通信开销.

Parent directory lock contention. A non-trivial corner case may arise when multiple clients (DLMs) simultaneously send self-owner notifications for the same object name under a shared parent directory. In shared-disk file systems, the parent directory must be exclusively locked before creating any child entity. Accordingly, Lockify assumes this lock is already held when initiating self-ownership. To maintain consistency with standard DLM behavior, Lockify releases the parent directory lock only after both (1) the ownership update and (2) the corresponding file operation (i.e., creating new child files or directories) are complete. The key difference is that Lockify executes these steps concurrently, performing the file operation while the ownership update is still in progress. This design introduces no further communication overhead beyond that of the standard DLM.

父目录锁竞争. 一个需要注意的边界情况是: 多个客户端同时为共享父目录下同名对象发送本节点所有权通知. 共享磁盘文件系统创建子项前, 必须先独占锁住父目录. 因而 Lockify 假定声明本节点所有权时已持有该锁. 为与标准 DLM 保持一致, 只有所有权更新和对应的文件创建操作两者都完成后, 才释放父目录锁. 区别在于 Lockify 让两者并行执行: 所有权尚在更新时即可进行文件操作, 不会在标准 DLM 之外引入额外通信.

5. 评估

We implement Lockify in Linux kernel 6.6.23, on top of the kernel DLM, and evaluate it against the vanilla kernel DLM using OCFS2 and GFS2 file systems with NVMe-over-TCP [10]. We exclude O2CB since the kernel DLM outperforms it with OCFS2 in our evaluation scenarios. We also compare Lockify with NFS [35], which is a widely used shared file system but operates independently of DLM.

我们基于 Linux 6.6.23 内核 DLM 实现 Lockify, 在 NVMe-over-TCP [10] 上使用 OCFS2 和 GFS2, 与未经修改的内核 DLM 比较. 由于此前场景中 OCFS2 配合内核 DLM 已优于 O2CB, 本节不再纳入 O2CB. 我们还比较了广泛使用且不依赖 DLM 的共享文件系统 NFS [35].

脚注 1: 实现见 Lockify, 详见附录 A. 脚注 2: 评估图中用 "DLM" 指代内核 DLM.

5.1 评估配置

Testbed setup. We use a 5-server testbed, as five servers are sufficient to demonstrate our scalability problem. Each server is equipped with dual Intel Xeon Gold 5115 (2.40GHz) CPUs with 20 cores per socket, hyperthreading enabled, 64GB RAM, and a 250GB Samsung 970 EVO Plus NVMe SSD. All servers are connected via 56Gbps links and run Ubuntu 18.04 (kernel 6.6.23). Unless stated otherwise, default system configurations are used.

集群配置. 五台服务器足以展示本文的扩展性问题, 因而使用五节点测试集群. 原文配置为: 每台安装两颗 Intel Xeon Gold 5115 (2.40 GHz), 每插槽 20 核并开启超线程, 64 GB 内存, 250 GB Samsung 970 EVO Plus NVMe SSD. 服务器通过 56 Gbps 链路连接, 运行 Ubuntu 18.04, 内核版本 6.6.23. 除非另行说明, 使用默认系统配置.

Workloads. For microbenchmarks, we use mdtest provided by IOR [5] to evaluate file system metadata performance by creating a tree structure of files and directories. Our mdtest workload generates a total of 35,000 files and directories. To evaluate real-world workloads, we use Postmark [26] and Filebench [2]. Postmark is widely used to measure file system performance under e-mail and web-based service workloads. Our Filebench tests include the fileserver and webproxy workloads, emulating a broader range of real-world usage scenarios.

工作负载. 微基准使用 IOR 的 mdtest [5], 通过创建树状文件和目录结构评估元数据性能, 共生成 35000 个文件和目录. 实际负载使用 Postmark [26] 和 Filebench [2]. Postmark 常用于评估邮件与 Web 服务的文件系统性能; Filebench 选用 fileserver 和 webproxy, 覆盖更广泛的实际使用场景.

5.2 微基准

This section extends the evaluation from §3 by incorporating Lockify, now considering two scenarios: (1) a low-contention scenario, where only one client among multiple clients runs the workload, and (2) a high-contention scenario, where all clients run the same application workload concurrently under a shared parent directory.

本节在原文第 3 节的实验中加入 Lockify, 分两种场景: 低竞争时多个客户端只有一个运行负载; 高竞争时全部客户端同时在共享父目录下运行相同应用负载.

Low-contention scenario. In Figure 7, we compare mdtest throughput between the 1-client and 5-client cases. Similar to Figure 2, the 1-client case represents the ideal scenario, with no communication overhead, as the client acts as both the directory and owner node for every lock object. Consequently, Lockify provides no performance gain in this case. In contrast, the 5-client case shows a significant throughput drop for OCFS2 and GFS2 with the kernel DLM due to high communication latency, as revealed in Figure 3. By eliminating this overhead, Lockify improves OCFS2 throughput by ∼2.9× and GFS2 throughput by ∼6.4×, as shown in Figures 7(a) and 7(b). We also observe that NFS shows distinctly different performance characteristics compared to OCFS2 and GFS2, achieving extremely low throughput. Since NFS follows a client-server model, increasing the number of clients does not impact its performance. However, it consistently shows low throughput, even in the 1-client case, indicating that file system-side overhead is the dominant factor.

低竞争场景. 图 7 比较单客户端与五客户端的 mdtest 吞吐量. 与图 2 一样, 单客户端兼任全部锁对象的锁目录节点及所有者, 没有通信开销, 代表理想情况; Lockify 在此没有额外收益. 五客户端下, 使用内核 DLM 的 OCFS2, GFS2 因通信延迟明显降速, 如图 3 所示. Lockify 消除这一开销后, 两者吞吐量分别达到约 2.9 倍和 6.4 倍, 见图 7(a), (b). NFS 则表现不同, 吞吐量很低. 它采用客户端-服务器模型, 客户端数量增加不影响性能, 但即使单客户端吞吐也低, 表明主导因素在文件系统本身.

Figure 7: Low-contention performance. While Lockify does not provide any performance gain over the kernel DLM in the 1-client case, it significantly improves throughput in the 5-client case by eliminating bottlenecks.

图 7: 低竞争性能. 单客户端下 Lockify 没有额外收益; 五客户端下消除瓶颈, 吞吐明显提高.

High-contention scenario. To evaluate Lockify's effectiveness under high-contention, each of the 5 clients runs the mdtest workload, with all clients creating files and directories under the same parent directory. Unlike in low-contention scenarios, this setup further increases communication overhead due to frequent parent directory lock acquisitions. Since ownership of the parent directory lock is already assigned, Lockify cannot mitigate this overhead. As a result, in Figure 8, we observe that Lockify provides only a minor throughput improvement for OCFS2 (1.09-1.11×). This is because, even though Lockify reduces lock acquisition overhead for new files and directories, the owner identification process for the parent directory remains a major bottleneck.

高竞争场景. 五个客户端分别运行 mdtest, 在同一父目录下创建文件和目录. 频繁获取父目录锁进一步增加通信开销. 由于父目录锁已有所有者, Lockify 无法消除这一开销. 图 8 中 OCFS2 因而仅获得小幅收益, 吞吐量为原来的 1.09-1.11 倍. 新对象的锁获取虽然更快, 父目录所有者的查找仍是主要瓶颈.

On the other hand, Lockify significantly improves GFS2 throughput, achieving 5.2× and 5.4× speedups for directory and file creations, respectively (Figure 8). This improvement is due to GFS2's optimization: GFS2 maintains an internal queue for lock requests and checks for duplicate requests before issuing a new one. Therefore, if clients concurrently request a lock for the same parent directory, communication with the owner node is significantly reduced. At the same time, Lockify continues to minimize lock acquisition overhead for new files and directories.

GFS2 则获得明显收益: 目录和文件创建吞吐量分别达到 5.2 倍与 5.4 倍, 见图 8. 原因在于 GFS2 的优化: 内部维护锁请求队列, 发出新请求前检查重复项. 多个客户端同时请求同一父目录锁时, 与所有者节点的通信因此大幅减少; Lockify 则继续降低新文件和目录的锁获取开销.

Figure 8: High-contention performance. GFS2 implements an optimization that reduces the number of parent directory lock acquisitions, enabling Lockify to further improve throughput via self-owner notifications.

图 8: 高竞争性能. GFS2 通过优化减少父目录锁获取次数, Lockify 再以本节点所有权通知进一步提高吞吐.

Latency overhead. To understand Lockify's throughput gains, we compare DLM-side and file system-side latencies in the low-contention scenario, as shown in Figure 9. We evaluate three configurations: GFS2 (1 client), GFS2 (5 clients), and GFS2 with Lockify (5 clients). Similar to the throughput results, the GFS2 (1-client) case represents the performance upper bound, where DLM latency accounts for only 4.4% of total latency. However, with 5 clients, the DLM latency jumps to 46.7%, leading to a significant drop in overall performance. Lockify reduces this DLM latency to 8%, nearly matching the single-client baseline, leading to a substantial increase in total throughput. This result also indicates that Lockify's wait-list incurs negligible overhead -- comparable to the GFS2 (1-client) case, where no wait-list is maintained. Importantly, this is observed under a stress scenario involving 35,000 file and directory creations, confirming that wait-list maintenance does not introduce measurable penalty. Lastly, we note that the evaluation was conducted without background network traffic. Under network congestion, the kernel DLM's communication latency would likely increase, further degrading its performance. In contrast, Lockify is less sensitive to such congestion, as it can proceed with file system operations while asynchronously awaiting confirmation.

延迟开销. 为解释吞吐收益, 图 9 比较低竞争下 DLM 与文件系统两部分延迟, 包括单客户端 GFS2, 五客户端 GFS2, 五客户端 GFS2 加 Lockify. 单客户端代表性能上限, DLM 只占总延迟 4.4%; 五客户端升至 46.7%, 整体性能明显降低. Lockify 将占比降至 8%, 接近单客户端基线, 吞吐量随之提高. 这也表明等待列表开销可忽略: 性能接近不维护等待列表的单客户端 GFS2. 即使压力场景涉及 35000 次文件和目录创建, 也未测得明显代价. 实验没有后台网络流量. 网络拥塞时, 内核 DLM 通信延迟很可能更高, 性能进一步降低; Lockify 异步等待确认期间仍可执行文件操作, 因而对拥塞不那么敏感.

Figure 9: Latency overhead comparison: DLM vs. File System. Lockify effectively reduces DLM-side latency in the 5-client case, approaching the ideal 1-client scenario.

图 9: DLM 与文件系统延迟占比比较. Lockify 降低五客户端下 DLM 延迟, 接近理想的单客户端情况.

5.3 实际工作负载

This subsection evaluates Lockify using real-world workloads for 1-client and 5-client cases. Following common low-contention scenarios observed in real-world deployments (§1), we configure one active client to run the workload, while the others remain idle.

本节比较实际负载下的单客户端与五客户端. 根据原文第 1 节介绍的常见低竞争部署, 只让一个客户端运行负载, 其余空闲.

Postmark. Our Postmark configuration consists of 500 files, with file sizes ranging from 1KB to 4KB, and a total of 500,000 transactions to simulate a realistic workload. Figure 10(a) presents the throughput of the active client, which aligns with our microbenchmark results (§5.2). In the 5-client case, Lockify improves throughput by 1.7× for OCFS2 and 2.0× for GFS2, compared to the kernel DLM, while achieving 93-96% of the ideal 1-client throughput.

Postmark. 配置 500 个文件, 大小为 1-4 KB, 共执行 500000 个事务. 图 10(a) 的活动客户端吞吐与微基准结果一致, 见原文第 5.2 节. 五客户端下, 相较内核 DLM, Lockify 使 OCFS2 和 GFS2 吞吐分别达到 1.7 倍与 2.0 倍, 相当于理想单客户端吞吐的 93%-96%.

Filebench. Our Filebench configuration incorporates two representative workloads: fileserver and webproxy. The fileserver workload generates 10,000 files within directories, each containing an average of 20 entries. File sizes follow a gamma distribution with a 128KB mean. We use 50 threads, with each I/O operation handling 1MB of data and append operations averaging 16KB. The webproxy workload performs file creation, modification, deletion, as well as reading and logging. Our setup includes 10,000 files distributed across a directory structure with an average width of 1,000,000 and a mean file size of 16KB. We use 100 threads, with a mean I/O size of 16KB and an overall I/O size of 1MB, which are the default settings in Filebench.

Filebench. 采用 fileserver 与 webproxy. fileserver 生成 10000 个文件, 每个目录平均 20 项; 文件大小服从均值 128 KB 的伽马分布. 使用 50 个线程, 每次 I/O 处理 1 MB, 追加操作平均 16 KB. webproxy 包含文件创建, 修改, 删除, 读取和日志写入. 配置 10000 个文件, 目录结构平均宽度为 1000000, 文件平均 16 KB; 使用 100 个线程, 平均 I/O 大小 16 KB, 总 I/O 大小 1 MB, 均采用 Filebench 默认值.

Figure 10(b) presents the fileserver throughput. While this workload primarily consists of file I/Os, where DLM communication overhead is masked by high I/O overhead, the results show that Lockify still achieves 1.07-1.14× throughput improvements over the kernel DLM for OCFS2 and GFS2 in the 5-client case. In contrast, as shown in Figure 10(c), Lockify significantly improves GFS2 throughput by 2.5× compared to the kernel DLM, while its throughput gains on OCFS2 are relatively modest (1.08× improvement), indicating a need for further file system-level optimizations.

图 10(b) 展示 fileserver 吞吐. 这一负载主要执行文件 I/O, 较高的 I/O 开销掩盖了 DLM 通信开销; 即便如此, 五客户端下 Lockify 仍使 OCFS2 和 GFS2 吞吐达到内核 DLM 的 1.07-1.14 倍. webproxy 的结果见图 10(c): GFS2 达到 2.5 倍, OCFS2 仅为 1.08 倍, 表明后者还需要进一步的文件系统层优化.

Figure 10: Performance with real-world workloads. In the 5 client cases, Lockify consistently improves throughput over the kernel DLM, achieving performance comparable to the ideal 1-client throughput.

图 10: 实际工作负载性能. 五客户端下 Lockify 持续优于内核 DLM, 接近理想单客户端吞吐.

5.4 崩溃一致性测试

Xfstests [12] is a file system testing suite used to evaluate stability and compliance. Following the approach in [13, 15, 27], we conduct 75 generic tests suggested for NFS [11] on GFS2 and OCFS2, using both the kernel DLM and Lockify. Our results show that GFS2 with DLM passes 70 out of 75 tests, while GFS2 with Lockify achieves the same results. Similarly, OCFS2 produces identical results for both DLM and Lockify, passing 67 out of 75 tests. These results confirm that Lockify's integration does not negatively impact compliance with shared-disk file system standards.

Xfstests [12] 用于评估文件系统稳定性与符合性. 参考已有研究 [13, 15, 27], 我们在 GFS2 和 OCFS2 上分别使用内核 DLM 与 Lockify, 执行建议用于 NFS 的 75 项通用测试 [11]. GFS2 加内核 DLM 通过 70 项, 换成 Lockify 结果相同; OCFS2 两种方案均通过 67 项. 结果表明, 在这些测试范围内, 接入 Lockify 未损害共享磁盘文件系统的符合性.

5.5 与基于 RDMA 的 DLM 比较

Finally, this subsection presents an indirect comparison using an emulated RDMA-based DLM with NVMe-over-RDMA [9]. Since an RDMA-based kernel DLM implementation is currently unavailable, we emulate it by running the kernel DLM in a single-client scenario with no communication latency, assuming RDMA latency remains below 1µs in low-contention scenarios [31]. In addition, storage is connected via NVMe-over-RDMA to ensure a fair comparison between TCP- and RDMA-based solutions. The goal of this indirect comparison is to evaluate how well Lockify bridges the performance gap with recent hardware-assisted solutions [16, 21, 39, 42], even though Lockify is primarily designed for cluster environments where TCP is the only available option for network communication.

最后通过模拟基于 RDMA 的 DLM, 配合 NVMe-over-RDMA [9] 进行间接比较. 当时尚无可用的 RDMA 内核 DLM 实现, 因而在单客户端下运行内核 DLM, 以无通信延迟近似模拟, 假定低竞争时 RDMA 延迟小于 1 μs [31]. 存储也经 NVMe-over-RDMA 连接, 公平比较 TCP 与 RDMA 方案. Lockify 主要面向只能使用 TCP 通信的集群, 这一间接比较旨在评估它能在多大程度上缩小与近期硬件辅助方案 [16, 21, 39, 42] 的差距.

We repeat the low-contention scenario from Figure 7 using mdtest, which involves creating a large number of directories and files, and compare Lockify (5-client case) with the emulated RDMA-based DLM (DLM over RDMA) on both OCFS2 and GFS2, as shown in Figure 11. Overall, Lockify achieves 87-88% of DLM-over-RDMA throughput across all results, demonstrating that Lockify delivers performance comparable to an RDMA-based solution, without specialized hardware support.

我们用 mdtest 重复图 7 的低竞争实验, 大量创建目录与文件, 在 OCFS2, GFS2 上比较五客户端 Lockify 与模拟的 RDMA DLM, 如图 11. Lockify 吞吐达到 DLM-over-RDMA 的 87%-88%, 表明无须专门硬件也能接近该模拟方案的性能.

Figure 11: Comparison with RDMA-based DLM. The results show that Lockify achieves performance comparable to the RDMA-based DLM.

图 11: 与基于 RDMA 的 DLM 比较. Lockify 的性能接近该模拟方案.

6. 结论

This paper presents Lockify, a novel DLM for shared-disk file systems. Based on the observation that existing DLMs suffer from high lock acquisition overhead even in low-contention scenarios, Lockify minimizes lock acquisition latency by avoiding unnecessary communication with remote nodes. The evaluation results from our Linux kernel implementation show that Lockify improves overall throughput by ∼6.4× compared to existing DLMs across microbenchmarks and real-world workloads, while achieving performance comparable to an RDMA-based solution.

本文提出面向共享磁盘文件系统的 Lockify. 现有 DLM 即使在低竞争时也存在较高锁获取开销, Lockify 通过省去与远端节点不必要的通信来降低延迟. Linux 内核实现的微基准与实际负载评估表明, 相较现有 DLM, 吞吐量可达到约 6.4 倍, 并接近基于 RDMA 的模拟方案.
