This artifact has the following requirements:

材料需要满足以下条件.

Linux kernel 6.6.23: The artifact relies on Linux kernel version 6.6.23. Applying it to other kernel versions may require additional porting effort.

Linux 6.6.23: 实现依赖这一内核版本, 应用于其他版本可能需要额外移植工作.

Shared storage: All nodes must have access to a shared storage device over the network, such as via NVMe-over-TCP, iSCSI, or other similar protocols.

共享存储: 所有节点必须能通过网络访问同一共享存储设备, 可使用 NVMe-over-TCP, iSCSI 或类似协议.

Multi-node setup: To evaluate Lockify's effectiveness, at least two network-connected nodes are required. A single-node setup does not reproduce the scalability issues discussed in the paper, such as Figure 4, and thus cannot demonstrate the benefits of Lockify.

多节点环境: 至少需要两个联网节点才能评估效果. 单节点无法复现图 4 等扩展性问题, 因而不能体现 Lockify 的收益.

entry.title: 译 - Rearchitecting Buffered I/O in the Era of High-Bandwidth SSDs
entry.content:
原论文 Rearchitecting Buffered I/O in the Era of High-Bandwidth SSDs 发表于 FAST 2026 (第 24 届 USENIX 文件与存储技术会议), 中文题名为 "高带宽 SSD 时代的缓冲 I/O 架构重设计".

传统缓冲 I/O 把所有写入都放进页缓存, 在高带宽 SSD 上容易受页管理开销和非整页写入的先读后写影响. WSBuffer 重新安排写入路径, 保留页缓存的读取优势:

最小化写缓冲

  • 片段缓冲区只接住小写入和大写入中未对齐的部分; 较大且对齐的部分直接写入 SSD.

刷出与并发

  • 机会式两阶段刷出和并发页管理减少脏数据写回时的阻塞, 避免写缓冲成为新的瓶颈.

实验结果

  • 在论文评估的文件系统和缓冲 I/O 方案中, WSBuffer 吞吐量最高达到对照的 3.91 倍, 延迟最低降至对照的 1/82.80.

WSBuffer 研究高带宽 SSD 时代的缓冲 I/O 写入路径. 传统页缓存会缓冲所有写入, 即使较大且已经对齐的数据可以直接送往设备; 页管理并发能力有限, 非整页写入还可能触发昂贵的先读后写. 这篇 FAST 2026 论文提出写入片段缓冲, 只缓存小写入和大写入中未对齐的部分, 把较大且对齐的部分直接写入 SSD, 同时保留页缓存对读取的帮助. 为避免新的缓冲结构成为瓶颈, WSBuffer 还设计机会式两阶段脏数据刷出和并发页管理机制, 控制写回过程中的等待与资源占用. 论文解释片段缓冲区与传统完整内存页的区别, 给出数据路径和刷出算法, 并与 EXT4, F2FS, BTRFS, XFS 及 ScaleCache 等方案比较. 在其测试负载下, 吞吐量最高达到对照的 3.91 倍, 延迟最低降至对照的 1/82.80. 这些极值来自论文特定实验配置, 不代表每一种文件访问都能取得相同改善. 小写入和未对齐片段仍留在内存缓冲区, 以避免直接写入设备时形成大量低效的小 I/O; 这正是它与完全绕过页缓存的方案不同的地方.

scrap buffer 译为片段缓冲区, scrap-page 译为片段页, 与传统页缓存的完整内存页区分. 实验结论以论文环境为准; 延迟改善倍数表示对照延迟与 WSBuffer 延迟之比.

0. 摘要

Buffered I/O via page cache has been prevalently used by applications for decades due to its user-friendliness and high performance. However, the existing buffered I/O architecture fails to effectively utilize high-bandwidth Solid-State Drives (SSDs) caused by 1) costly page caching overused for buffering all incoming writes in the critical path, 2) the limited concurrency of page management, and 3) the high read-before-write penalty for partial-page writes.

基于页缓存的缓冲 I/O 易于使用且性能较高, 数十年来一直被应用广泛采用. 然而, 现有架构难以充分利用高带宽 SSD, 原因有三: 1) 写入关键路径上过度使用开销较大的页缓存, 缓冲所有写入; 2) 页管理并发能力有限; 3) 非整页写入需要付出较高的先读后写代价.

This paper rearchitects buffered I/O and proposes a write-scrap buffering approach (WSBuffer) to remove the aforementioned shackles of buffered I/O on writes to proactively exploit fast SSDs while retaining all the advantages of buffered I/O on reads. WSBuffer first presents a novel memory-page buffering structure, scrap buffer, to efficiently buffer SSD-I/O unfriendly writes and expensive partial-page writes. WSBuffer further proposes a buffer-minimized data access mechanism to partially buffer small and unaligned parts of user writes via the scrap buffer while directly sending large and aligned parts to underlying SSDs. Finally, WSBuffer devises an opportunistic two-stage dirty-data flushing mechanism and a concurrent page management mechanism to achieve fluent and fast dirty-data flushing. The experimental results show that WSBuffer outperforms Linux file systems of EXT4, F2FS, BTRFS and XFS, as well as the state-of-the-art buffered I/O optimization of ScaleCache by up to 3.91× and 82.80× in throughput and latency respectively.

本文重新设计缓冲 I/O, 提出写入片段缓冲方案 WSBuffer, 在保留读取优势的同时消除上述写入限制, 主动利用高速 SSD. 首先, WSBuffer 引入新的内存页缓冲结构 scrap buffer, 高效缓冲不适合直接交给 SSD 的写入和代价较高的非整页写入. 随后, 它采用最小化缓冲的数据访问机制, 仅缓冲小写入以及大写入中未对齐的部分, 将较大且对齐的部分直接送往 SSD. 最后, 通过机会式两阶段脏数据刷出机制和并发页管理机制, 实现顺畅, 快速的脏数据写回. 实验表明, 相较 Linux 文件系统 EXT4, F2FS, BTRFS, XFS 以及先进的缓冲 I/O 优化方案 ScaleCache, WSBuffer 吞吐量最高达到 3.91 倍, 延迟最多降至对照的 1/82.80.

1. 引言

For decades, the buffered mode of I/O operations via page cache has been the most popular approach to bridge the performance gap between main memory and storage devices in a user-friendly and transparent manner, making it the preferred choice for the majority of applications. The performance of buffered I/O is primarily derived from the in-kernel page cache. Page cache has been an indispensable component of modern storage stack to fast respond to application reads/writes while shielding the application from the much slower storage I/Os whose latency and bandwidth are typically several orders of magnitude worse than the main memory.

数十年来, 通过页缓存执行缓冲 I/O 一直是透明, 易用地弥合内存与存储性能差距的主要方法, 因而成为多数应用的首选. 其性能主要来自内核页缓存. 页缓存快速响应应用读写, 遮蔽底层较慢的存储 I/O; 传统存储的延迟和带宽通常比主存差数个数量级, 使页缓存成为现代存储栈不可缺少的组成部分.

With rapid development of Solid-State Drives (SSDs), especially for NVMe-based SSDs, the bandwidth gap between memory and storage has been narrowing. In the high-bandwidth storage era, direct I/O has been receiving increasing attention [15, 21, 46, 73], because it bypasses page cache and transfers data between user buffers and storage devices directly. However, utilizing direct I/O necessitates adherence to its strict data alignment requirements for user requests, which complicates programming. Moreover, the access latency of SSDs is still far higher than that of memory. Therefore, the popularity of buffered I/O remains strong in storage systems.

随着 SSD, 尤其 NVMe SSD 的发展, 内存与存储的带宽差距不断缩小. 直接 I/O 绕过页缓存, 在用户缓冲区与设备之间传输数据, 因而受到更多关注 [15, 21, 46, 73]. 但它要求用户请求严格对齐, 增加了编程难度. 同时, SSD 访问延迟仍远高于内存. 因此缓冲 I/O 在存储系统中依旧广泛使用.

However, this work reveals that buffered I/O writes, particularly intensive writes, fall far short of reaching the performance potentials offered by high-bandwidth SSDs due to 1) costly page caching overused for buffering all incoming writes, 2) limited concurrency of page management operations causing memory-inefficiency, and 3) high read-before-write penalty for partial-page writes (§ 2.3).

本文发现, 缓冲 I/O 的写入, 尤其高强度写入, 远未发挥高带宽 SSD 的潜力. 原因包括缓冲全部写入的页缓存开销, 页管理并发不足导致的内存利用低效, 以及非整页写入较高的先读后写代价, 详见原文第 2.3 节.

Prior studies have also reported that page cache becomes a performance bottleneck of data-intensive applications running on fast SSDs [38, 45, 46, 73]. Existing solutions approach the problem largely from two angles: optimizing page cache [5, 38, 45], and bypassing page cache partially or completely [21, 27, 46, 60, 71, 73]. The former improves page cache to enhance buffered I/O performance. However, the conventional buffered I/O architecture, which puts the buffer in the write critical path to buffer all writes, severely hinders the effective exploitation of the high bandwidth of modern SSDs. The latter partially or completely abandons the advantages of buffered I/O to bypass page cache, thus requiring additional program modifications and maintenance, especially for legacy codes.

已有研究也指出, 在高速 SSD 上运行的数据密集型应用中, 页缓存已成为瓶颈 [38, 45, 46, 73]. 解决方法主要分为优化页缓存 [5, 38, 45] 与部分或完全绕过页缓存 [21, 27, 46, 60, 71, 73]. 前者改善缓冲 I/O, 但传统架构仍在关键路径缓冲全部写入, 限制了高带宽 SSD 的利用. 后者为绕过页缓存而放弃部分或全部缓冲 I/O 优势, 需要额外改造和维护应用, 对遗留代码尤其不便.

To break through performance constraints of buffered I/O in face of high-bandwidth SSDs, this paper proposes to rearchitect buffered I/O by introducing a write-scrap buffering (WSBuffer) to significantly enhance buffered I/O. First, WSBuffer presents a novel write buffering structure, scrap buffer, to take over the write buffer handling from page cache and achieve efficient partial-page writes (§ 3.2). Second, WSBuffer proposes a buffer-minimized data access mechanism (§ 3.3) to partially buffer user writes via the scrap buffer and directly send SSD-friendly large and aligned parts of writes to SSDs to proactively and effectively leverage their high bandwidth and save memory used for writes, while ensuring the data consistency between scrap buffer, page cache, and SSDs. Finally, WSBuffer devises an opportunistic two-stage dirty-data flushing mechanism (OTflush) (§ 3.4) and a concurrent page management mechanism (§ 3.5) to achieve fluent dirty-data flushing and minimize the blockage under intensive writes, while further exploiting SSD bandwidth. In addition, WSBuffer enables page cache to focus on its strengths in serving reads, thus retaining buffered I/O's high efficiency for reads. Furthermore, the memory saved by WSBuffer can be used by page cache to further accelerate reads.

为突破这些限制, 本文提出 WSBuffer, 重新设计缓冲 I/O. 首先用 scrap buffer 接管页缓存的写缓冲职责, 高效支持非整页写入, 见原文第 3.2 节. 然后通过最小化缓冲的数据访问机制, 只缓冲部分用户写入, 将适合 SSD 的较大且对齐部分直接发送到设备, 节省写入内存, 同时保持 scrap buffer, 页缓存与 SSD 之间的数据一致性, 见原文第 3.3 节. 最后, 机会式两阶段刷出 OTflush 与并发页管理机制使脏数据顺畅写回, 减少高强度写入阻塞并进一步利用 SSD 带宽, 见原文第 3.4, 3.5 节. 页缓存则专注于擅长的读取, 保留其优化优势, 还可使用写入节省下来的内存进一步加速读取.

We implement the WSBuffer architecture based on XFS under Linux kernel 6.8, and evaluate it under a variety of workloads. The experimental results show that, compared to representative file systems (EXT4 [8], F2FS [34], BTRFS [50] and XFS [58]) and the state-of-the-art buffered I/O optimization (ScaleCache [45]), WSBuffer gains up to 3.91× and 82.80× improvements in throughput and latency respectively.

我们基于 Linux 6.8 的 XFS 实现 WSBuffer, 并测试多种负载. 相较 EXT4 [8], F2FS [34], BTRFS [50], XFS [58] 和 ScaleCache [45], 吞吐量最高达到 3.91 倍, 延迟最多降至对照的 1/82.80.

The major contributions of this work are:

本文的主要贡献包括:

We experimentally analyze the root causes of poor write performance of buffered I/O on high-bandwidth SSDs.

通过实验分析高带宽 SSD 上缓冲 I/O 写入性能不足的根因.

We propose the WSBuffer architecture and present several novel enabling techniques to enhance buffered I/O.

提出 WSBuffer 架构及其配套技术, 改善缓冲 I/O.

We implement a WSBuffer prototype in Linux kernel and evaluate it against representative file systems and the state-of-the-art buffered I/O optimization under a variety of workloads and real-world applications.

在 Linux 内核实现原型, 使用多种负载和真实应用, 与代表性文件系统及先进的缓冲 I/O 优化方案比较.

2. 背景与动机

2.1 高带宽 SSD

In recent years, the bandwidth of NVMe SSDs continues to expand exponentially, due to increasingly scalable I/O parallelism among multiple channels, chips and dies within an SSD. Specifically, from the PCIe3.0 era to the current PCIe5.0 era, the write bandwidth of SSDs has increased from less than 3GB/s to over 10GB/s, and their read bandwidth follows the trend closely [52, 61]. It is reasonable to anticipate that the bandwidth of PCIe6.0 SSDs will further double. How to improve the software stack to adapt to increasingly higher-bandwidth SSDs has become a crucial research topic, especially for general operating system kernels.

SSD 内部多通道, 多芯片和多 die 的并行能力持续增强, 推动 NVMe SSD 带宽快速增长. 从 PCIe 3.0 到论文所处的 PCIe 5.0 时代, 写带宽从不足 3 GB/s 增长到超过 10 GB/s, 读带宽也同步提升 [52, 61]. 可以预期 PCIe 6.0 SSD 带宽还将翻倍. 如何改进软件栈以适应更高带宽, 尤其如何改进通用操作系统内核, 已成为重要研究问题.

2.2 缓冲 I/O 与直接 I/O

As the default mode of I/O operations offered by most operating systems, buffered I/O leverages the in-kernel page cache to effectively absorb user reads/writes while internally merging data, handling I/O alignment, prefetching pages, and flushing dirty pages to the underlying disks. Buffered I/O supports file access requests with diverse offsets and sizes without considering the I/O size and alignment constraints of the underlying storage devices.

缓冲 I/O 是多数操作系统的默认模式. 内核页缓存吸收用户读写, 内部负责数据合并, I/O 对齐, 页预取和脏页写回. 应用可使用不同偏移与大小访问文件, 无须考虑底层设备的请求大小和对齐约束.

With continuous advancement of SSDs, the bandwidth gap between memory and fast SSD has gradually narrowed to within one order of magnitude, in contrast to the two to three orders of magnitudes of difference between memory and older generations of SATA SSDs and HDDs. Deploying multiple SSDs can further increase the aggregated bandwidth. To effectively exploit the high bandwidth of SSDs, some customized systems [12, 15, 21, 46] adopt direct I/O, which bypasses page cache and transfers data between user buffers and storage devices directly. For example, the DeepSeek's fire-flyer file system (3FS) instance [15] includes 180 storage nodes, each equipped with 16 NVMe SSDs, achieving 6.6TB/s aggregate throughput via direct I/O.

高速 SSD 与内存的带宽差距已缩小到一个数量级以内, 而早期 SATA SSD 和 HDD 与内存相差两到三个数量级. 多 SSD 还能进一步提高总带宽. 为充分利用带宽, 一些定制系统 [12, 15, 21, 46] 使用直接 I/O, 绕过页缓存, 在用户缓冲区和设备之间直接传输. 例如 DeepSeek 的 3FS 实例 [15] 包含 180 个存储节点, 每节点 16 块 NVMe SSD, 通过直接 I/O 达到 6.6 TB/s 总吞吐量.

However, using direct I/O imposes strict alignment constraints on the request's offset, size, and user-buffer address. Furthermore, the access latency of the memory is still far lower than that of SSDs. Many page cache optimizations through long-term development and iteration [24, 25, 39, 53, 62] have been integrated into buffered I/O to accelerate user accesses. In particularly, the folio module [14, 63] of Linux kernel improves page management efficiency, e.g., supporting batch page allocation, which is particularly friendly to reads. Therefore, buffered I/O with attractive user-friendliness and performance is still dominant in applications in the era of high-bandwidth SSDs.

但直接 I/O 对请求偏移, 大小和用户缓冲区地址都有严格对齐要求, 内存访问延迟也仍远低于 SSD. 多年积累的页缓存优化 [24, 25, 39, 53, 62] 已集成进缓冲 I/O. 例如 Linux folio [14, 63] 支持批量页分配, 改善页管理效率, 尤其有利于读取. 因此, 缓冲 I/O 凭借易用性和性能, 在高带宽 SSD 时代仍占主导地位.

2.3 缓冲 I/O 的写入性能

Compared to the well-optimized read process, the write process of buffered I/O is significantly more complex. In this section, we comprehensively and experimentally analyze the write performance of buffered I/O on high-bandwidth SSDs.

相较优化充分的读取路径, 缓冲 I/O 写入更复杂. 本节通过实验分析其在高带宽 SSD 上的表现.

2.3.1 最大写带宽受限

We first assess the maximum write throughput of buffered I/O and direct I/O in ideal case. We use FIO [4] to perform sequential 2MB-sized writes via buffered I/O and direct I/O with unlimited memory. We also disable background page flushing for buffered I/O to avoid its potential interference with foreground writes. As shown in Figure 1, the bandwidth of direct I/O outperforms that of buffered I/O via page cache in all cases (1.10×-4.46×). This result reveals that the bandwidth advantage of the memory over SSDs is insufficient to offset, much less overshadow, the cost of page cache management, such as page allocation, looking up, page state maintenance, and LRU list management for aging and reclaiming. The management cost of page cache generally was ignored in the slow-storage era. Nowadays, the storage bandwidth continues to scale by increasing both the inter-SSD and intra-SSD I/O parallelism. Therefore, overused page cache becomes the write bottleneck of buffered I/O on high-bandwidth SSDs.

首先测量理想条件下的最大写吞吐量. 使用 FIO [4] 执行 2 MB 顺序写, 提供充足内存, 并关闭缓冲 I/O 后台刷页以避免干扰. 图 1 中, 直接 I/O 带宽在所有情况下均为缓冲 I/O 的 1.10-4.46 倍. 这说明内存带宽优势已不足以抵消页分配, 查找, 状态维护和用于老化回收的 LRU 管理开销. 慢存储时代这些开销常被忽略, 但随着设备内外并行能力提升, 过度使用页缓存已成为写瓶颈.

Overall, the write bandwidth of buffered I/O via page cache is limited and unable to directly scale with the rising storage performance due to the full buffering design that puts buffered I/O on the write critical path. Direct I/O bypasses page cache and effectively unleashes the full bandwidth of the underlying storage. However, direct I/O demands strict alignment among the IO size, offset, and memory-buffer address [1, 46, 73].

全量缓冲将缓冲过程置于写入关键路径, 使写带宽无法随存储性能增长而扩展. 直接 I/O 可绕过页缓存释放底层带宽, 但必须满足请求大小, 偏移和内存地址的严格对齐要求 [1, 46, 73].

Figure 1: Maximum performance of direct I/O via a RAID0 array with 8 PCIe4.0 SSDs [51] (about 55GB/s total bandwidth) and buffered I/O via 8 DDR4 DRAM (about 200GB/s total bandwidth) under different thread counts.

图 1: 不同线程数下的最大性能: 直接 I/O 使用八块 PCIe 4.0 SSD [51] 组成的 RAID0, 总带宽约 55 GB/s; 缓冲 I/O 使用八条 DDR4 DRAM, 总带宽约 200 GB/s.

2.3.2 高强度写入依赖大量内存

Page cache first buffers user writes to dirty pages, and then strategically flushes them into the underlying storage and finally reclaims clean pages. To better understand the performance behavior of buffered I/O with page flushing, we use FIO to perform full-page 4KB-sized writes under different memory capacity limits and enabling page flushing at the beginning (i.e., setting dirty_background_ratio to 0). We use 16 user threads to represent a write-intensive scenario and let each thread exclusively access a dedicated file to avoid lock contention caused by concurrent file accesses [42]. Figure 2 shows that, except for BTRFS, which is limited by its own concurrency issues [41, 50], the write throughput of file systems via buffered I/O is highly dependent on the memory utilizations, despite enabling page flushing throughout the entire process. In particular, the write throughput of the case with supplied memory being 70% amount of written data is significantly lower than that of the 100% case by up to 54.0%. This indicates that buffered I/O needs a large amount of memory to sustain a high write throughput even on high-bandwidth SSDs.

页缓存先将写入保存为脏页, 再按策略写回底层, 最后回收干净页. 我们用 FIO 在不同内存限制下执行整页 4 KB 写入, 从开始就启用刷页, 即 dirty_background_ratio=0. 使用 16 个线程模拟高强度写入, 每线程独占一个文件, 避免同文件并发锁竞争 [42]. 图 2 中, 除受自身并发限制的 BTRFS [41, 50] 外, 各文件系统吞吐量都高度依赖内存供给. 内存为写入量的 70% 时, 吞吐量相较 100% 情况最多下降 54.0%. 即使高速 SSD 存在, 缓冲 I/O 仍需要大量内存维持高写吞吐量.

We further find that, the high memory dependency of buffered I/O's write process with flushing is mainly caused by severe lock contention of page management between concurrent free page insertions, clean page deletions, and page-state maintenance. The high-intensive writes under limited memory fast use up the available memory and lead to frequent page replacements, where the XArray of page cache [45] is frequently updated (e.g., free page insert and clean page delete). To avoid conflicts between multiple XArray updates, the non-scalable spinlock of XArray (i.e., xa_lock) [38] limits the concurrency of tree updates. Meanwhile, each tree node of XArray maintains tag fields to mark whether the corresponding subtree contains any dirty pages or pages under flushing [64]. Due to the demand of acquiring the XArray spinlock for any page-state update (i.e., modifying tag fields), the page flushing process for each dirty page necessitates multiple acquisitions of the XArray spinlock, i.e., transitioning the tag field from dirty to writeback, and finally to clean, which further exacerbates the lock contention. Simply introducing multiple flushers cannot address this issue, because the root cause of this issue lies in the non-scalable lock mechanism, which hinders page-level concurrent updates.

其主要原因是空闲页插入, 干净页删除与页状态维护之间的锁竞争. 内存受限时, 高频写入迅速耗尽可用空间, 导致频繁页替换和页缓存 XArray 更新 [45]. 为避免树更新冲突, XArray 使用扩展性有限的自旋锁 xa_lock [38]. 此外, 节点标签记录子树中是否存在脏页或正在刷出的页 [64], 每次状态变更也要获取该锁. 一次脏页刷出从 dirty 到 writeback 再到 clean, 会多次竞争同一自旋锁. 因而简单增加刷页线程并不能解决问题, 根因在于这一锁机制限制了页级并发更新.

Overall, buffered I/O under high-intensity writes degrades the overall throughput of the foreground write process and the background flush process due to limited concurrency of page management, and freezes a large amount of memory.

总体而言, 页管理并发不足同时降低前台写入与后台刷出吞吐量, 并使大量内存迟迟无法释放.

Figure 2: The write throughput of file systems via buffered I/O under different memory supplies (i.e., the ratio of available memory capacity to the amount of written data). Page flushing is enabled throughout the entire process.

图 2: 不同内存供给比例下的缓冲 I/O 写吞吐量. 比例为可用内存与写入数据量之比, 全程启用刷页.

2.3.3 非整页写入代价高昂

Applications send write requests with diverse offsets and sizes to file systems. File systems via buffered I/O can transparently utilize page cache to handle these writes. However, for a partial page write missed in page cache, page cache first triggers a page fault to perform a slow SSD-read to fill this page, i.e., a read-before-write [36], and then updates it.

应用写请求具有不同偏移与大小, 缓冲 I/O 可透明处理. 但非整页写若未命中页缓存, 必须先触发缺页, 从 SSD 读取整页, 再更新所需部分, 即先读后写 [36].

To better understand the penalty of such partial-page writes, we use FIO (thread=1, ioengine=psync and with sufficient memory) to compare the latencies of full-page writes and partial-page writes under four representative file systems via buffered I/O. Figure 3 shows that the latency of the partial-page writes is 1.51×-84.37× that of the corresponding full-page writes. The additional penalty of partial-page writes is significant, even for large writes, and it is almost entirely attributed to the slow SSD-reads. This is because, despite modern SSDs being capable of providing sufficiently high bandwidth, they still exhibit long access latencies, especially for small accesses, which cannot benefit from the internal parallelism of SSDs.

我们使用单线程 FIO, ioengine=psync, 提供充足内存, 比较四种文件系统的整页和非整页写延迟. 图 3 中后者为前者的 1.51-84.37 倍. 即使请求较大, 额外代价仍明显, 且几乎全部来自慢速 SSD 读取. 现代 SSD 虽带宽高, 访问延迟仍长, 小请求尤其难以利用内部并行能力.

Overall, for common partial-page writes missed in page cache, buffered I/O suffers from prohibitively expensive read-before-write processes. Its efficiency relies on the small-access performance of SSDs, which is not SSD's forte.

因此, 常见的未命中非整页写会遭遇昂贵的先读后写, 其效率依赖 SSD 并不擅长的小请求性能.

Figure 3: Full-page writes vs. partial-page writes.

图 3: 整页与非整页写入比较.

2.4 动机与目标

Our experiments and analyses reveal that buffered I/O's write process cannot effectively exploit the performance potentials of high-bandwidth SSDs due to page caching with three main challenges: C1 costly page caching overused for buffering all incoming writes, C2 limited concurrency of page management causing memory-inefficiency, and C3 high read-before-write penalty for partial-page writes.

实验揭示三个挑战: C1, 全量缓冲带来的高页缓存开销; C2, 页管理并发不足导致内存利用低效; C3, 非整页写的先读后写代价高. 它们使缓冲 I/O 无法发挥高带宽 SSD 的潜力.

Prior studies have also reported that page cache has become a performance bottleneck of data-intensive applications running on fast SSDs [38, 45, 46, 73]. Existing solutions can be roughly grouped into two categories: optimizing page cache, and bypassing page cache partially or completely.

已有研究也发现页缓存是高速 SSD 数据密集应用的瓶颈 [38, 45, 46, 73]. 现有方法大致分为优化页缓存和部分或完全绕过页缓存.

Optimizing page cache. ScaleCache [45] proposes a concurrent data structure (ccXArray) for page management to perform page indexing, updating, and flushing in a higher parallelism. StreamCache [38] improves page management efficiency and concurrency for high-intensity file scanning, including page-state maintenance, page reclaiming, and page allocation. Uncached buffered I/O [5] reclaims the touchedranges memory-pages immediately after the access operation is completed while performing dirty-page flushing and subsequent reclaiming immediately after page writing. Uncached buffered I/O urgently reclaims memory to mitigate the pressure of page cache. Overall, these efforts effectively enhance the performance of page cache but with a limited potential due to the narrowing bandwidth gap between main memory and fast storage. More importantly, the existing full buffering architecture of buffered I/O overuses page cache on the write critical path, which causes the high bandwidth of modern SSDs to be underutilized (C1).

优化页缓存. ScaleCache [45] 用并发结构 ccXArray 提高索引, 更新和刷出并行度. StreamCache [38] 优化高强度文件扫描中的页状态维护, 回收与分配. Uncached buffered I/O [5] 在访问完成后立即回收相关页, 写入后立即刷出再回收, 尽快释放内存以缓解压力. 这些方案有效改善页缓存, 但受内存与存储带宽差距缩小的限制. 更重要的是, 全量缓冲仍把页缓存放在写入关键路径, 使 SSD 高带宽未被充分利用, 即 C1.

Bypassing page cache partially or completely. Some works introduce hybrid modes of I/O operations in which runtime decisions are made to strategically switch between buffered I/O and direct I/O. BeeGFS [7] supports switching between buffered I/O and direct I/O based on a fixed threshold value. Lustre AutoIO [46] makes its switching decision dynamically based on the I/O size, file lock contention, and memory constraints. They effectively combine the advantages of both buffered I/O and direct I/O to partially bypass page cache. Furthermore, some works outright abandon buffered I/O for writes to completely bypass page cache. Userspace OrchFS [73] utilizes non-volatile memory (NVM) via memorysemantic data-path to handle unaligned writes and processes SSD-page aligned writes via direct I/O only. Some userspace I/O engines [27, 60, 71], such as SPDK [71], further bypass the entire kernel to handle I/Os, thereby significantly reducing software overhead. Overall, these efforts partially or completely abandon the advantages of buffered I/O to bypass page cache, while incurring the cost of additional program modifications and maintenance. Therefore, these solutions potentially sacrifice applicability and portability, because buffered I/O has been extensively employed in a multitude of various applications and legacy codes.

部分或完全绕过页缓存. 一些混合 I/O 方案在运行时选择缓冲或直接 I/O. BeeGFS [7] 使用固定阈值, Lustre AutoIO [46] 则综合请求大小, 文件锁竞争与内存限制动态决策. 它们结合两种模式的优点, 部分绕过缓存. 另一些工作完全放弃写缓冲: 用户态 OrchFS [73] 用 NVM 内存语义路径处理未对齐写, 对齐 SSD 页的写入走直接 I/O; SPDK [71] 等用户态引擎 [27, 60, 71] 甚至绕过整个内核以减少软件开销. 但这些方案放弃部分或全部缓冲 I/O 优势, 需要修改和维护应用, 因而可能损害适用性与可移植性, 尤其面对广泛使用缓冲 I/O 的现有应用和遗留代码.

Design goals. Our experimental observations and analysis, along with and the weaknesses and problems of existing solutions, motivate us to rethink whether and how buffered I/O fully exploits SSD bandwidth and overcomes the three challenges of buffered I/O in its write process while retaining the benefits in its read process. Therefore, we propose a write-scrap buffering (WSBuffer) to rearchitect buffered I/O to achieve the following design goals (Gs).

设计目标. 实验与现有方案的不足促使我们重新思考: 如何保留缓冲读取优势, 同时充分利用 SSD 带宽并克服三个写入挑战? 为此提出 WSBuffer, 目标如下.

Minimizing buffered user-writes (G1). The maximum write performance of buffered I/O is actually constrained by the complex page cache management, and cannot scale with the increasing aggregate bandwidth of SSDs. Moreover, a large number of buffered pages further increase the memory footprint, page management overhead, and potential lock contention. Therefore, WSBuffer should strategically partially buffer user writes and directly access the underlying SSDs for user-writes as much as possible, thereby minimizing buffered data while benefiting from the high bandwidth of SSDs, to fundamentally overcome C1 and indirectly alleviate C2.

最小化用户写入缓冲 (G1). 最大写性能受复杂页管理限制, 无法随 SSD 总带宽提高而增长; 大量缓冲页还增加内存占用, 管理开销和锁竞争. WSBuffer 应仅缓冲必要部分, 尽量将写入直接交给 SSD, 从根本上克服 C1, 并间接缓解 C2.

Fluent dirty-data flushing (G2). Limited concurrency of the foreground write process, background flush process, and page reclaiming can lead to intermittent and slow dirty-data flushing and a large number of dirty pages stagnating in memory, which further blocks foreground user-writes and encroaches caching capacity for reads, especially under memory pressure. Therefore, WSBuffer should achieve fluent dirty-data flushing to overcome C2, remove this write blocking, and reclaim memory used for writes quickly.

顺畅刷出脏数据 (G2). 前台写入, 后台刷出与回收并发不足, 会导致刷出缓慢且时断时续, 大量脏页滞留内存, 阻塞新写入并挤占读缓存, 内存压力下尤其严重. WSBuffer 应顺畅刷出以克服 C2, 减少阻塞并快速回收写入内存.

Efficient partial-page writes (G3). Legacy buffered I/O supports any-pattern user accesses but must trigger slow read-before-write processes to fill pages before performing common and ubiquitous partial-page writes. Simply removing the read-before-write process to accelerate partial-page writes would significantly complicate page-data management and page flushing. Therefore, WSBuffer should overcome the penalty of read-before-write processes while maintaining efficient page-data management to address C3.

高效处理非整页写入 (G3). 传统缓冲 I/O 支持任意访问模式, 但非整页写需先从设备补全页面. 直接去掉这一过程虽能加速写入, 却会使页数据管理与刷出复杂化. WSBuffer 必须在避免先读后写惩罚的同时高效管理页数据, 解决 C3.

Different from the existing solutions that attempt to either optimize or bypass page cache, our design of WSBuffer aims to rearchitect the data path of buffered I/O by moving most of the buffering process out of the write critical path for incoming writes to proactively leverage SSD performance to enhance buffered I/O while retaining all of the advantages of buffered I/O without changing the I/O programming interface or requiring application modifications. Furthermore, WSBuffer is orthogonal to and can integrate with existing page cache optimizations.

与优化或绕过页缓存的既有方法不同, WSBuffer 重构缓冲 I/O 数据路径, 将大部分缓冲过程移出写入关键路径, 主动利用 SSD 性能. 它保留缓冲 I/O 优势, 不改变编程接口, 不要求修改应用, 且可与现有页缓存优化结合.

3. WSBuffer 设计与实现

We propose WSBuffer, a novel write-scrap buffering to rearchitect buffered I/O. WSBuffer proactively utilizes high-bandwidth SSDs and achieves the three design goals to enhance buffered I/O performance on high-bandwidth SSDs.

WSBuffer 采用写入片段缓冲重构缓冲 I/O, 主动利用高带宽 SSD, 达成上述三个目标.

3.1 概览

Figure 4 shows the overview of WSBuffer. First, WSBuffer introduces a scrap buffer (§ 3.2) to take over the write buffer handling from page cache while allowing page cache to focus on its strengths in reads. Then, WSBuffer utilizes the scrap buffer to efficiently buffer small writes and partial-page writes by asynchronously performing their corresponding read-before-write processes and efficiently managing their data in a merge-friendly manner, thereby achieving G3.

图 4 展示 WSBuffer. 首先, scrap buffer 接管写缓冲, 页缓存专注读取, 见原文第 3.2 节. 对小写入与非整页写, scrap buffer 异步执行先读后写, 并以便于合并的方式管理数据, 实现 G3.

Figure 4: WSBuffer overview.

图 4: WSBuffer 概览.

Further, WSBuffer designs a buffer-minimized data access mechanism (§ 3.3) to handle user requests by combining scrap buffer, page cache and SSDs while efficiently maintaining data consistency. WSBuffer splits large writes into partial-scrap-page parts and scrap-page-aligned parts, and then directly sends the large and aligned parts to the underlying SSDs to achieve (G1), while utilizing the scrap buffer to buffer small writes and the partial-scrap-page parts of large writes. This also effectively reduces the number of dirty pages that need to be buffered in memory and the corresponding management overhead (G1), and further relieves the pressure of dirty-page flushing (G2).

随后, 最小化缓冲的数据访问机制协调 scrap buffer, 页缓存与 SSD 并维护一致性, 见原文第 3.3 节. 大写入拆为未对齐 scrap-page 的部分和对齐部分, 后者直接发送到 SSD, 前者与小写入留在缓冲区. 这减少脏页数量及管理开销, 达成 G1, 同时减轻刷出压力, 有助于 G2.

Furthermore, WSBuffer devises an opportunistic two-stage flushing mechanism (OTflush) (§ 3.4) to handle these asynchronous read-before-write processes to fill scrap-pages (Stage-1) and perform dirty-page writeback at a large granularity (Stage-2), in an opportunistic load-aware and parallel manner, thus exploiting SSD performance to achieve G2 and enhance G3. Finally, WSBuffer proposes a concurrent page management mechanism (§ 3.5) to separately manage scrap-pages and read-only memory-pages and minimize the lock contention between free scrap-page insertions, invalid scrap-page deletions, and page flushing of OTflush, to enhance G2.

OTflush 在第一阶段异步读取并补全 scrap-page, 第二阶段以大粒度写回. 它感知设备负载, 利用空闲机会并行工作, 达成 G2 并改善 G3, 见原文第 3.4 节. 并发页管理机制分别管理 scrap-page 与只读内存页, 减少新页插入, 无效页删除和 OTflush 之间的锁竞争, 进一步实现 G2, 见原文第 3.5 节.

3.2 片段缓冲区

To efficiently buffer SSD-I/O unfriendly writes and expensive partial-page writes (§ 2.3.3), WSBuffer first presents a memory-page structure, scrap buffer. The scrap buffer is designed to strategically buffers small writes (§ 3.3) and fast handle partial-page writes by asynchronously performing the read-before-write processes via OTflush (§ 3.4), thus hiding and reducing the penalty of partial-page writes (C3).

scrap buffer 用于缓冲不适合直接交给 SSD 的写入与昂贵的非整页写, 见原文第 2.3.3 节. 它按策略吸收小写入, 并通过 OTflush 异步执行先读后写, 隐藏并减少非整页写代价, 克服 C3, 相关机制见原文第 3.3, 3.4 节.

Scrap-pages. Different from page cache, where all its memory-pages are always full, the scrap buffer presents a scrap-page structure to manage partial-page writes with diverse offsets and sizes. In addition to a data-zone for placing the page data, a scrap-page also has a header for efficiently maintaining the metadata (i.e., partial-page data-segment information) of this page. Specifically, the header is 128B-sized by default, including a 4B-sized counter field for recording the byte count of valid data within this page, a 1B-sized number field for recording the number of data-segments within this page, a 2B-sized SSD-id field for identifying the underlying SSD corresponding to this page (for OTflush), a 1B-sized tag field for recording page flushing state, and 15 8B-sized index entries, each of which records the offset of a data-segment within the page (4B) and the segment's size (4B). A larger header means more index entries, i.e., accommodating more discontinuous data-segments, which applies to workloads primarily composed of small writes. In our evaluations, the number of index entries used within a scrap-page is less than 15 in more than 95% cases.

片段页. 页缓存中的内存页总是完整的, scrap buffer 则用 scrap-page 管理不同偏移和大小的局部数据. 每页包含数据区和记录片段信息的页头. 默认页头 128 B, 包括记录有效字节数的 4 B counter, 记录片段数的 1 B number, 供 OTflush 定位设备的 2 B SSD-id, 记录刷出状态的 1 B tag, 以及 15 个 8 B 索引项. 每项含 4 B 页内偏移和 4 B 片段长度. 更大页头可容纳更多不连续片段, 适合小写入负载. 实验中超过 95% 的页使用不足 15 个索引项.

To maximize the internal parallelism of SSDs, the data-zone size should also be an integral multiple of the number of channels × the SSD-page size [22, 73]. Further, the smaller the size, the more flexible the memory allocation. In contrast, larger size means more efficient OTflush (its handling granularity is data-zone-sized) and page indexing, and less management overhead. Therefore, for our evaluated SSDs (§ 4.1, 8 channels and 16KB-sized SSD-page), the data-zone size is set to 256KB (2 × 128KB) by default.

为利用 SSD 内部并行, 数据区大小应是通道数乘 SSD 页大小的整数倍 [22, 73]. 较小数据区利于灵活分配内存; 较大数据区则提高 OTflush 和索引效率, 减少管理开销, 因为 OTflush 以整个数据区为粒度. 实验 SSD 有 8 个通道, 页大小 16 KB, 因而默认数据区为 256 KB, 即 2 × 128 KB.

Scrap-page allocation. Memory allocation is often based on 4KB pages, thus the 128B-sized header can lead to significant memory fragmentation. Moreover, simply placing the header and data-zone together can result in a single cross-scrap-page access being split into multiple scattered memory accesses, thereby reducing access efficiency. Therefore, WSBuffer allocates 32 scrap-pages each time, and places headers and data-zones separately in a data layout format of 4KB-sized header area + 8MB-sized data-zone area.

片段页分配. 内存通常按 4 KB 页分配, 单独的 128 B 页头可能带来严重碎片. 将页头与数据区逐个交错放置, 还可能使一次跨片段页访问拆成多段不连续内存访问. 因此 WSBuffer 每次批量分配 32 个片段页, 将页头与数据区分开连续排列, 形成 4 KB 页头区加 8 MB 数据区.

Scrap buffer writes. Straightforwardly placing writes to the scrap buffer in arrival order can lead to complex data indexing, leading to potentially reduced read performance and low memory utilization. Therefore, WSBuffer places writes in a merge-friendly manner. Specifically, a scrap buffer write is first split to corresponding one or more scrap-pages according to its offset. For each split sub-write, WSBuffer first performs the (partial-page) write in the scrap-page directly without the read-before-write process. Then, WSBuffer merges it with existing address-overlapping data-segments by querying and updating the corresponding scrap-page header. Finally, if the page state is changed (e.g., from unfilled to full), WSBuffer updates the tag field in the header, and notifies OTflush accordingly by fast inserting the address of this page header to the corresponding queue of OTflush.

片段缓冲区写入. 若仅按到达顺序保存写入, 索引会复杂, 读取与内存利用率可能下降. WSBuffer 因而采用便于合并的组织方式. 先按偏移将请求拆到对应片段页, 各子写入直接更新页面而不先读, 再查询和更新页头, 与地址重叠的现有片段合并. 若状态改变, 如从未满变为已满, 则更新 tag, 并将页头地址快速加入 OTflush 对应队列.

Example. Figure 5 shows a scrap buffer write example with offset=131KB and size=276KB. This write corresponds to two existing scrap-pages. After the partial-page write, the data-segment #2 of the scrap-page #1 is merged with the 131KB-256KB address-range of the write. The scrap-page #1 is still unfilled without requiring to update its tag field. The data-segments #1 and #2 of the scrap-page #2 are merged with the 256KB-407KB address-range of the write. The number of data-segments in the scrap-page #2 is changed to 1, and the page becomes full. Therefore, in scrap-page #2 header, the number field is updated to 1, and the tag field is updated to 2, while this page is inserted into the queue of OTflush Stage-2.

示例. 图 5 中偏移 131 KB, 大小 276 KB 的写入覆盖两个已有片段页. 页 1 的片段 2 与 131-256 KB 范围合并, 页面仍未满, 无须改变 tag. 页 2 的两个片段与 256-407 KB 范围合并后形成一个完整片段, 页面变满. 因而其 number 设为 1, tag 设为 2, 并进入 OTflush 第二阶段队列.

Figure 5: A scrap buffer write example.

图 5: 片段缓冲区写入示例.

Overall, the scrap buffer overcomes C3 and utilizes the customized header to achieve efficient page-data management, while it simplifies the design of OTflush.

总体而言, 片段缓冲区克服 C3, 用专用页头高效管理页数据, 同时简化 OTflush.

3.3 最小化缓冲的数据访问

Legacy buffered I/O utilizes page cache to handle all user accesses, resulting in limited maximum write performance (§ 2.3.1) and high memory dependency (§ 2.3.2). WSBuffer introduces the scrap buffer to take over the write buffer handling from page cache while retains its read process. Further, WSBuffer aims to partially buffer user writes via the scrap buffer and proactively send writes to underlying SSDs directly to improve maximum write performance of buffered I/O (overcoming C1) and reduce memory footprint used for dirty-data (indirectly alleviating C2). However, introducing the scrap buffer complicates user accesses and data consistency. Therefore, WSBuffer presents a buffer-minimized data access mechanism to handle various user access requests across scrap buffer, page cache and SSDs, while maintaining data consistency, as shown in Algorithm 1.

传统缓冲 I/O 用页缓存处理所有访问, 最大写性能受限且高度依赖内存, 见原文第 2.3.1, 2.3.2 节. WSBuffer 用片段缓冲区接管写入, 保留原读取路径, 并尽量将写入直接交给 SSD, 以提高最大性能并减少脏数据内存, 分别应对 C1 和 C2. 但新增缓冲区使访问和一致性更复杂, 因而需要算法 1 所示机制, 协调片段缓冲区, 页缓存与 SSD.

Algorithm 1: Buffer-Minimized Data Access Mechanism.

算法 1: 最小化缓冲的数据访问机制. 输入为用户请求偏移 reqoffset 与大小 reqsize.

小写入全部缓冲, 大写入拆为局部片段与对齐区域, 分别交给片段缓冲区和 SSD, 随后回收被覆盖的旧页. 读取先查询片段缓冲区, 剩余部分沿原页缓存路径处理.

Write mechanism. WSBuffer utilizes the scrap buffer and SSDs to handle writes without page cache writes. Figure 1 demonstrates how SSDs can achieve faster writes than main memory via buffered I/O. However, this requires the writes to be aligned and sufficiently large. Therefore, WSBuffer utilizes the scrap buffer to buffer small writes and unaligned parts of large writes, and proactively sends aligned parts of large writes to SSDs directly, to benefit from the respective strengths of both main memory and SSDs.

写入机制. WSBuffer 不再向页缓存写数据, 而由片段缓冲区和 SSD 处理. 图 1 表明 SSD 写入可快于经页缓存写内存, 前提是请求足够大且对齐. 因此小写入与大请求的未对齐部分进入片段缓冲区, 大且对齐部分直接发往 SSD, 发挥两者各自优势.

Specifically, WSBuffer first determines whether the write request is sufficiently large to benefit from the SSD bandwidth, based on a predefined request-size threshold (line 2), and utilizes the scrap buffer to fast absorb all small writes with any offsets (line 3). By default, the request-size threshold is 1MB, because on our evaluation platform (§ 4.1), using SSDs to handle writes of 1MB each or larger can provide higher performance than using the scrap buffer. A higher threshold means buffering more writes via the scrap buffer. Then, for large writes, WSBuffer splits them into partial-scrap-page parts and large aligned parts (line 6), and utilizes the scrap buffer to buffer the partial-scrap-page parts, while directly sends large and aligned parts of writes to SSDs (line 7-8).

首先按预设大小阈值判断写请求是否足以发挥 SSD 带宽, 见算法第 2 行. 小请求无论偏移如何均由片段缓冲区吸收, 见第 3 行. 默认阈值 1 MB, 因为实验平台上这一大小及以上交给 SSD 更快, 见原文第 4.1 节; 阈值越大, 缓冲数据越多. 大请求则拆成局部片段页和大段对齐区域, 前者缓冲, 后者直接写 SSD, 见第 6-8 行.

The alignment granularity is the scrap-page-data-zone size (e.g., 256KB) rather than the memory-page size (e.g., 4KB). This design aims to ensure that all SSD-write sizes are multiples of scrap-page-data-zone size, thereby achieving 1) file fragmentation resistance and 2) OTflush friendliness. For 1), it is because, in this way, the storage space of SSDs is orchestrated as multiple large and aligned data blocks that will never be further fragmented, i.e., the minimum storage unit of SSDs is scrap-page-data-zone-sized. Further, the scrap-pagedata-zone size is a multiple of the number of channels × the SSD-page size (§ 3.2). These designs fundamentally prevent the fragmentation-induced performance degradation [22]. For 2), it is because a scrap-page should correspond to a single contiguous address space on SSDs (if any), instead of being scattered across multiple locations, thereby enhancing OTflush efficiency.

对齐粒度是片段页数据区大小, 如 256 KB, 而非 4 KB 内存页. 这样所有 SSD 写入均为该大小的整数倍, 一方面抵抗文件碎片, 另一方面便于 OTflush. SSD 空间以较大且对齐的块组织, 最小分配单元为片段页数据区, 不再进一步拆碎; 其大小又是通道数乘 SSD 页大小的整数倍, 从而避免碎片引起的性能下降 [22]. 同时, 每个片段页在 SSD 上对应一段连续地址, 不散布于多个位置, 提高 OTflush 效率.

In addition, a portion of the SSD-write address range may have already been allocated with scrap-pages to buffer written data and memory-pages to cache read data. These pages become obsolete after the SSD-write is completed, thus WSBuffer reclaims these pages directly (line 10-11). Similarly, a portion of the scrap-buffer-write address range may have already been allocated with memory-pages to cache read data, thus WSBuffer reclaims these pages after the write (line 4 and 9). These reclaiming operations are performed in the background without interfering with foreground writes (§ 3.5).

SSD 写入覆盖的范围可能已有缓冲脏数据的片段页和缓存读取的内存页. 写完后这些页过期, WSBuffer 直接回收, 见第 10-11 行. 同理, 片段缓冲区写入后也要回收该范围的旧读缓存页, 见第 4, 9 行. 回收在后台进行, 不干扰前台写入, 见原文第 3.5 节.

Figure 6 (a) shows the data flow of a typical write operation. The write is first partially buffered by scrap-pages ((1) ), and then the large and scrap-page-size aligned sub-write is handled by SSDs directly ((2) ).

图 6(a) 展示典型写入: 先将部分内容放入片段页 (1), 再将大且对齐片段页的子请求直接交给 SSD (2).

Read mechanism. Unlike writes, which can be proactively determined in their placement, read requests depend on the location where the data is placed. File data may be placed on scrap-pages, memory-pages and SSDs, causing potentially complex reads. Fortunately, the WSBuffer write mechanism has ensured that the data in the scrap buffer is always the latest, and the remaining data is on SSDs while page cache may have cached a part of the data of SSDs. Therefore, as shown in Figure 6 (b), WSBuffer first looks up the scrap buffer to read requested data (line 13-15 and (1) ), and reads the remaining requested data (if any) via page cache and possible SSD accesses caused by page fault (line 16-18 and (2) (3) ) to benefit from mature page cache read optimizations.

读取机制. 写入可主动选择放置位置, 读取却取决于数据已在哪里. 数据可能位于片段页, 内存页或 SSD, 看似复杂. 但写入机制保证片段缓冲区内容总是最新, 其余最新数据在 SSD, 页缓存可能保存部分 SSD 数据. 因此先查询片段缓冲区, 再通过原页缓存路径读取剩余内容, 必要时缺页访问 SSD, 如图 6(b) 和算法第 13-18 行所示. 这样保留了成熟的页缓存读取优化.

Data consistency. Intuitively, the data consistency of the three sources could be particularly complex. Fortunately, WSBuffer utilizes the scrap buffer and SSDs to handle writes while always keeping scrap-pages and memory-pages valid. The latest data are placed on scrap-pages or stored to SSDs directly. Memory-pages are always clean and used for caching data for reads only. Therefore, the data access mechanism simplifies and ensures data consistency by separating dirty scrap-pages from clean memory-pages.

数据一致性. 三个来源看似难以协调, 但 WSBuffer 只用片段缓冲区和 SSD 接收写入, 并保持对外可见片段页和内存页有效. 最新数据在片段页或 SSD, 页缓存中的内存页始终干净且只用于读取. 将脏片段页与干净内存页分离, 简化并保证了一致性.

Figure 6: The data flow of buffer-minimized data access.

图 6: 最小化缓冲的数据访问流程.

3.4 机会式两阶段刷出

Many scrap-pages are unfilled, and cannot be written back to SSDs directly, to avoid scrap-page data-zone-size unaligned SSD-writes (§ 3.3). Further, the underlying SSDs with high bandwidth may experience differing levels of busyness, because WSBuffer strategically sends a part of foreground writes to SSDs directly. Inappropriate page flushing sent to busy SSDs may be slow and block other page flushing operations corresponding to idle SSDs. Therefore, WSBuffer devises an opportunistic two-stage dirty-data flushing (OTflush) to dynamically utilize idle SSDs to perform fluent page filling and writeback (C2 and C3), as shown in Algorithm 2.

许多片段页尚未填满, 为避免不按数据区大小对齐的写入, 不能直接写回 SSD, 见原文第 3.3 节. 同时, 部分前台写已直达 SSD, 各设备忙闲程度不同. 向繁忙设备刷页不仅慢, 还可能阻塞本可交给空闲设备的其他刷页. 因此 OTflush 动态利用空闲 SSD 补全和写回页面, 处理 C2, C3, 如算法 2 所示.

Algorithm 2: OTflush Process.

算法 2: OTflush 流程.

第一阶段在对应 SSD 空闲时读取并补全页面, 已满页无需重复补全. 第二阶段跳过无效页, 为尚未分配空间的页选择最空闲 SSD, 或在既有 SSD 空闲时写回, 完成后回收页面. 暂时无法处理的页重新放到队尾.

SSD busyness awareness. To avoid the inappropriate page flushing sent to busy SSDs, OTflush is designed to identify the SSD busyness by sensing the bandwidth usage of each SSD. Since the bandwidth usage of an SSD is almost directly proportional to the amount of I/O data being handled by the SSD, OTflush maintains the count of bytes of all writes sent to each SSD (Bcount). Specifically, OTflush increases Bcount by the size of the I/O before submitting each I/O (e.g., submit_bio), and decreases Bcount after each I/O is completed (e.g., bi_end_io). OTflush uses per-SSD Bcount to separately identify the bandwidth usage of each SSD. Further, OTflush senses whether an SSD is busy by comparing its Bcount with a predefined threshold. In our evaluation, this threshold is set to 4MB by default, because a 4MB write can nearly saturate the bandwidth of the SSD [51]. Note that, since SSD performance behaviors are complex and dynamic [20, 29, 75], Bcount aims to provide a coarse-grained but effective SSD bandwidth awareness at a low cost. Bcount can be adjusted to strike a proper tradeoff between foreground-writes and background OTflush.

感知 SSD 忙闲. OTflush 用带宽占用估计设备负载. 由于带宽占用与正在处理的数据量近似成正比, 它为每台 SSD 维护在途写入字节数 Bcount. 提交 I/O 前, 如 submit_bio, 加上请求大小; 完成后, 如 bi_end_io, 再减去. 将 Bcount 与阈值比较即可粗略判断忙闲. 实验默认阈值 4 MB, 因为一次 4 MB 写几乎可占满设备带宽 [51]. SSD 行为复杂且动态 [20, 29, 75], 此计数旨在低成本提供粗粒度但有效的感知, 可调整阈值以平衡前台写入与后台 OTflush.

Stage-1. OTflush Stage-1 is designed to read data from SSDs to asynchronously fill scrap-pages of which many are due to partial-page writes performed directly by WSBuffer upon their arrivals. Specifically, OTflush maintains a dedicated ring queue (Queue-1) for reads. Whenever an unfilled page is generated, the scrap buffer (§ 3.2) inserts it to Queue-1. To accelerate page insertion and page field query, the scrap buffer only inserts the address of the scrap-page header into Queue-1, and the same for Stage-2. When a scrap-page is taken out from Queue-1, OTflush first identifies whether it is full. If it is full, OTflush will discard it directly (line 4-5). This is because a scrap-page may have been filled by foreground writes before it is fetched (e.g., Figure 5). Then, OTflush identifies whether the scrap-page corresponding SSD (recorded in the SSD-id field of its header) is busy. If the corresponding SSD is not busy, OTflush performs the corresponding SSD-read, and inserts this page to Stage-2 queue after reading (line 6-8) while updating the tag field of this page. Otherwise, the read is not executed, and the scrap-page is inserted into the tail of Queue-1 again (line 9-10) to fill later.

第一阶段. OTflush 从 SSD 异步读取, 补全因直接接收局部写入而未满的片段页. 新生成的未满页加入专用环形 Queue-1, 实际只存页头地址以便快速入队与查询, 第二阶段同样如此. 取出后先判断是否已满: 页面可能已被后续前台写填满, 此时跳过第一阶段, 见第 4-5 行. 否则根据页头 SSD-id 检查设备忙闲; 空闲则读取并补全, 更新 tag 后放入第二阶段队列, 见第 6-8 行; 繁忙则重新放到 Queue-1 尾部, 稍后处理, 见第 9-10 行.

Stage-2. OTflush Stage-2 is designed to write full scrap-pages back to SSDs. Similarly, OTflush maintains another dedicated ring queue (Queue-2) for writing back. Whenever a full page is generated, the scrap buffer inserts it to Queue-2. When a scrap-page is taken out from Queue-2, OTflush first checks its validity. Because the scrap-page may have been deleted due to being obsolete (§ 3.3). If it is invalid, discarding it (line 14-15). Then, OTflush identifies the SSD corresponding to this page by querying the SSD-id field of its header. If SSD-id field=0, this means that the storage space corresponding to this page has not been allocated, because WSBuffer uses a delayed allocation approach [8, 26, 50] for the storage space corresponding to a new scrap-page. This allows OTflush to flexibly select the least busy SSD to allocate the corresponding space and performs the page writeback (line 16-18). Otherwise, OTflush identifies whether its corresponding SSD is busy or not, and performs the page writeback (line 20-21) or inserts this page into the tail of Queue-2 again (line 23-24) to writeback later. After the page writeback is completed, WSBuffer reclaims the corresponding scrap-page immediately to reduce memory usage (line 19 and 22).

第二阶段. 完整片段页进入专用环形 Queue-2, 准备写回. 取出后先检查有效性, 因为页面可能已因被覆盖而删除; 无效则跳过, 见第 14-15 行. 再查询 SSD-id. 若为 0, 表示尚未分配存储空间: WSBuffer 对新片段页采用延迟分配 [8, 26, 50], 因而可选择最空闲 SSD 分配并写回, 见第 16-18 行. 若已有位置, 则检查对应 SSD, 空闲时写回, 繁忙时重新放到队尾, 见第 20-24 行. 写回完成立即回收片段页, 减少内存占用, 见第 19, 22 行.

Due to the absence of dependencies between scrap-pages, OTflush, combined with § 3.5, can effectively enable concurrent page flushing by simply splitting Queue-1/2 into multiple sub-queues and allocating a thread to each sub-queue, at the cost of CPU resource. For a fair comparison, in our evaluation, WSBuffer sets only two queue-thread pairs by default, one for Stage-1 and the other for Stage-2. It should be emphasized that, due to high SSD bandwidth, scrap-pages exist only within a short time window, and are quickly flushed to SSDs without occupying excessive memory.

片段页之间没有依赖, 配合原文第 3.5 节机制, 可以把两个队列拆为多个子队列, 各配线程实现并发刷出, 代价是更多 CPU. 为公平比较, 默认只使用两个队列-线程对, 每阶段一个. SSD 高带宽使片段页通常只短暂存在, 很快写回, 不会长期占用大量内存.

3.5 并发页管理

In the legacy buffered I/O, the XArray of page cache is used to unify the management of clean pages, dirty pages and page flushing via an non-scalable spinlock, resulting in high lock contention and blocked foreground writes and background flushing. The scrap buffer is used to take over the write buffer handling from page cache, thus it faces similar lock contention and further complicates page management. Therefore, WSBuffer presents a concurrent page management mechanism to manage pages and minimize lock contention between concurrent page operations (C2), as shown in Figure 7.

传统页缓存用 XArray 自旋锁统一管理干净页, 脏页与刷出, 并发扩展性有限, 锁竞争阻塞前后台. 片段缓冲区接管写入后也面临类似问题, 还增加了页管理复杂度. 图 7 所示并发机制用于减少页操作间的锁竞争, 解决 C2.

XArray for read-only memory-pages. The buffer-minimized data access mechanism (§ 3.3) ensures that all memory-pages of page cache are clean and used for reads only. In this way, the XArray of page cache no longer needs to maintain page states, but merely manage page replacements. Therefore, WSBuffer continues to use the XArray to manage memory-pages for read-only workloads. This design is efficient, because page-fault-induced tree structure updates will only hinder its corresponding thread, and do not block other read threads. Further, compared to the slow SSD-read triggered by a page fault, the overhead of non-concurrent tree structure updates is negligible.

只读内存页使用 XArray. 最小化缓冲机制保证页缓存页始终干净, 只供读取, 因而 XArray 不再维护脏页状态, 只需管理替换. WSBuffer 保留原 XArray 管理读缓存. 缺页引起的树更新仅阻塞对应线程, 不阻塞其他读线程; 相较 SSD 读取, 非并发树更新的开销也很小.

SXArray for scrap-pages. The scrap buffer faces lock contention between free scrap-page insertions, invalid scrap-page deletions, and scrap-page state maintenance. Therefore, WSBuffer utilizes a slightly modified XArray, called SXArray, to index and manage scrap-pages. SXArray manages the insertions and deletions of scrap-pages, but does not manage scrap-page states to avoid the required multiple lock-acquisitions for state maintenance. Further, concurrent operations of scrap-page insertions and deletions can also lead to lock contention. Therefore, SXArray performs insertion operations normally, but for deletion operations, SXArray only changes the corresponding index entries to NULL by introducing extra index-entry-level locks (rather than using xa_lock), and executes delayed tree structure updates (e.g., cascaded tree node deletions). Hence, these index-entry-level locks are lightweight.

片段页使用 SXArray. 片段缓冲区的插入, 删除和状态维护可能相互争锁, 因而使用略作修改的 XArray, 称为 SXArray. 它管理插入与删除, 不管理页状态, 避免状态变更反复加锁. 插入仍正常进行; 删除则只获取新增的索引项级锁, 将对应项置为 NULL, 不使用 xa_lock, 并延迟级联节点删除等树结构更新. 这些项级锁因此较轻量.

SXArray executes the tree structure updates in an opportunistic manner, i.e., executing when the load of the corresponding file is light or the file is closed. This design could lead to a potentially larger tree structure, but it is acceptable. Because the scrap-page granularity is large, and most data of large writes are directly stored on SSDs, so that the number of scrap-pages of a file is small. Moreover, the delayed-deleted nodes can be reused directly for newly inserted scrap-pages.

SXArray 在文件负载较轻或关闭时执行延迟树更新. 树可能暂时较大, 但片段页粒度大, 且大写入多数直接进入 SSD, 每文件片段页数较少, 因而可接受. 延迟删除的节点也可直接复用于后续插入.

Per-page locks for scrap-page state maintenance. Both scrap buffer writes and OTflush need to acquire a lock, resulting in potential lock contention. Therefore, WSBuffer introduces a fine-grained per-scrap-page lock to manage the scrap-page states. In this way, multiple scrap-pages are able to perform writes and OTflush concurrently. Specifically, scrap-page updates and OTflush Stage-1 can be performed by acquiring the per-scrap-page lock without acquiring the SXArray lock, because these operations do not change the tree structure. OTflush Stage-2 acquires the per-scrap-page lock to perform page writeback and only needs to acquire a corresponding index-entry-level lock of SXArray to modify the index entry after flushing. Although scrap-page insertions still need to acquire the non-scalable xa_lock, larger scrap-pages suffer much less from lock contention than memory-pages, and no lock contention at all with page flushing.

页级锁管理片段页状态. 写入与 OTflush 都需要同步, 因而 WSBuffer 为每个片段页配置细粒度锁, 允许不同页并发写入和刷出. 更新片段页和第一阶段不改变树结构, 只需页锁而无须 SXArray 锁. 第二阶段取得页锁写回, 完成后只需相应索引项锁更新映射. 插入仍需 xa_lock, 但较大页粒度显著减少竞争, 且不会与刷出争锁.

Moreover, scrap-page insertions and read-only memory-page management can benefit from existing XArray optimizations (e.g., ccXArray [45]) to further enhance concurrency.

片段页插入与只读内存页管理还可结合 ccXArray [45] 等现有优化, 进一步提高并发能力.

Figure 7: Concurrent page management mechanism.

图 7: 并发页管理机制.

3.6 实现

WSBuffer Implementation. We implemented a WSBuffer prototype on XFS [58] with ~4500 lines of code (LoC) in Linux kernel 6.8 for evaluation. The WSBuffer prototype with XFS is compiled as a kernel file system module. The interaction logic between the scrap buffer and the file system is similar to that of page cache and the file system. Therefore, introducing the WSBuffer architecture does not compromise the integrity of the file system. All file accesses via buffered I/O are handled by WSBuffer data access mechanism (§ 3.3), which is implemented in the read and write functions. WSBuffer implements several new functions for the scrap buffer structure (§ 3.2), OTflush (§ 3.4) and concurrent page management (§ 3.5). Further, the WSBuffer prototype inherits and expands the metadata maintenance processes used for page cache writes to adapt to WSBuffer writes.

WSBuffer 实现. 我们在 Linux 6.8 的 XFS [58] 上用约 4500 行代码实现原型, 编译为内核文件系统模块. 片段缓冲区与文件系统的交互类似页缓存, 不破坏文件系统完整性. 读写函数中实现的数据访问机制接管全部缓冲 I/O. 新增函数实现片段缓冲区, OTflush 与并发页管理, 同时继承并扩展原页缓存写入的元数据维护流程, 适配 WSBuffer.

fsync(). Most metadata operations in the WSBuffer prototype are similar to those in XFS, except for fsync(). When an fsync() is issued, WSBuffer first looks up relevant scrap-pages only without memory-pages. Then, WSBuffer wakes up a dedicated fsync thread to perform flushing for these scrap-pages, similar to the OTflush process. Due to scalable efficient OTflush and high SSD bandwidth, most scrap-pages are often already filled and even completed flushing, thus the remaining scrap-pages can be quickly written back to SSDs to achieve fast fsync. This also applies to other sync-like operations.

fsync(). 除该操作外, 大多数元数据操作与 XFS 类似. 收到 fsync() 后, WSBuffer 仅查找相关片段页, 不查读缓存页, 再唤醒专用线程, 按类似 OTflush 的流程刷出. 高效并发刷出与高带宽 SSD 使多数页早已补全甚至写回, 剩余页可快速落盘, 因而同步较快. 其他类似同步操作同样受益.

Durability and Crash Consistency. Similar to page cache of the legacy buffered I/O, WSBuffer delegates the underlying file system to ensure data durability and crash consistency (e.g., journaling mechanisms [44, 54, 74]).

持久性与崩溃一致性. 与传统页缓存一样, WSBuffer 依赖底层文件系统保障持久性和崩溃一致性, 例如使用日志机制 [44, 54, 74].

Generality and Portability. The WSBuffer architecture is independent of XFS-specific features and can be deployed to other file systems. The scrap buffer structure and concurrent page-management can be directly applied to other file systems as well. However, due to the data structures and handling logic specific to individual existing file systems, the implementation of data-access mechanism and OTflush requires engineering efforts to carefully integrate WSBuffer into the logic between the file system and the page cache.

通用性与可移植性. WSBuffer 不依赖 XFS 特有功能, 可用于其他文件系统. 片段缓冲区与并发页管理可直接复用, 但数据访问与 OTflush 需针对各文件系统的数据结构和处理逻辑进行工程集成, 正确接入文件系统与页缓存之间.

Additionally, the WSBuffer prototype can offer significant performance improvements to XFS with the best buffered I/O performance, detailed in § 4. File systems with lower buffered I/O performance can benefit more from WSBuffer.

原文第 4 节表明, 即使对缓冲 I/O 表现最好的 XFS, 原型也能明显改善性能; 缓冲性能更低的文件系统可能获益更多.

4. 评估

In this section, we evaluate the efficacy of WSBuffer under a wide variety of workloads and real-world applications.

本节在多种负载和真实应用下评估 WSBuffer.

4.1 实验设置

Environment. Our evaluation machine has two Intel Xeon Gold 6348 processors (2.60 GHz, 28 CPUs) and 256GB of DDR4 DRAM. For storage, the machine has 8 PCIe4.0 Samsung 990 PRO SSDs [51], with 7GB/s read and 6.9GB/s write bandwidths. We configure these SSDs as RAID0 using Linux software RAID (mdRAID [3]) and use the default stripe size (512KB) for evaluation. We run most experiments on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with Linux kernel 6.8, except for ScaleCache [45], which is implemented on Linux kernel 5.4. For all experiments, we pin threads to the cores, disable CPU frequency scaling, and clear the kernel cache before each run. All experimental results are the average of at least five runs.

环境. 服务器有两颗 Intel Xeon Gold 6348, 每颗 28 核, 2.60 GHz, 256 GB DDR4. 存储为八块 PCIe 4.0 Samsung 990 PRO [51], 每块读带宽 7 GB/s, 写带宽 6.9 GB/s. 使用 Linux mdRAID [3] 组成 RAID0, 默认条带 512 KB. 多数实验运行 Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 与 Linux 6.8, ScaleCache [45] 则基于 Linux 5.4. 所有实验绑定线程到核心, 禁用 CPU 动态调频, 每轮清空内核缓存, 结果至少取五轮平均.

Baseline file systems. We use four popular file systems: EXT4 [8], F2FS [34], BTRFS [50], and XFS [58], as the baselines. Further, we configure ScaleCache [45] on XFS (ScaleCache-XFS or SC-XFS) to represent the state-of-the-art buffered I/O optimization. Note that, ScaleCache-XFS based on Linux kernel 5.4 is inferior to XFS based on Linux kernel 6.8 in some experiments, due to various XFS-optimizations that have been incorporated into the Linux kernel mainline, such as folio module [14, 63], delayed logging [68], and batch inode activations [69]. StreamCache [38] is not open-source and it is designed for file scanning. In addition, since AutoIO [46] is implemented on the distributed Lustre parallel file system, we implement the AutoIO principle in userspace and deploy it on XFS (XFS-AutoIO) for a fair comparison, to represent the state-of-the-art hybrid modes of I/O operations.

基线文件系统. 使用 EXT4 [8], F2FS [34], BTRFS [50], XFS [58], 以及在 XFS 上部署的 ScaleCache, 简称 SC-XFS. 部分实验中 Linux 5.4 的 SC-XFS 不如 Linux 6.8 XFS, 原因是主线已加入 folio [14, 63], 延迟日志 [68], 批量 inode 激活 [69] 等优化. StreamCache [38] 未开源且面向扫描. AutoIO [46] 实现在分布式 Lustre 上, 为公平比较, 我们在用户态按其原理实现并部署到 XFS, 作为 XFS-AutoIO 混合 I/O 基线.

4.2 微基准

In this section, we evaluate the WSBuffer performance under various request sizes and offsets. To fairly demonstrate WSBuffer performance, we first disable page flushing for all file systems and provide sufficient memory.

我们测试不同请求大小与偏移. 为公平展示性能, 先关闭所有文件系统的刷页并提供充足内存.

Full-page write performance. We use the FIO benchmark with a single thread to perform random full-page writes with offsets aligned to scrap-page boundary, and measure the average write latency. As shown in Figure 8 (a), the WSBuffer performance is 1.03×-3.29× higher than that of the baseline file systems. For writes smaller than 1MB, WSBuffer utilizes the scrap buffer to buffer all writes. The performance advantage (1.03×-2.84×) of WSBuffer stems from the designs of batch allocation and data layout format of 32 scrap-pages in batch, and the large-size page management of scrap-pages (§ 3.2). These designs reduce the number of memory allocations and improve the efficiency of memory copying (due to more continuous-address copying) and page indexing (due to smaller index structure). For writes greater than or equal to 1MB, WSBuffer sends all writes to SSDs, and its performance is 1.14×-3.29× that of the baseline file systems. This demonstrates that WSBuffer effectively exploits the performance potentials of SSDs to accelerate foreground writes (C1).

整页写性能. 单线程 FIO 执行偏移对齐片段页边界的随机整页写, 测量平均延迟. 图 8(a) 中 WSBuffer 性能为基线的 1.03-3.29 倍. 小于 1 MB 时全部缓冲, 1.03-2.84 倍优势来自 32 页批量分配, 连续内存布局和大页管理: 减少分配次数, 提高连续复制和较小索引结构的效率. 至少 1 MB 时全部直接写 SSD, 性能为基线的 1.14-3.29 倍, 说明它能利用 SSD 加速前台写入, 克服 C1.

Partial-page write performance. Similarly, Figure 8 (b) shows the average write latency of partial-page writes with diverse offsets and size ±10%. The WSBuffer performance is 1.70×-82.80× higher than that of the baseline file systems. For writes smaller than 1MB, WSBuffer exhibits significant performance advantages (2.11×-82.80×) over the baseline file systems, demonstrating WSBuffer's ability to remove the read-before-write penalty of partial-page writes (C3) via the scrap buffer (§ 3.2). For 1MB, 2MB, and 4MB writes, in WSBuffer, respectively 32.4%, 82.3%, and 91.1% of the data are directly written into the SSDs, while achieving 1.70×-4.06× performance advantages over the baselines, demonstrating WSBuffer's capability to overcome C1 and C3.

非整页写性能. 图 8(b) 测试不同偏移和大小上下浮动 10% 的写入, WSBuffer 性能为基线的 1.70-82.80 倍. 小于 1 MB 时优势为 2.11-82.80 倍, 来自片段缓冲区消除同步先读后写代价, 即 C3. 对 1, 2, 4 MB 请求, 分别有 32.4%, 82.3%, 91.1% 数据直接写 SSD, 性能达到基线的 1.70-4.06 倍, 同时改善 C1 和 C3.

Figure 8: Average write latency of file systems under different write offsets and sizes.

图 8: 不同偏移与大小下各文件系统的平均写入延迟.

Comparison with direct I/O and hybrid I/O. To answer the natural question of what the effect of using direct I/O only or the hybrid direct-buffered I/O is, we use a FIO-like benchmark to perform random write experiments to compare WSBuffer with XFS-direct I/O (direct I/O only) and XFS-AutoIO (hybrid I/O). We use 1MB as the request-size threshold for XFS-AutoIO. We use the read-modify-write (RMW) process [55, 73] to execute I/Os for XFS-direct I/O, i.e., reading the corresponding unaligned pages from SSDs, then updating the user buffer, and finally writing the aligned data of the user buffer to SSDs. As shown in Figure 9, the WSBuffer performance is 1.59×-231.28× higher than that of the baselines. Because XFS-direct I/O suffers from slow and unavoidable RMWs in all cases and XFS-AutoIO suffers from slow partial-page writes for small-write cases and slow RMWs for large-write cases. This demonstrates that even without considering the additional programming costs, the performance of existing solutions that bypass page cache is still inferior to WSBuffer.

与直接及混合 I/O 比较. 使用类似 FIO 的随机写基准比较 WSBuffer, XFS-direct I/O 和 XFS-AutoIO, 后者阈值为 1 MB. 直接 I/O 通过读-改-写 [55, 73] 处理未对齐部分: 从 SSD 读相应页, 更新用户缓冲区, 再将对齐数据写回. 图 9 中 WSBuffer 性能为基线的 1.59-231.28 倍. 纯直接 I/O 始终承受 RMW, AutoIO 的小请求承受非整页写惩罚, 大请求承受 RMW. 因而即使不考虑编程改造成本, 这些绕过页缓存的方案仍不如 WSBuffer.

Figure 9: Comparison with direct I/O and hybrid I/O.

图 9: 与直接 I/O 及混合 I/O 的比较.

Multi-threaded performance. Further, we use the FIO benchmark with random writes whose size ranges from 4KB to 4MB (i.e., bsrange=4k-4m) to evaluate the multi-threaded write performance of WSBuffer. As shown in Figure 10 (a), WSBuffer exhibits a faster throughput growth with the increase of thread count, and its throughput is 1.21×-3.91× higher than that of the baseline file systems. We further use the Fileserver workload with read/write=1/2 [59] (detailed in Table 1), to evaluate the multi-threaded mixed read and write performance of WSBuffer. As shown in Figure 10 (b), WSBuffer outperforms the baseline file systems by 1.19×-2.51× in throughput. These further demonstrate that WSBuffer effectively exploits SSD performance, especially bandwidth, to enhance buffered I/O performance (C1). In addition, the peak throughput of WSBuffer is mainly constrained by the total SSD bandwidth (about 55GB/s) and the unavoidable memory copy, i.e., copying the aligned part of a write request from the (unaligned) user buffer to the in-kernel address-aligned memory-space for submit_bio(). Increasing the total SSD bandwidth or enhancing the efficiency of memory copying can directly improve the peak throughput of WSBuffer.

多线程性能. 用 FIO 的 bsrange=4k-4m 随机写测试扩展性. 图 10(a) 中 WSBuffer 吞吐量随线程数增长更快, 为基线的 1.21-3.91 倍. 再用读写比 1:2 的 Fileserver [59] 测试混合负载, 见表 1 和图 10(b), 吞吐量为基线的 1.19-2.51 倍. 这说明它能利用 SSD, 尤其其带宽, 改善缓冲 I/O. 当前峰值主要受约 55 GB/s 总带宽及不可避免的内存复制限制: 为 submit_bio() 将用户缓冲区中对齐的数据部分复制到内核地址对齐区域, 因用户缓冲区地址本身可能未对齐. 提高总带宽或复制效率即可进一步提升峰值.

Reads. For read-only workloads, the performance of WSBuffer and XFS is almost identical, as WSBuffer retains the original read process of page cache. Figure 10 (b) demonstrates that WSBuffer performs well (up to 2.51×) under the workload with a read-write ratio of 1:2. We will further assess WSBuffer under read-heavy workloads in § 4.3 and § 4.4.

读取. WSBuffer 保留原页缓存读路径, 只读性能与 XFS 几乎相同. 图 10(b) 中读写比 1:2 时最高达到 2.51 倍; 原文第 4.3, 4.4 节进一步评估读密集负载.

4.3.1 充足内存下的评估

First, we evaluate WSBuffer under sufficient memory with page flushing disabled. Figure 11 shows the throughput results of a single thread and 16 threads (at this point, the performance of these file systems has reached their peaks).

先提供充足内存并关闭刷页. 图 11 给出单线程和 16 线程结果, 后者已达到各系统性能峰值.

Fileserver. WSBuffer outperforms the baseline file systems by 1.23×-2.51× in throughput for the write-heavy Fileserver. XFS ranks second only to WSBuffer and significantly outperforms other baseline file systems due to its various optimizations for both metadata and data accesses. This demonstrates that the performance advantage of WSBuffer remains significant under mixed metadata and data accesses without reducing the efficiency of file system metadata operations.

Fileserver. 写密集 Fileserver 中, WSBuffer 吞吐量为基线的 1.23-2.51 倍. XFS 得益于原文第 4.1 节所述优化, 仅次于 WSBuffer, 并明显优于其他基线. 这说明混合元数据与数据访问下, WSBuffer 仍有明显优势, 且未降低文件系统元数据操作效率.

Webproxy. In read-heavy Webproxy, WSBuffer is slightly inferior to XFS and significantly outperforms other baseline file systems by 1.08×-1.65× in throughput. This is attributed to the increasing usage of scrap pages due to the disabled page flushing (i.e., OTflush § 3.4), which results in frequent twice page indexing (i.e., looking up SXArray first and then XArray) and twice tree structure updates. Enabling OTflush can mitigate this issue, and the more OTflush threads, the closer the performance of WSBuffer approaches that of XFS.

Webproxy. 读密集 Webproxy 中, WSBuffer 略低于 XFS, 但为其他基线的 1.08-1.65 倍. 原因是关闭 OTflush 后片段页积累, 常需先查 SXArray 再查 XArray, 产生两次索引与两次树更新. 启用 OTflush 可缓解, 线程越多, 性能越接近 XFS.

Varmail. WSBuffer outperforms the baseline file systems by 1.06×-2.84× in throughput for the metadata-intensive Varmail. In these file systems, more than 60% of the time is spent on fsync operations. For fsync() calls, WSBuffer achieves faster page locating, bio assembly, and page flushing due to the large scrap-page granularity (§ 3.2), as well as more efficient page-state maintenance (§ 3.5), especially for multiple user threads. F2FS ranks second only to WSBuffer and significantly outperforms other baseline file systems due to its multiple optimizations for fsync [2, 34, 72].

Varmail. 元数据密集的 Varmail 中, WSBuffer 吞吐量为基线的 1.06-2.84 倍. 各系统超过 60% 时间用于 fsync. 大片段页与高效状态维护使 WSBuffer 的定位, bio 组装和刷出更快, 多线程下尤其明显, 见原文第 3.2, 3.5 节. F2FS 有多项 fsync 优化 [2, 34, 72], 因而仅次于 WSBuffer, 明显优于其他基线.

4.3.2 受限内存下的评估

Then, we use data-intensive Fileserver and Webproxy to evaluate WSBuffer under limited memory supply and enabling page flushing for all file systems. For a fair comparison, we only enable two OTflush threads, one for Stage-1 and the other for Stage-2. ScaleCache-XFS is unable to run under strictly limited memory supply. We will further evaluate ScaleCache-XFS under less strictly limited memory supply in (§ 4.4).

随后对数据密集的 Fileserver 和 Webproxy 限制内存, 启用全部系统刷页. 为公平比较, OTflush 仅使用两个线程, 每阶段一个. ScaleCache-XFS 无法在严格内存限制下运行, 原文第 4.4 节将在较宽松限制下继续评估它.

Fileserver. Figure 12 (a)(b) show that WSBuffer significantly outperforms the baseline file systems by 1.23×-4.48× in throughput. This demonstrates that WSBuffer effectively improves buffered I/O performance under heavy writes and limited memory supply (C1 and C2) by utilizing buffer-minimized data access mechanism (§ 3.3) to reduce memory footprint and using OTflush (§ 3.4) and concurrent page management (§ 3.5) to achieve fluent dirty-data flushing and minimize the lock contention. Due to the high throughput of WSBuffer, the rate of memory consumption by partially buffered foreground writes still surpasses the speed at which OTflush releases memory. Therefore, as the memory supply increases, the performance of WSBuffer continues to increase. Moreover, enabling more OTflush threads can accelerate page flushing to further enhance WSBuffer performance.

Fileserver. 图 12(a), 12(b) 中, WSBuffer 吞吐量为基线的 1.23-4.48 倍. 它通过最小化缓冲减少内存, 通过 OTflush 和并发页管理顺畅刷出并减少争锁, 因而改善高强度写与内存受限时的 C1, C2. 但高吞吐量下, 前台部分缓冲消耗内存仍快于 OTflush 释放, 所以内存增大时性能仍继续增长. 增加 OTflush 线程也可加快刷出, 进一步提高性能.

Webproxy. Figure 12 (c)(d) show that, even under read-heavy workloads, WSBuffer outperforms the baseline file systems by 1.07×-4.37× in throughput. The baseline file systems under read-heavy Webproxy suffer from less lock contention (§ 2.3.2) compared to under Fileserver, especially XFS, which fully benefits from batch page allocation and flushing offered by folio [14, 63]. The performance advantage of WSBuffer stems from two factors. 1) WSBuffer's significant savings in memory used for writes free up more memory for page cache to accelerate reads, which is especially significant for the 10% and 20% cases. 2) WSBuffer's concurrent page management further minimizes the lock contention. Therefore, WSBuffer can enable more memory for reads under memory pressure.

Webproxy. 图 12(c), 12(d) 中, 即使读密集负载, WSBuffer 仍为基线的 1.07-4.37 倍. 读密集时基线锁竞争较轻, XFS 尤其受益于 folio 批量分配与刷出 [14, 63]. WSBuffer 优势来自两方面: 写入节省内存, 留给页缓存加速读取, 在 10%, 20% 内存供给时尤为明显; 并发页管理进一步减少锁竞争. 因而它在内存压力下能为读取腾出更多空间.

4.6 内存占用分析

We discuss the memory consumption details of WSBuffer.

本节分析 WSBuffer 的内存消耗.

Analysis of microbenchmark writes. Table 4 shows the percentage of data written to memory of the baseline file systems and WSBuffer with different request-size threshold, which is 1MB-sized by default. The baseline file systems use page cache to handle all writes. For WSBuffer, the larger the threshold value, the more data is written to memory. Nevertheless, WSBuffer sends most of large-write data to SSDs directly, thus significantly reducing memory consumption.

Analysis of real-world applications. For the KV store experiment, all foreground writes are buffered by memory due to small accesses. We focus on the graph processing and scientific computing applications, as shown in Table 5. Surprisingly, WSBuffer's foreground writes consume only a small amount of memory. This is mainly because that, for large writes, most data are written to SSDs directly; and for small writes (most of their sizes are ranging from a few KB to tens of KB), although they are buffered on scrap-pages, they often become obsolete and are reclaimed (§ 3.3) due to subsequent large overwrites. This demonstrates that the WSBuffer architecture is particularly memory-efficient for modern data-intensive applications. The saved memory can be effectively utilized by page cache to accelerate reads.

5. 相关工作

Different from existing solutions that enhance buffered I/O by either optimizing or bypassing page cache (detailed in § 2.4), WSBuffer, designed to fully adapt to high-bandwidth SSDs, proactively leverages SSD performance to enhance buffered I/O. Next, we further discuss other related works.

现有缓冲 I/O 优化主要改善或绕过页缓存, 见原文第 2.4 节; WSBuffer 则面向高带宽 SSD 重构路径, 主动利用设备性能. 下面讨论其他相关研究.

Storage I/O stack optimizations. Falcon [31] optimizes the block layer of storage I/O stack by a per-drive I/O processing to parallelize I/O serving. AIOS [35] presents an asynchronous storage I/O stack to overlap I/O-related CPU operations, and reducing the sojourn time in the block layer. λ-IO [70] presents a unified I/O stack to manage both computation and storage resources across the host and the device. In addition, some works focus on ensuring the storage order with low overhead for I/O stack [28, 65]. In comparison, WSBuffer focuses on rearchitecting the data path of buffered I/O.

存储 I/O 栈优化. Falcon [31] 采用每设备 I/O 处理来并行化块层服务. AIOS [35] 用异步 I/O 栈重叠相关 CPU 操作, 减少块层停留时间. λ-IO [70] 统一管理主机与设备计算及存储资源. 还有研究以低开销保证 I/O 顺序 [28, 65]. WSBuffer 则着重重构缓冲 I/O 数据路径.

Proactively exploiting SSD performance. NHC [67] redirects excess load to the underlying storage to proactively exploit the bandwidth of the lower layer in storage hierarchies. OrchFS [73] utilizes NVM to absorb unaligned I/Os and proactively exploits SSD bandwidth to handle large and SSD-page aligned I/Os. SPDK [71] bypasses the kernel to directly submit I/O requests to NVMe SSDs in userspace, thereby reducing software overhead and maximizing SSD performance, but at the cost of reduced generality and increased CPU overhead. In addition, many GPU-centric storage solutions [43, 48, 49] enable direct access from GPU to the storage device via NVMe queues to expand GPU memory. In comparison, WSBuffer enables mainstream buffered I/O to directly benefit from high SSD bandwidth, while retaining all advantages of buffered I/O.

主动利用 SSD 性能. NHC [67] 将过量负载转到低层存储以利用其带宽. OrchFS [73] 用 NVM 接收未对齐 I/O, 让 SSD 处理大且按设备页对齐的访问. SPDK [71] 绕过内核, 从用户态直接提交 NVMe 请求, 减少软件开销, 但牺牲通用性并增加 CPU 开销. 多种 GPU 存储方案 [43, 48, 49] 通过 NVMe 队列使 GPU 直接访问存储, 扩展可用空间. WSBuffer 则让主流缓冲 I/O 直接受益于 SSD 高带宽, 同时保留其优势.

Cache systems for SSDs. Most storage systems employ memory as a cache for SSDs to speedup data accesses by buffered I/O or various customized solutions [6, 9, 10, 33, 37]. In addition to memory, NVM is also widely used for SSD caching. AFCM [11] utilizes NVM to speedup synchronization operations for SSDs. P2Cache [40] leverages NVM to cache all write requests for underlying kernel file systems. Furthermore, some tiering file systems [32, 47, 66, 76] use the upper-layer NVMs as a cache to the lower-layer SSDs to absorb most workloads. In addition, CSAL [77] leverages a high-performance SSD as write buffers for a large-capacity QLC SSD. In comparison, WSBuffer focuses on buffered I/O while its insights can be applied to these systems based on a hierarchical architecture.

SSD 缓存系统. 许多系统用内存作为 SSD 缓存, 通过缓冲 I/O 或定制方案加速访问 [6, 9, 10, 33, 37]. NVM 也常用于缓存: AFCM [11] 加速同步, P2Cache [40] 缓存内核文件系统全部写入. 一些分层文件系统 [32, 47, 66, 76] 用上层 NVM 缓冲下层 SSD 的大部分负载. CSAL [77] 用高性能 SSD 缓冲大容量 QLC SSD 的写入. WSBuffer 聚焦缓冲 I/O, 其设计思路也可用于这些分层系统.

6. 结论

This paper identifies and analyzes the root causes for the failure of the current buffered I/O architecture to effectively utilize high-bandwidth SSDs. We further propose WSBuffer to rearchitect the data path of buffered I/O to proactively leverage SSD performance to enhance buffered I/O while retaining all its advantages, achieving higher performance, less memory consumption, and lower CPU utilization.

本文分析现有缓冲 I/O 无法有效利用高带宽 SSD 的根因, 提出 WSBuffer 重构数据路径, 主动利用 SSD 性能, 在保留缓冲 I/O 优势的同时提高性能, 减少内存占用和 CPU 利用率.

[77] Yanbo Zhou, Erci Xu, Li Zhang, Kapil Karkra, Mariusz Barczak, Wayne Gao, Wojciech Malikowski, Mateusz Kozlowski, Łukasz Łasek, Ruiming Lu, Feng Yang, Lilong Huang, Xiaolu Zhang, Keqiang Niu, Jiaji Zhu, and Jiesheng Wu.
