The results of our experiment are summarized in Table 1. Over the 30-minute period, Aurora was able to sustain 35 times more transactions than mirrored MySQL. The number of I/Os per transaction on the database node in Aurora was 7.7 times fewer than in mirrored MySQL despite amplifying writes six times with Aurora and not counting the chained replication within EBS nor the cross-AZ writes in MySQL. Each storage node sees unamplified writes, since it is only one of the six copies, resulting in 46 times fewer I/Os requiring processing at this tier. The savings we obtain by writing less data to the network allow us to aggressively replicate data for durability and availability and issue requests in parallel to minimize the impact of jitter.

结果见表 1. 在这 30 分钟内, Aurora 完成的事务量是镜像 MySQL 的 35 倍. 尽管 Aurora 将写入复制六份, 且比较中尚未计入 MySQL 的 EBS 内部链式复制和跨 AZ 写入, Aurora 数据库节点每事务 I/O 仍仅约为镜像 MySQL 的 1/7.7. 每个存储节点只接收六份中的一份, 因而不承受复制放大, 该层需要处理的 I/O 数约为原来的 1/46. 减少网络写入省下的资源, 让我们可以积极复制数据以提高持久性和可用性, 并行发起请求以减小抖动影响.

Moving processing to a storage service also improves availability by minimizing crash recovery time and eliminates jitter caused by background processes such as checkpointing, background data page writing and backups.

将处理下放到存储服务, 还通过缩短崩溃恢复时间提高可用性, 并消除检查点, 后台数据页写出和备份等任务引起的抖动.

Let's examine crash recovery. In a traditional database, after a crash the system must start from the most recent checkpoint and replay the log to ensure that all persisted redo records have been applied. In Aurora, durable redo record application happens at the storage tier, continuously, asynchronously, and distributed across the fleet. Any read request for a data page may require some redo records to be applied if the page is not current. As a result, the process of crash recovery is spread across all normal foreground processing. Nothing is required at database startup.

传统数据库崩溃后, 必须从最近检查点重放日志, 确保全部已持久化 redo 都已应用. Aurora 则将 redo 应用放在存储层, 持续异步执行, 并分散到整个集群. 若请求的数据页尚未追上最新状态, 读取时可能需要应用一些 redo 记录. 因此, 崩溃恢复工作被分摊到正常的前台处理之中, 数据库启动时无需集中执行这部分工作.

3.3 存储服务设计要点

A core design tenet for our storage service is to minimize the latency of the foreground write request. We move the majority of storage processing to the background. Given the natural variability between peak to average foreground requests from the storage tier, we have ample time to perform these tasks outside the foreground path. We also have the opportunity to trade CPU for disk. For example, it isn't necessary to run garbage collection (GC) of old page versions when the storage node is busy processing foreground write requests unless the disk is approaching capacity. In Aurora, background processing has negative correlation with foreground processing. This is unlike a traditional database, where background writes of pages and checkpointing have positive correlation with the foreground load on the system. If we build up a backlog on the system, we will throttle foreground activity to prevent a long queue buildup. Since segments are placed with high entropy across the various storage nodes in our system, throttling at one storage node is readily handled by our 4/6 quorum writes, appearing as a slow node.

存储服务的一项核心原则是尽量降低前台写延迟. 我们将大部分处理移到后台, 利用前台请求的峰谷差在非关键路径执行. 也可以权衡 CPU 和磁盘资源: 例如, 节点忙于前台写请求时, 除非磁盘即将写满, 否则无需立刻回收旧页版本. Aurora 的后台活动与前台活动负相关, 而传统数据库的后台页写入和检查点通常与前台负载正相关. 若积压增长, 系统会限制前台活动, 避免队列过长. 由于段高度分散在各存储节点, 单个节点限流只表现为一个慢节点, 4/6 写 quorum 可以轻松应对.

Let's examine the various activities on the storage node in more detail. As seen in Figure 4, it involves the following steps: (1) receive log record and add to an in-memory queue, (2) persist record on disk and acknowledge, (3) organize records and identify gaps in the log since some batches may be lost, (4) gossip with peers to fill in gaps, (5) coalesce log records into new data pages, (6) periodically stage log and new pages to S3, (7) periodically garbage collect old versions, and finally (8) periodically validate CRC codes on pages. Note that not only are each of the steps above asynchronous, only steps (1) and (2) are in the foreground path potentially impacting latency.

图 4 展示了存储节点的处理流程: (1) 接收日志并加入内存队列; (2) 落盘并确认; (3) 整理记录, 找出丢失批次造成的日志空洞; (4) 与同组节点通过 gossip 补齐空洞; (5) 合并日志生成新数据页; (6) 定期将日志和新页上传 S3; (7) 定期回收旧版本; (8) 定期校验页面 CRC. 这些步骤均异步执行, 只有第 1, 2 步位于可能影响延迟的前台路径.

Figure 4: IO Traffic in Aurora Storage Nodes.

图 4: Aurora 存储节点内的 I/O 流程. 只有日志接收和持久化确认处于前台, 其他处理均异步执行.

4. 日志持续向前推进

In this section, we describe how the log is generated from the database engine so that the durable state, the runtime state, and the replica state are always consistent. In particular, we will describe how consistency is implemented efficiently without an expensive 2PC protocol. First, we show how we avoid expensive redo processing on crash recovery. Next, we explain normal operation and how we maintain runtime and replica state. Finally, we provide details of our recovery process.

本节说明数据库如何生成日志, 使持久状态, 运行时状态和副本状态始终一致, 尤其是如何避免高成本的 2PC. 先说明如何避开崩溃恢复时昂贵的 redo 处理, 再介绍正常运行和运行时及副本状态维护, 最后给出恢复细节.

4.1 方案概览: 异步处理

Since we model the database as a redo log stream (as described in Section 3), we can exploit the fact that the log advances as an ordered sequence of changes. In practice, each log record has an associated Log Sequence Number (LSN) that is a monotonically increasing value generated by the database. This lets us simplify a consensus protocol for maintaining state by approaching the problem in an asynchronous fashion instead of using a protocol like 2PC which is chatty and intolerant of failures. At a high level, we maintain points of consistency and durability, and continually advance these points as we receive acknowledgements for outstanding storage requests. Since any individual storage node might have missed one or more log records, they gossip with the other members of their PG, looking for gaps and fill in the holes. The runtime state maintained by the database lets us use single segment reads rather than quorum reads except on recovery when the state is lost and has to be rebuilt.

如原文第 3 节所述, 我们将数据库建模为 redo 日志流, 因而可以利用日志按有序修改序列推进的特性. 每条记录都有数据库生成的单调递增日志序列号 (LSN). 这使我们能采用异步方式简化维护状态的共识协议, 避免通信频繁且不耐故障的 2PC. 大体而言, 系统维护一致性点和持久性点, 随未完成存储请求的确认不断推进. 单个存储节点可能漏收记录, 会与同一 PG 的其他节点 gossip, 发现并补齐空洞. 数据库维护的运行时状态允许正常情况下只读取一个段, 无需读 quorum; 只有恢复时状态丢失, 才需要重新建立.

The database may have multiple outstanding isolated transactions, which can complete (reach a finished and durable state) in a different order than initiated. Supposing the database crashes or reboots, the determination of whether to roll back is separate for each of these individual transactions. The logic for tracking partially completed transactions and undoing them is kept in the database engine, just as if it were writing to simple disks. However, upon restart, before the database is allowed to access the storage volume, the storage service does its own recovery which is focused not on user-level transactions, but on making sure that the database sees a uniform view of storage despite its distributed nature.

数据库可能同时运行多个相互隔离的事务, 它们到达完成且持久化状态的顺序, 可以与启动顺序不同. 若数据库崩溃或重启, 是否回滚要对每个事务分别判断. 跟踪未完成事务并撤销它们的逻辑仍留在数据库引擎中, 就像底层只是普通磁盘一样. 不过, 重启后数据库访问卷之前, 存储服务会先执行自身恢复. 它不关心用户级事务, 而是确保数据库面对分布式存储时, 仍能看到统一视图.

The storage service determines the highest LSN for which it can guarantee availability of all prior log records (this is known as the VCL or Volume Complete LSN). During storage recovery, every log record with an LSN larger than the VCL must be truncated. The database can, however, further constrain a subset of points that are allowable for truncation by tagging log records and identifying them as CPLs or Consistency Point LSNs. We therefore define VDL or the Volume Durable LSN as the highest CPL that is smaller than or equal to VCL and truncate all log records with LSN greater than the VDL. For example, even if we have the complete data up to LSN 1007, the database may have declared that only 900, 1000, and 1100 are CPLs, in which case, we must truncate at 1000. We are complete to 1007, but only durable to 1000.

存储服务找出一个最高 LSN, 保证其之前的全部日志都可用, 称为卷完整 LSN (Volume Complete LSN, VCL). 存储恢复必须截断 VCL 之后的记录. 数据库还可以标记允许截断的位置, 即一致性点 LSN (Consistency Point LSN, CPL). 卷持久 LSN (Volume Durable LSN, VDL) 因而定义为不大于 VCL 的最高 CPL, 并截断 VDL 之后的全部记录. 例如, 日志虽完整到 1007, 但 CPL 只有 900, 1000 和 1100, 则必须在 1000 处截断: 完整到 1007, 但只持久到 1000.

Completeness and durability are therefore different and a CPL can be thought of as delineating some limited form of storage system transaction that must be accepted in order. If the client has no use for such distinctions, it can simply mark every log record as a CPL. In practice, the database and storage interact as follows:

完整性与持久性因此不同. CPL 可以视为一种受限存储事务的边界, 这些事务必须按顺序接受. 客户端若不需要区分, 可以将每条日志都标为 CPL. 实际上, 数据库与存储按以下方式协作:

1. Each database-level transaction is broken up into multiple mini-transactions (MTRs) that are ordered and must be performed atomically.

1. 每个数据库级事务拆成多个有序的小事务 (mini-transaction, MTR), 每个 MTR 必须原子执行.

2. Each mini-transaction is composed of multiple contiguous log records (as many as needed).

2. 每个 MTR 由若干连续日志记录组成, 数量按需确定.

3. The final log record in a mini-transaction is a CPL.

3. 每个 MTR 的最后一条日志是 CPL.

On recovery, the database talks to the storage service to establish the durable point of each PG and uses that to establish the VDL and then issue commands to truncate the log records above VDL.

恢复时, 数据库与存储服务交互, 确定各 PG 的持久点, 由此确定 VDL, 再发出命令截断 VDL 之后的日志.

4.2 正常运行

We now describe the "normal operation" of the database engine and focus in turn on writes, reads, commits, and replicas.

下面依次介绍正常运行中的写入, 提交, 读取和副本处理.

4.2.1 写入

In Aurora, the database continuously interacts with the storage service and maintains state to establish quorum, advance volume durability, and register transactions as committed. For instance, in the normal/forward path, as the database receives acknowledgements to establish the write quorum for each batch of log records, it advances the current VDL.

数据库持续与存储服务交互, 维护用于建立 quorum, 推进卷持久性和确认事务提交的状态. 例如, 正常处理过程中, 某批日志收到足够确认, 满足写 quorum 后, 数据库就推进当前 VDL.

At any given moment, there can be a large number of concurrent transactions active in the database, each generating their own redo log records. The database allocates a unique ordered LSN for each log record subject to a constraint that no LSN is allocated with a value that is greater than the sum of the current VDL and a constant called the LSN Allocation Limit (LAL) (currently set to 10 million). This limit ensures that the database does not get too far ahead of the storage system and introduces back-pressure that can throttle the incoming writes if the storage or network cannot keep up.

任意时刻都可能有大量事务并发生成 redo 日志. 数据库为每条记录分配唯一有序 LSN, 但不得超过当前 VDL 加上 LSN 分配上限 (LSN Allocation Limit, LAL); LAL 当前为 1000 万. 这防止数据库领先存储过多, 并在存储或网络跟不上时形成背压, 限制新写入.

Note that each segment of each PG only sees a subset of log records in the volume that affect the pages residing on that segment. Each log record contains a backlink that identifies the previous log record for that PG. These backlinks can be used to track the point of completeness of the log records that have reached each segment to establish a Segment Complete LSN (SCL) that identifies the greatest LSN below which all log records of the PG have been received. The SCL is used by the storage nodes when they gossip with each other in order to find and exchange log records that they are missing.

每个 PG 的各段只接收卷日志中影响本段页面的子集. 每条日志包含一个反向链接, 指向该 PG 的前一条记录. 节点据此追踪日志完整进度, 得到段完整 LSN (Segment Complete LSN, SCL), 表示该 PG 日志已经完整接收的最高位置. 存储节点 gossip 时利用 SCL 发现并交换缺失记录.

4.2.2 提交

In Aurora, transaction commits are completed asynchronously. When a client commits a transaction, the thread handling the commit request sets the transaction aside by recording its "commit LSN" as part of a separate list of transactions waiting on commit and moves on to perform other work. The equivalent to the WAL protocol is based on completing a commit, if and only if, the latest VDL is greater than or equal to the transaction's commit LSN. As the VDL advances, the database identifies qualifying transactions that are waiting to be committed and uses a dedicated thread to send commit acknowledgements to waiting clients. Worker threads do not pause for commits, they simply pull other pending requests and continue processing.

事务提交异步完成. 客户端提交时, 处理线程将事务及其提交 LSN 放入独立的待提交列表, 然后继续处理其他工作. 等价于 WAL 的规则是: 当且仅当最新 VDL 不小于事务提交 LSN 时, 才完成提交. 随 VDL 推进, 数据库找到满足条件的事务, 由专门线程向等待的客户端发送确认. 工作线程不会停下来等待提交, 而是继续领取其他请求.

4.2.3 读取

In Aurora, as with most databases, pages are served from the buffer cache and only result in a storage IO request if the page in question is not present in the cache. If the buffer cache is full, the system finds a victim page to evict from the cache. In a traditional system, if the victim is a "dirty page" then it is flushed to disk before replacement. This is to ensure that a subsequent fetch of the page always results in the latest data. While the Aurora database does not write out pages on eviction (or anywhere else), it enforces a similar guarantee: a page in the buffer cache must always be of the latest version. The guarantee is implemented by evicting a page from the cache only if its "page LSN" (identifying the log record associated with the latest change to the page) is greater than or equal to the VDL. This protocol ensures that: (a) all changes in the page have been hardened in the log, and (b) on a cache miss, it is sufficient to request a version of the page as of the current VDL to get its latest durable version.

与多数数据库一样, Aurora 优先从缓冲缓存提供页面, 未命中才发起存储 I/O. 缓存已满时, 系统选择牺牲页淘汰. 传统系统若选中脏页, 会先刷盘, 确保以后读回最新数据. Aurora 淘汰页面时不写出数据页, 其他路径也不写, 但仍要求缓冲缓存中的页始终是最新版本. 原文将淘汰条件写为: 页 LSN, 即该页最新修改对应的日志位置, 大于或等于 VDL 才能淘汰. 原文称该协议保证: (a) 页中所有修改已在日志中持久化; (b) 缓存未命中时, 按当前 VDL 请求页面即可取得最新持久版本.

Translator's note: The paper says page LSN >= VDL, but the stated durability guarantee requires page LSN <= VDL. This is an apparent reversed inequality in the source; its wording is retained above.

译者校注: 原文将条件写作 page LSN >= VDL, 但若要保证页的全部修改已持久化, 应要求 page LSN <= VDL. 这里疑似不等号方向写反. 上文保留原文说法, 实现时不能据此采用相反条件.

The database does not need to establish consensus using a read quorum under normal circumstances. When reading a page from disk, the database establishes a read-point, representing the VDL at the time the request was issued. The database can then select a storage node that is complete with respect to the read point, knowing that it will therefore receive an up to date version. A page that is returned by the storage node must be consistent with the expected semantics of a mini-transaction (MTR) in the database. Since the database directly manages feeding log records to storage nodes and tracking progress (that is, the SCL of each segment), it normally knows which segment is capable of satisfying a read (the segments whose SCL is greater than the read-point) and thus can issue a read request directly to a segment that has sufficient data.

正常情况下, 数据库无需通过读 quorum 达成共识. 读取磁盘页时, 先确定读取点, 即发出请求时的 VDL, 再选择已完整接收到该位置的存储节点, 确保获得最新版本. 返回页必须满足 MTR 的一致性语义. 数据库直接向节点发送日志并跟踪各段 SCL, 因而通常知道哪些段能满足读取, 即 SCL 大于读取点的段, 可以直接请求一个数据足够完整的段.

Given that the database is aware of all outstanding reads, it can compute at any time the Minimum Read Point LSN on a per-PG basis. If there are read replicas the writer gossips with them to establish the per-PG Minimum Read Point LSN across all nodes. This value is called the Protection Group Min Read Point LSN (PGMRPL) and represents the "low water mark" below which all the log records of the PG are unnecessary. In other words, a storage node segment is guaranteed that there will be no read page requests with a read-point that is lower than the PGMRPL. Each storage node is aware of the PGMRPL from the database and can, therefore, advance the materialized pages on disk by coalescing the older log records and then safely garbage collecting them.

数据库知道全部未完成读取, 因而可随时按 PG 计算最小读取点 LSN. 若有只读副本, 写入实例还会与它们 gossip, 求得所有实例上的每 PG 最小读取点, 称为保护组最小读取点 LSN (PGMRPL). 它是一个低水位: 系统保证不会再有读取点低于它的请求. 存储节点获知 PGMRPL 后, 可以将更早日志合并到磁盘物化页, 推进页面状态, 再安全回收这些旧日志.

The actual concurrency control protocols are executed in the database engine exactly as though the database pages and undo segments are organized in local storage as with traditional MySQL.

并发控制仍完全由数据库引擎执行, 就像传统 MySQL 中的数据页和 undo 段都组织在本地存储上一样.

4.2.4 副本

In Aurora, a single writer and up to 15 read replicas can all mount a single shared storage volume. As a result, read replicas add no additional costs in terms of consumed storage or disk write operations. To minimize lag, the log stream generated by the writer and sent to the storage nodes is also sent to all read replicas. In the reader, the database consumes this log stream by considering each log record in turn. If the log record refers to a page in the reader's buffer cache, it uses the log applicator to apply the specified redo operation to the page in the cache. Otherwise it simply discards the log record. Note that the replicas consume log records asynchronously from the perspective of the writer, which acknowledges user commits independent of the replica. The replica obeys the following two important rules while applying log records: (a) the only log records that will be applied are those whose LSN is less than or equal to the VDL, and (b) the log records that are part of a single mini-transaction are applied atomically in the replica's cache to ensure that the replica sees a consistent view of all database objects. In practice, each replica typically lags behind the writer by a short interval (20 ms or less).

一个写入实例与最多 15 个只读副本可以挂载同一共享卷, 因而增加只读副本不会额外消耗存储空间或磁盘写操作. 为降低延迟, 写入实例向存储节点发送日志的同时, 也将日志流发给全部只读副本. 副本逐条处理: 若目标页在本地缓冲缓存中, 就应用 redo; 否则丢弃记录. 从写入实例看, 副本消费是异步的, 用户提交确认不等待它们. 副本必须遵守两条规则: 只应用 LSN 不大于 VDL 的记录; 同一 MTR 的全部记录在副本缓存中原子应用, 保证数据库对象的一致视图. 实际中, 副本通常只落后写入实例 20 ms 或更短.

4.3 恢复

Most traditional databases use a recovery protocol such as ARIES [7] that depends on the presence of a write-ahead log (WAL) that can represent the precise contents of all committed transactions. These systems also periodically checkpoint the database to establish points of durability in a coarse-grained fashion by flushing dirty pages to disk and writing a checkpoint record to the log. On restart, any given page can either miss some committed data or contain uncommitted data. Therefore, on crash recovery the system processes the redo log records since the last checkpoint by using the log applicator to apply each log record to the relevant database page. This process brings the database pages to a consistent state at the point of failure after which the in-flight transactions during the crash can be rolled back by executing the relevant undo log records. Crash recovery can be an expensive operation. Reducing the checkpoint interval helps, but at the expense of interference with foreground transactions. No such tradeoff is required with Aurora.

多数传统数据库采用 ARIES [7] 一类恢复协议, 依赖能准确表达全部已提交事务内容的 WAL. 系统定期将脏页刷盘并写入检查点记录, 以较粗粒度建立持久点. 重启时, 页面既可能缺少已提交数据, 也可能包含未提交数据. 因而崩溃恢复要从最近检查点开始应用 redo, 将页面恢复到故障时的一致状态, 然后通过 undo 撤销崩溃时仍在进行的事务. 恢复成本可能很高. 缩短检查点间隔有帮助, 却会增加对前台事务的干扰. Aurora 无需作这种取舍.

A great simplifying principle of a traditional database is that the same redo log applicator is used in the forward processing path as well as on recovery where it operates synchronously and in the foreground while the database is offline. We rely on the same principle in Aurora as well, except that the redo log applicator is decoupled from the database and operates on storage nodes, in parallel, and all the time in the background. Once the database starts up it performs volume recovery in collaboration with the storage service and as a result, an Aurora database can recover very quickly (generally under 10 seconds) even if it crashed while processing over 100,000 write statements per second.

传统数据库的一项简化原则是: 正常处理与恢复使用同一个 redo 日志应用器, 但恢复时数据库离线, 日志应用在前台同步执行. Aurora 沿用同一原则, 只是将应用器从数据库中解耦, 放到存储节点持续后台并行运行. 启动时数据库与存储服务协作完成卷恢复, 因而即使崩溃前每秒处理超过 100,000 条写语句, 通常也能在 10 秒内恢复.

The database does need to reestablish its runtime state after a crash. In this case, it contacts for each PG, a read quorum of segments which is sufficient to guarantee discovery of any data that could have reached a write quorum. Once the database has established a read quorum for every PG it can recalculate the VDL above which data is truncated by generating a truncation range that annuls every log record after the new VDL, up to and including an end LSN which the database can prove is at least as high as the highest possible outstanding log record that could ever have been seen. The database infers this upper bound because it allocates LSNs, and limits how far allocation can occur above VDL (the 10 million limit described earlier). The truncation ranges are versioned with epoch numbers, and written durably to the storage service so that there is no confusion over the durability of truncations in case recovery is interrupted and restarted.

崩溃后仍需重建运行时状态. 数据库会对每个 PG 联系达到读 quorum 数量的段, 足以发现任何可能已达到写 quorum 的数据. 获得所有 PG 的读 quorum 后, 重新计算 VDL, 并生成截断区间, 使新 VDL 之后直到某个末端 LSN 的全部记录失效. 数据库能够证明, 这个末端不低于任何可能已经发出的日志记录, 因为 LSN 由它分配, 且分配位置不能超过 VDL 太远, 即前述 1000 万上限. 截断区间带有 epoch 版本号并持久化到存储服务, 即使恢复中断再重启, 也不会混淆截断是否已持久完成.

The database still needs to perform undo recovery to unwind the operations of in-flight transactions at the time of the crash. However, undo recovery can happen when the database is online after the system builds the list of these in-flight transactions from the undo segments.

数据库仍需 undo 恢复, 撤销崩溃时未完成事务的操作. 但从 undo 段建立这些事务的列表后, undo 恢复可以在线执行.

5. 整体架构

In this section, we describe the building blocks of Aurora as shown with a bird's eye view in Figure 5.

本节结合图 5 的全局视图, 介绍 Aurora 的组成模块.

Figure 5: Aurora Architecture: A Bird's Eye View.

图 5: Aurora 架构全貌: 客户 VPC, RDS VPC 与存储 VPC 分离, 数据库实例连接共享存储和 S3 备份服务.

The database engine is a fork of "community" MySQL/InnoDB and diverges primarily in how InnoDB reads and writes data to disk. In community InnoDB, a write operation results in data being modified in buffer pages, and the associated redo log records written to buffers of the WAL in LSN order. On transaction commit, the WAL protocol requires only that the redo log records of the transaction are durably written to disk. The actual modified buffer pages are also written to disk eventually through a double-write technique to avoid partial page writes. These page writes take place in the background, or during eviction from the cache, or while taking a checkpoint. In addition to the IO Subsystem, InnoDB also includes the transaction subsystem, the lock manager, a B+-Tree implementation and the associated notion of a "mini transaction" (MTR). An MTR is a construct only used inside InnoDB and models groups of operations that must be executed atomically (for example, split/merge of B+-Tree pages).

数据库引擎基于社区版 MySQL/InnoDB 分支开发, 主要区别在 InnoDB 如何读写磁盘. 社区版写入会修改缓冲页, 并按 LSN 顺序将 redo 写到 WAL 缓冲区. 提交时, WAL 协议只要求相关 redo 已持久落盘. 修改后的页最终也要写出, 并通过双写避免部分页写入, 发生在后台, 缓存淘汰或检查点期间. 除 I/O 子系统外, InnoDB 还包括事务子系统, 锁管理器, B+ 树及其小事务 MTR. MTR 仅供 InnoDB 内部使用, 表示必须原子执行的一组操作, 例如 B+ 树页面分裂或合并.

In the Aurora InnoDB variant, the redo log records representing the changes that must be executed atomically in each MTR are organized into batches that are sharded by the PGs each log record belongs to, and these batches are written to the storage service. The final log record of each MTR is tagged as a consistency point. Aurora supports exactly the same isolation levels that are supported by community MySQL in the writer (the standard ANSI levels and Snapshot Isolation or consistent reads). Aurora read replicas get continuous information on transaction starts and commits in the writer and use this information to support snapshot isolation for local transactions that are of course read-only. Note that concurrency control is implemented entirely in the database engine without impacting the storage service. The storage service presents a unified view of the underlying data that is logically identical to what you would get by writing the data to local storage in community InnoDB.

Aurora 的 InnoDB 将每个 MTR 的 redo 按所属 PG 分批, 写入存储服务, 最后一条记录标记为一致性点. 写入实例支持与社区 MySQL 相同的隔离级别, 包括标准 ANSI 级别以及快照隔离或一致性读. 只读副本持续接收写入实例上的事务开始与提交信息, 用来为本地只读事务提供快照隔离. 并发控制全部位于引擎, 不影响存储服务. 存储呈现的统一数据视图, 在逻辑上与社区 InnoDB 写入本地存储所得视图相同.

Aurora leverages Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for its control plane. RDS includes an agent on the database instance called the Host Manager (HM) that monitors a cluster's health and determines if it needs to fail over, or if an instance needs to be replaced. Each database instance is part of a cluster that consists of a single writer and zero or more read replicas. The instances of a cluster are in a single geographical region (for example, us-east-1, us-west-1 etc.), are typically placed in different AZs, and connect to a storage fleet in the same region. For security, we isolate the communication between the database, applications and storage. In practice, each database instance can communicate on three Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networks: the customer VPC through which customer applications interact with the engine, the RDS VPC through which the database engine and control plane interact with each other, and the Storage VPC through which the database interacts with storage services.

Aurora 采用 Amazon RDS 作为控制平面. 数据库实例上的 Host Manager (HM) 代理监测集群健康, 判断是否故障切换或替换实例. 每个集群包含一个写入实例和零个或多个只读副本, 均位于同一地理区域, 如 us-east-1 或 us-west-1, 通常分散在不同 AZ, 并连接同区域存储集群. 为保证安全, 应用, 数据库与存储之间的通信相互隔离. 每个实例通过三套 VPC 通信: 客户 VPC 承载应用访问, RDS VPC 承载引擎与控制平面交互, Storage VPC 承载数据库与存储服务交互.

The storage service is deployed on a cluster of EC2 VMs that are provisioned across at least 3 AZs in each region and is collectively responsible for provisioning multiple customer storage volumes, reading and writing data to and from those volumes, and backing up and restoring data from and to those volumes. The storage nodes manipulate local SSDs and interact with database engine instances, other peer storage nodes, and the backup/restore services that continuously backup changed data to S3 and restore data from S3 as needed. The storage control plane uses the Amazon DynamoDB database service for persistent storage of cluster and storage volume configuration, volume metadata, and a detailed description of data backed up to S3. For orchestrating long-running operations, e.g. a database volume restore operation or a repair (re-replication) operation following a storage node failure, the storage control plane uses the Amazon Simple Workflow Service. Maintaining a high level of availability requires pro-active, automated, and early detection of real and potential problems, before end users are impacted. All critical aspects of storage operations are constantly monitored using metric collection services that raise alarms if key performance or availability metrics indicate a cause for concern.

存储服务由跨至少三个 AZ 的 EC2 虚拟机集群承载, 负责配置多个客户卷, 读写卷数据, 以及备份与恢复. 节点管理本地 SSD, 与引擎实例, 同组存储节点及备份恢复服务通信; 后者持续将变更备份到 S3, 并按需恢复. 存储控制平面通过 DynamoDB 持久保存集群和卷配置, 卷元数据, 以及 S3 备份数据的详细描述. 卷恢复或节点故障后的重新复制等长任务, 由 Amazon Simple Workflow Service 编排. 高可用要求在用户受影响前, 主动, 自动, 尽早识别实际与潜在问题. 因而系统持续采集关键存储指标, 性能或可用性指标出现异常迹象时发出告警.

6. 性能结果

In this section, we will share our experiences in running Aurora as a production service that was made "Generally Available" in July 2015. We begin with a summary of results running industry standard benchmarks and then present some performance results from our customers.

本节分享 Aurora 自 2015 年 7 月正式可用以来的生产经验, 先介绍行业标准基准结果, 再展示客户性能数据.

6.1 标准基准测试

Here we present results of different experiments that compare the performance of Aurora and MySQL using industry standard benchmarks such as SysBench and TPC-C variants. We ran MySQL on instances that are attached to an EBS volume with 30K provisioned IOPS. Except when stated otherwise, these are r3.8xlarge EC2 instances with 32 vCPUs and 244GB of memory and features the Intel Xeon E5-2670 v2 (Ivy Bridge) processors. The buffer cache on the r3.8xlarge is set to 170GB.

我们使用 SysBench 和 TPC-C 变体等标准基准比较 Aurora 与 MySQL. MySQL 挂载预置 30,000 IOPS 的 EBS 卷. 除非另有说明, 测试使用 r3.8xlarge EC2 实例, 配备 32 个 vCPU, 244 GB 内存和 Intel Xeon E5-2670 v2 (Ivy Bridge) 处理器, 缓冲缓存设为 170 GB.

6.1.1 随实例规格扩展

In this experiment, we report that throughput in Aurora can scale linearly with instance sizes, and with the highest instance size can be 5x that of MySQL 5.6 and MySQL 5.7. Note that Aurora is currently based on the MySQL 5.6 code base. We ran the SysBench read-only and write-only benchmarks for a 1GB data set (250 tables) on 5 EC2 instances of the r3 family (large, xlarge, 2xlarge, 4xlarge, 8xlarge). Each instance size has exactly half the vCPUs and memory of the immediately larger instance.

这一实验表明, Aurora 吞吐量可随实例规格线性增长, 最大规格下达到 MySQL 5.6 和 5.7 的约 5 倍. 当时 Aurora 基于 MySQL 5.6. 我们在 r3 系列的 large, xlarge, 2xlarge, 4xlarge 和 8xlarge 五种规格上, 对 1 GB, 250 张表的数据集运行 SysBench 只读和只写测试. 每一档的 vCPU 和内存恰为上一档的两倍.

The results are shown in Figure 7 and Figure 6, and measure the performance in terms of write and read statements per second respectively. Aurora's performance doubles for each higher instance size and for the r3.8xlarge achieves 121,000 writes/sec and 600,000 reads/sec which is 5x that of MySQL 5.7 which tops out at 20,000 reads/sec and 125,000 writes/sec.

6.2.3 多副本延迟

MySQL replicas often lag significantly behind their writers and can "can cause strange bugs" as reported by Weiner at Pinterest [40]. For the education technology company described earlier, the replica lag often spiked to 12 minutes and impacted application correctness and so the replica was only useful as a stand by. In contrast, after migrating to Aurora, the maximum replica lag across 4 replicas never exceeded 20ms as shown in Figure 11. The improved replica lag provided by Aurora let the company divert a significant portion of their application load to the replicas saving costs and increasing availability.

7. 经验总结

We have now seen a large variety of applications run by customers ranging from small internet companies all the way to highly sophisticated organizations operating large numbers of Aurora clusters. While many of their use cases are standard, we focus on scenarios and expectations that are common in the cloud and are leading us to new directions.

客户涵盖小型互联网公司, 到运行大量 Aurora 集群的成熟组织, 应用类型也十分丰富. 许多用法很常规, 本节重点讨论云环境中常见, 且推动我们探索新方向的场景与期望.

7.1 多租户与数据库整合

Many of our customers operate Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) businesses, either exclusively or with some residual on-premise customers they are trying to move to their SaaS model. We find that these customers often rely on an application they cannot easily change. Therefore, they typically consolidate their different customers on a single instance by using a schema/database as a unit of tenancy. This idiom reduces costs: they avoid paying for a dedicated instance per customer when it is unlikely that all of their customers active at once. For instance, some of our SaaS customers report having more than 50,000 customers of their own.

许多客户经营 SaaS 业务, 有的已完全采用这一模式, 有的还在将剩余本地部署客户迁入 SaaS. 他们往往依赖难以修改的应用, 因而以 schema 或 database 作为租户单位, 将不同客户整合到同一实例. 由于所有客户不太可能同时活跃, 这种做法避免为每位客户支付专用实例费用. 例如, 有些 SaaS 客户自己的客户数超过 50,000.

This model is markedly different from well-known multi-tenant applications like Salesforce.com [14] which use a multi-tenant data model and pack the data of multiple customers into unified tables of a single schema with tenancy identified on a per-row basis. As a result, we see many customers with consolidated databases containing a large number of tables. Production instances of over 150,000 tables for small database are quite common. This puts pressure on components that manage metadata like the dictionary cache. More importantly, such customers need (a) to sustain a high level of throughput and many concurrent user connections, (b) a model where data is only provisioned and paid for as it is used since it is hard to anticipate in advance how much storage space is needed, and (c) reduced jitter so that spikes for a single tenant have minimal impact on other tenants. Aurora supports these attributes and fits such SaaS applications very well.

这与 Salesforce.com [14] 等知名多租户应用很不同, 后者采用多租户数据模型, 将多个客户数据放入同一 schema 的统一表中, 按行标识租户. 我们因此看到很多整合数据库包含海量表, 甚至数据量不大的生产实例也常有超过 150,000 张表, 给字典缓存等元数据组件造成压力. 更重要的是, 这些客户需要高吞吐和大量并发连接, 随使用量配置和付费的存储, 以及更低抖动, 使单租户尖峰尽量不影响其他租户. Aurora 提供这些能力, 很适合此类 SaaS 应用.

7.2 高并发自动扩缩负载

Internet workloads often need to deal with spikes in traffic based on sudden unexpected events. One of our major customers had a special appearance in a highly popular nationally televised show and experienced one such spike that greatly surpassed their normal peak throughput without stressing the database. To support such spikes, it is important for a database to handle many concurrent connections. This approach is feasible in Aurora since the underlying storage system scales so well. We have several customers that run at over 8000 connections per second.

互联网负载常因突发事件出现流量尖峰. 一位重要客户亮相全国热门电视节目后, 流量远超平时峰值, 数据库却未因此承压. 要支撑此类尖峰, 数据库必须能处理大量并发连接; Aurora 的底层存储扩展性使之可行. 我们已有若干客户每秒连接数超过 8000.

7.3 模式演进

Modern web application frameworks such as Ruby on Rails deeply integrate object-relational mapping tools. As a result, it is easy for application developers to make many schema changes to their database making it challenging for DBAs to manage how the schema evolves. In Rails applications, these are called "DB Migrations" and we have heard first-hand accounts of DBAs that have to either deal with a "few dozen migrations a week", or put in place hedging strategies to ensure that future migrations take place without pain. The situation is exacerbated with MySQL offering liberal schema evolution semantics and implementing most changes using a full table copy. Since frequent DDL is a pragmatic reality, we have implemented an efficient online DDL implementation that (a) versions schemas on a per-page basis and decodes individual pages on demand using their schema history, and (b) lazily upgrades individual pages to the latest schema using a modify-on-write primitive.

Ruby on Rails 等现代 Web 框架深度集成 ORM, 开发者容易频繁变更数据库模式, DBA 管理演进因而更困难. Rails 将这些变更称为 DB Migrations. 我们听到 DBA 每周要应对数十次迁移, 或提前采取防护措施, 确保未来迁移顺利. MySQL 允许灵活的模式演进, 却对多数变更采用整表复制, 进一步加剧问题. 既然频繁 DDL 已是现实, 我们实现了高效在线 DDL: 按页记录模式版本, 根据模式历史按需解码页面, 并通过写时修改机制, 延迟将各页升级到最新模式.

7.4 可用性与软件升级

Our customers have demanding expectations of cloud-native databases that can conflict with how we operate the fleet and how often we patch servers. Since our customers use Aurora primarily as an OLTP service backing production applications, any disruption can be traumatic. As a result, many of our customers have a very low tolerance to our updates of database software, even if this amounts to a planned downtime of 30 seconds every 6 weeks or so. Therefore, we recently released a new Zero-Downtime Patch (ZDP) feature that allows us to patch a customer while in-flight database connections are unaffected.

客户对云原生数据库的可用性要求, 有时与集群运维及补丁频率冲突. Aurora 主要支撑生产 OLTP 应用, 任何中断都可能造成严重影响. 即使约每六周仅有一次计划内 30 秒停机, 许多客户仍难以接受. 因此, 我们近期推出零停机补丁 (Zero-Downtime Patch, ZDP), 使打补丁不影响现有数据库连接.

As shown in Figure 12, ZDP works by looking for an instant where there are no active transactions, and in that instant spooling the application state to local ephemeral storage, patching the engine and then reloading the application state. In the process, user sessions remain active and oblivious that the engine changed under the covers.

如图 12 所示, ZDP 等待没有活动事务的瞬间, 将应用状态暂存到本地临时存储, 更新引擎, 再加载状态. 整个过程中用户会话保持活跃, 无需感知底层引擎已替换.

Figure 12: Zero-Downtime Patching.

图 12: 零停机补丁: 保留会话与应用状态, 替换底层引擎后重新加载状态.

8. 相关工作

In this section, we discuss other contributions and how they relate to the approaches taken in Aurora.

本节讨论相关研究及其与 Aurora 方法的关系.

Decoupling storage from compute. Although traditional systems have usually been built as monolithic daemons [27], there has been recent work on databases that decompose the kernel into different components. For instance, Deuteronomy [10] is one such system that separates a Transaction Component (TC) that provides concurrency control and recovery from a Data Component (DC) that provides access methods on top of LLAMA [34], a latch-free log-structured cache and storage manager. Sinfonia [39] and Hyder [38] are systems that abstract transactional access methods over a scale out service and database systems can be implemented using these abstractions. The Yesquel [36] system implements a multi-version distributed balanced tree and separates concurrency control from the query processor. Aurora decouples storage at a level lower than that of Deuteronomy, Hyder, Sinfonia, and Yesquel. In Aurora, query processing, transactions, concurrency, buffer cache, and access methods are decoupled from logging, storage, and recovery that are implemented as a scale out service.

计算与存储解耦. 传统系统多采用单体进程 [27], 近期一些数据库研究则将内核分解成多个组件. 例如, Deuteronomy [10] 将提供并发控制和恢复的事务组件 TC, 与提供访问方法的数据组件 DC 分离, 后者基于无闩锁的日志结构化缓存与存储管理器 LLAMA [34]. Sinfonia [39] 和 Hyder [38] 在横向扩展服务上提供事务访问抽象, 数据库可据此构建. Yesquel [36] 实现多版本分布式平衡树, 并将并发控制与查询处理分离. Aurora 的拆分层次比这些系统更低: 查询, 事务, 并发, 缓冲缓存和访问方法留在引擎, 日志, 存储和恢复则成为横向扩展服务.

Distributed Systems. The trade-offs between correctness and availability in the face of partitions have long been known with the major result that one-copy serializability is not possible in the face of network partitions [15]. More recently Brewer's CAP Theorem as proved in [16] stated that a highly available system cannot provide "strong" consistency guarantees in the presence of network partitions. These results and our experience with cloud-scale complex and correlated failures motivated our consistency goals even in the presence of partitions caused by an AZ failure.

分布式系统. 网络分区时正确性与可用性之间的取舍早已为人所知, 重要结论是分区下无法同时维持相应可用性要求与单副本可串行化 [15]. 后来, 文献 [16] 证明 Brewer 的 CAP 定理: 高可用系统无法在网络分区下提供强一致性保证. 这些结果, 加上云规模复杂相关故障的经验, 促使我们明确包括 AZ 故障所致分区在内的一致性目标.

Bailis et al [12] study the problem of providing Highly Available Transactions (HATs) that neither suffer unavailability during partitions nor incur high network latency. They show that Serializability, Snapshot Isolation and Repeatable Read isolation are not HAT-compliant, while most other isolation levels are achievable with high availability. Aurora provides all these isolation levels by making a simplifying assumption that at any time there is only a single writer generating log updates with LSNs allocated from a single ordered domain.

Bailis 等 [12] 研究高可用事务 (HAT), 要求事务既不因分区而不可用, 也不承担高网络延迟. 他们指出, 可串行化, 快照隔离和可重复读不满足 HAT 要求, 多数其他隔离级别则可实现高可用. Aurora 通过简化假设提供上述全部隔离级别: 任意时刻只有一个写入实例生成日志, LSN 来自同一有序域. 译者注: 单写者并不意味着绕过 CAP 或 HAT 限制; 前文要求写入达到 4/6 quorum, 无法满足该条件时仍不能完成写入.

Google's Spanner [24] provides externally consistent [25] reads and writes, and globally-consistent reads across the database at a timestamp. These features enable Spanner to support consistent backups, consistent distributed query processing [26], and atomic schema updates, all at global scale, and even in the presence of ongoing transactions. As explained by Bailis [12], Spanner is highly specialized for Google's read-heavy workload and relies on two-phase commit and two-phase locking for read/write transactions.

Google Spanner [24] 提供具有外部一致性 [25] 的读写, 以及指定时间戳上的全数据库一致读取. 因而即使事务持续运行, 也能在全球范围执行一致备份, 一致分布式查询 [26] 和原子模式更新. 按本文对 Bailis [12] 的引用, Spanner 针对 Google 读密集型负载进行了专门设计, 读写事务依赖两阶段提交和两阶段锁.

Concurrency Control. Weaker consistency (PACELC [17]) and isolation models [18] [20] are well known in distributed databases and have led to optimistic replication techniques [19] as well as eventually consistent systems [21] [22] [23]. Other approaches in centralized systems range from classic pessimistic schemes based on locking [28], optimistic schemes like multi-versioned concurrency control in Hekaton [29], sharded approaches such as VoltDB [30] and Timestamp ordering in HyPer [31] [32] and Deuteronomy. Aurora's storage service provides the database engine the abstraction of a local disk that is durably persisted, and allows the engine to determine isolation and concurrency control.

并发控制. 分布式数据库中的较弱一致性模型, 如 PACELC [17], 以及隔离模型 [18, 20] 已有大量研究, 催生了乐观复制 [19] 和最终一致性系统 [21, 22, 23]. 集中式系统则有基于锁的经典悲观方案 [28], Hekaton 的多版本乐观方案 [29], VoltDB 的分片方案 [30], 以及 HyPer [31, 32] 和 Deuteronomy 的时间戳排序. Aurora 存储服务提供持久本地磁盘式抽象, 将隔离与并发控制交给数据库引擎.

Log-structured storage. Log-structured storage systems were introduced by LFS [33] in 1992. More recently Deuteronomy and the associated work in LLAMA [34] and Bw-Tree [35] use log-structured techniques in multiple ways across the storage engine stack and, like Aurora, reduce write amplification by writing deltas instead of whole pages. Both Deuteronomy and Aurora implement pure redo logging, and keep track of the highest stable LSN for acknowledging commits.

日志结构化存储. LFS [33] 于 1992 年提出日志结构化存储. 后来的 Deuteronomy, LLAMA [34] 和 Bw-Tree [35] 在存储栈多个层次采用这类技术, 与 Aurora 一样, 通过写差量而不是整页降低写放大. Deuteronomy 和 Aurora 都实现纯 redo 日志, 并跟踪最高稳定 LSN 来确认提交.

Recovery. While traditional databases rely on a recovery protocol based on ARIES [5], some recent systems have chosen other paths for performance. For example, Hekaton and VoltDB rebuild their in-memory state after a crash using some form of an update log. Systems like Sinfonia [39] avoid recovery by using techniques like process pairs and state machine replication. Graefe [41] describes a system with per-page log record chains that enables on-demand page-by-page redo that can make recovery fast. Like Aurora, Deuteronomy does not require redo recovery. This is because Deuteronomy delays transactions so that only committed updates are posted to durable storage. As a result, unlike Aurora, the size of transactions can be constrained in Deuteronomy.

恢复. 传统数据库依赖 ARIES 类协议, 原文此处引用为 [5]; 一些新系统则为性能选择其他路线. Hekaton 和 VoltDB 通过某种更新日志在崩溃后重建内存状态, Sinfonia [39] 等通过进程对和状态机复制避免恢复. Graefe [41] 描述了按页日志链, 可按需逐页 redo, 加快恢复. 与 Aurora 一样, Deuteronomy 不需要 redo 恢复, 但其原因是推迟事务, 只将已提交更新写到持久存储, 因而事务大小可能受到约束, Aurora 则不同. 译者注: 本文参考文献中, ARIES 对应 [7], 原文此处的 [5] 与书目不符.

9. 结论

We designed Aurora as a high throughput OLTP database that compromises neither availability nor durability in a cloud-scale environment. The big idea was to move away from the monolithic architecture of traditional databases and decouple storage from compute. In particular, we moved the lower quarter of the database kernel to an independent scalable and distributed service that managed logging and storage. With all I/Os written over the network, our fundamental constraint is now the network. As a result we need to focus on techniques that relieve the network and improve throughput. We rely on quorum models that can handle the complex and correlated failures that occur in large-scale cloud environments and avoid outlier performance penalties, log processing to reduce the aggregate I/O burden, and asynchronous consensus to eliminate chatty and expensive multi-phase synchronization protocols, offline crash recovery, and checkpointing in distributed storage. Our approach has led to a simplified architecture with reduced complexity that is easy to scale as well as a foundation for future advances.

我们将 Aurora 设计为云规模环境下不牺牲可用性和持久性的高吞吐 OLTP 数据库. 核心思路是摆脱传统单体架构, 将计算与存储解耦, 特别是把内核底部约四分之一的功能移到独立, 可扩展的分布式日志与存储服务. 所有 I/O 都经过网络, 网络成为主要约束, 因而优化重点是减轻网络负担并提高吞吐量. 我们通过 quorum 模型应对复杂相关故障及尾部性能问题, 通过日志处理减少总体 I/O, 通过异步共识避免通信频繁且昂贵的多阶段同步, 离线崩溃恢复和分布式存储检查点. 最终得到更简单, 更易扩展的架构, 也为后续改进奠定基础.

[13] R. Taft, E. Mansour, M. Serafini, J. Duggan, A.J. Elmore, A. Aboulnaga, A. Pavlo, and M. Stonebraker. E-Store: fine-grained elastic partitioning for distributed transaction processing systems. In VLDB 2015.

[14] R. Woollen. The internal design of salesforce.com's multi-tenant architecture. In SoCC 2010.

[15] S. Davidson, H. Garcia-Molina, and D. Skeen. Consistency in partitioned networks. ACM CSUR, 17(3): 341-370, 1985.

[16] S. Gilbert and N. Lynch. Brewer's conjecture and the feasibility of consistent, available, partition-tolerant web services. SIGACT News, 33(2): 51-59, 2002.

[17] D.J. Abadi. Consistency tradeoffs in modern distributed database system design: CAP is only part of the story. IEEE Computer, 45(2), 2012.

[18] A. Adya. Weak consistency: a generalized theory and optimistic implementations for distributed transactions. PhD Thesis, MIT, 1999.

[19] Y. Saito and M. Shapiro. Optimistic replication. ACM Computing Surveys, 37(1), Mar. 2005.

[20] H. Berenson, P. Bernstein, J. Gray, J. Melton, E. O'Neil, and P. O'Neil. A critique of ANSI SQL isolation levels. In SIGMOD 1995.

[21] P. Bailis and A. Ghodsi. Eventual consistency today: limitations, extensions, and beyond. ACM Queue, 11(3), March 2013.

[22] P. Bernstein and S. Das. Rethinking eventual consistency. In SIGMOD, 2013.

[23] B. Cooper et al. PNUTS: Yahoo!'s hosted data serving platform. In VLDB 2008.

[24] J. C. Corbett, J. Dean, et al. Spanner: Google's globally-distributed database. In OSDI 2012.

[25] David K. Gifford. Information Storage in a Decentralized Computer System. Tech. rep. CSL-81-8. PhD dissertation. Xerox PARC, July 1982.

[26] Jeffrey Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat. MapReduce: a flexible data processing tool". CACM 53 (1): 72-77, 2010.

[27] J. M. Hellerstein, M. Stonebraker, and J. R. Hamilton. Architecture of a database system. Foundations and Trends in Databases. 1(2) pp. 141-259, 2007.

[28] J. Gray, R. A. Lorie, G. R. Putzolu, I. L. Traiger. Granularity of locks in a shared data base. In VLDB 1975.

[29] P-A Larson, et al. High-Performance Concurrency control mechanisms for main-memory databases. PVLDB, 5(4): 298-309, 2011.

[30] M. Stonebraker and A. Weisberg. The VoltDB main memory DBMS. IEEE Data Engineering Bulletin, 36(2): 21-27, 2013.

[31] V. Leis, A. Kemper, et al. Exploiting hardware transactional memory in main-memory databases. In ICDE 2014.

[32] H. Mühe, S. Wolf, A. Kemper, and T. Neumann: An evaluation of strict timestamp ordering concurrency control for main-memory database systems. In IMDM 2013.

[33] M. Rosenblum and J. Ousterhout. The design and implementation of a log-structured file system. ACM TOCS 10(1): 26-52, 1992.

[34] J. Levandoski, D. Lomet, S. Sengupta. LLAMA: A cache/storage subsystem for modern hardware. PVLDB 6(10): 877-888, 2013.

[35] J. Levandoski, D. Lomet, and S. Sengupta. The Bw-Tree: A B-tree for new hardware platforms. In ICDE 2013.

[36] M. Aguilera, J. Leners, and M. Walfish. Yesquel: scalable SQL storage for web applications. In SOSP 2015.

[37] Percona Lab. TPC-C Benchmark over MySQL. Available at TPC-C Benchmark over MySQL.

[38] P. Bernstein, C. Reid, and S. Das. Hyder - A transactional record manager for shared flash. In CIDR 2011.

[39] M. Aguilera, A. Merchant, M. Shah, A. Veitch, and C. Karamanolis. Sinfonia: A new paradigm for building scalable distributed systems. ACM Trans. Comput. Syst. 27(3): 2009.

[40] M. Weiner. Sharding Pinterest: How we scaled our MySQL fleet. Pinterest Engineering Blog. Available at: Sharding Pinterest: How we scaled our MySQL fleet.

[41] G. Graefe. Instant recovery for data center savings. ACM SIGMOD Record. 44(2): 29-34, 2015.

[42] J. Dean and L. Barroso. The tail at scale. CACM 56(2): 74-80, 2013.

entry.title: 译 - F1: A Distributed SQL Database That Scales
entry.content:
F1 是 Google 为 AdWords 构建的分布式 SQL 数据库. 本文翻译其 VLDB 2013 论文, 介绍基于 Spanner 的架构, 层次化数据模型, 在线模式变更, 事务与变更历史, 分布式查询处理, 以及跨地域部署的延迟和吞吐量取舍.

原论文: F1: A Distributed SQL Database That Scales. 中文题名: "F1: 可扩展的分布式 SQL 数据库".

作者: Jeff Shute, Radek Vingralek, Bart Samwel, Ben Handy, Chad Whipkey, Eric Rollins, Mircea Oancea, Kyle Littlefield, David Menestrina, Stephan Ellner, John Cieslewicz, Ian Rae, Traian Stancescu, Himani Apte. 作者单位: Google, Inc. Ian Rae 来自 University of Wisconsin-Madison.

出处: Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment, Vol. 6, No. 11, 2013, pp. 1068-1079.

directory 是 Spanner 的数据聚簇单元, 不指文件系统目录; slave pool 译为工作进程池. "我们" 指原作者, 功能, 部署情况和未来计划均按论文写作时的语境理解.

0. 摘要

F1 is a distributed relational database system built at Google to support the AdWords business. F1 is a hybrid database that combines high availability, the scalability of NoSQL systems like Bigtable, and the consistency and usability of traditional SQL databases. F1 is built on Spanner, which provides synchronous cross-datacenter replication and strong consistency. Synchronous replication implies higher commit latency, but we mitigate that latency by using a hierarchical schema model with structured data types and through smart application design. F1 also includes a fully functional distributed SQL query engine and automatic change tracking and publishing.

F1 是 Google 为 AdWords 业务构建的分布式关系数据库系统. 它结合了高可用性, Bigtable 等 NoSQL 系统的可扩展性, 以及传统 SQL 数据库的一致性和易用性. F1 构建于 Spanner 之上, 由后者提供跨数据中心的同步复制和强一致性. 同步复制意味着更高的提交延迟, 但我们通过支持结构化数据类型的层次化模式, 以及合理的应用设计来减轻其影响. F1 还包含功能完整的分布式 SQL 查询引擎, 并能自动跟踪和发布数据变更.

1. 引言

F1 is a fault-tolerant globally-distributed OLTP and OLAP database built at Google as the new storage system for Google's AdWords system. It was designed to replace a sharded MySQL implementation that was not able to meet our growing scalability and reliability requirements.

F1 是 Google 构建的容错型全球分布式数据库, 同时支持 OLTP 和 OLAP, 用作 AdWords 的新存储系统. 它旨在取代基于分片 MySQL 的实现, 后者已无法满足不断增长的扩展性和可靠性要求. 脚注 1: 文献 [22] 曾简要介绍 F1.

The key goals of F1's design are:

F1 的设计有以下几个主要目标:

1. Scalability: The system must be able to scale up, trivially and transparently, just by adding resources. Our sharded database based on MySQL was hard to scale up, and even more difficult to rebalance. Our users needed complex queries and joins, which meant they had to carefully shard their data, and resharding data without breaking applications was challenging.

1. 可扩展性. 增加资源时, 系统应能轻松扩容, 不要求用户感知底层调整. 原来的 MySQL 分片数据库很难扩容, 重新均衡数据更难. 用户需要复杂查询和连接操作, 因而必须谨慎划分数据; 要在不破坏应用的前提下重新分片, 也很有挑战.

2. Availability: The system must never go down for any reason - datacenter outages, planned maintenance, schema changes, etc. The system stores data for Google's core business. Any downtime has a significant revenue impact.

2. 可用性. 无论数据中心故障, 计划维护还是模式变更, 系统都不应停机. 它承载着 Google 核心业务的数据, 任何停机都会显著影响收入.

3. Consistency: The system must provide ACID transactions, and must always present applications with consistent and correct data. Designing applications to cope with concurrency anomalies in their data is very error-prone, time-consuming, and ultimately not worth the performance gains.

3. 一致性. 系统必须提供 ACID 事务, 并始终向应用呈现一致且正确的数据. 让应用应对数据中的并发异常, 不仅容易出错, 还很耗时, 最终并不值得为此换取性能收益.

4. Usability: The system must provide full SQL query support and other functionality users expect from a SQL database. Features like indexes and ad hoc query are not just nice to have, but absolute requirements for our business.

4. 易用性. 系统必须完整支持 SQL 查询, 并提供用户期待 SQL 数据库具备的其他功能. 索引和临时查询并非锦上添花, 而是业务的硬性要求.

Recent publications have suggested that these design goals are mutually exclusive [5, 11, 23]. A key contribution of this paper is to show how we achieved all of these goals in F1's design, and where we made trade-offs and sacrifices. The name F1 comes from genetics, where a Filial 1 hybrid is the first generation offspring resulting from a cross mating of distinctly different parental types. The F1 database system is indeed such a hybrid, combining the best aspects of traditional relational databases and scalable NoSQL systems like Bigtable [6].

近期的一些研究认为, 这些设计目标无法兼得 [5, 11, 23]. 本文的一项主要贡献, 是说明 F1 如何同时实现这些目标, 又在哪些地方作出了取舍. F1 的名字来自遗传学: Filial 1 杂交种指两个明显不同的亲本杂交产生的第一代后代. F1 数据库正是这样一种结合体, 融合了传统关系数据库与 Bigtable [6] 等可扩展 NoSQL 系统的优点.

F1 is built on top of Spanner [7], which provides extremely scalable data storage, synchronous replication, and strong consistency and ordering properties. F1 inherits those features from Spanner and adds several more:

F1 构建于 Spanner [7] 之上. Spanner 提供高度可扩展的数据存储, 同步复制, 以及强一致性和顺序保证. F1 继承这些能力, 并增加了以下功能:

Distributed SQL queries, including joining data from external data sources

分布式 SQL 查询, 包括与外部数据源中的数据进行连接.

Transactionally consistent secondary indexes

具有事务一致性的二级索引.

Asynchronous schema changes including database reorganizations

异步模式变更, 包括数据库重组.

Optimistic transactions

乐观事务.

Automatic change history recording and publishing

自动记录和发布变更历史.

Our design choices in F1 result in higher latency for typical reads and writes. We have developed techniques to hide that increased latency, and we found that user-facing transactions can be made to perform as well as in our previous MySQL system:

这些设计选择使 F1 的典型读写延迟高于传统方案. 我们开发了一些方法来隐藏增加的延迟, 并发现面向用户的事务可以达到原 MySQL 系统的性能:

An F1 schema makes data clustering explicit, using tables with hierarchical relationships and columns with structured data types. This clustering improves data locality and reduces the number and cost of RPCs required to read remote data.

F1 模式通过具有层次关系的表和支持结构化类型的列, 显式表达数据聚簇方式. 这种聚簇能改善数据局部性, 减少读取远程数据所需的 RPC 次数和开销.

F1 users make heavy use of batching, parallelism and asynchronous reads. We use a new ORM (object-relational mapping) library that makes these concepts explicit. This places an upper bound on the number of RPCs required for typical application-level operations, making those operations scale well by default.

F1 用户大量采用批处理, 并行执行和异步读取. 我们使用新的对象关系映射 (ORM) 库, 将这些概念显式暴露给应用. 这样可以为典型应用操作所需的 RPC 次数设定上限, 使其默认就具备良好的扩展性.

The F1 system has been managing all AdWords advertising campaign data in production since early 2012. AdWords is a vast and diverse ecosystem including 100s of applications and 1000s of users, all sharing the same database. This database is over 100 TB, serves up to hundreds of thousands of requests per second, and runs SQL queries that scan tens of trillions of data rows per day. Availability reaches five nines, even in the presence of unplanned outages, and observable latency on our web applications has not increased compared to the old MySQL system.

自 2012 年初起, F1 已在生产环境中管理全部 AdWords 广告系列数据. AdWords 是一个规模庞大且多样化的生态系统, 数百个应用和数千名用户共用同一个数据库. 数据库超过 100 TB, 每秒处理的请求可达数十万, SQL 查询每天扫描数十万亿行数据. 即使发生计划外故障, 可用性仍达到五个九; 与原 MySQL 系统相比, Web 应用中用户可感知的延迟没有增加.

We discuss the AdWords F1 database throughout this paper as it was the original and motivating user for F1. Several other groups at Google are now beginning to deploy F1.

本文始终以 AdWords 的 F1 数据库为例, 因为它是 F1 最早的用户, 也是推动该系统设计的需求来源. Google 的其他一些团队也已开始部署 F1.

2. 基本架构

Users interact with F1 through the F1 client library. Other tools like the command-line ad-hoc SQL shell are implemented using the same client. The client sends requests to one of many F1 servers, which are responsible for reading and writing data from remote data sources and coordinating query execution. Figure 1 depicts the basic architecture and the communication between components.

用户通过 F1 客户端库访问系统. 命令行临时 SQL 查询工具等其他工具, 也基于同一客户端实现. 客户端将请求发送给众多 F1 服务器中的一台, 由其负责读写远程数据源并协调查询执行. 图 1 展示了基本架构和组件间的通信.

Figure 1: The basic architecture of the F1 system, with servers in two datacenters.

图 1: F1 基本架构, 图中展示两个数据中心的服务器.

Because of F1's distributed architecture, special care must be taken to avoid unnecessarily increasing request latency. For example, the F1 client and load balancer prefer to connect to an F1 server in a nearby datacenter whenever possible. However, requests may transparently go to F1 servers in remote datacenters in cases of high load or failures.

F1 采用分布式架构, 因此必须避免无谓的请求延迟. 客户端和负载均衡器通常优先连接附近数据中心的 F1 服务器. 如果本地负载过高或发生故障, 请求也可以自动转发到远端数据中心, 应用无须自行处理切换.

F1 servers are typically co-located in the same set of datacenters as the Spanner servers storing the data. This co-location ensures that F1 servers generally have fast access to the underlying data. For availability and load balancing, F1 servers can communicate with Spanner servers outside their own datacenter when necessary. The Spanner servers in each datacenter in turn retrieve their data from the Colossus File System (CFS) [14] in the same datacenter. Unlike Spanner, CFS is not a globally replicated service and therefore Spanner servers will never communicate with remote CFS instances.

F1 服务器通常与存储数据的 Spanner 服务器部署在同一组数据中心, 以便快速访问底层数据. 为保证可用性和均衡负载, F1 服务器在必要时也能与其他数据中心的 Spanner 服务器通信. 各数据中心的 Spanner 服务器再从本地的 Colossus 文件系统 (CFS) [14] 获取数据. 与 Spanner 不同, CFS 不是全球复制服务, 因此 Spanner 服务器不会访问远端 CFS 实例.

F1 servers are mostly stateless, allowing a client to communicate with a different F1 server for each request. The one exception is when a client uses pessimistic transactions and must hold locks. The client is then bound to one F1 server for the duration of that transaction. F1 transactions are described in more detail in Section 5. F1 servers can be quickly added (or removed) from our system in response to the total load because F1 servers do not own any data and hence a server addition (or removal) requires no data movement.

F1 服务器基本无状态, 客户端的每个请求都可以发往不同服务器. 唯一的例外是需要持锁的悲观事务: 在事务存续期间, 客户端必须绑定到同一台 F1 服务器. 原文第 5 节会进一步介绍 F1 事务. F1 服务器不拥有数据, 增减服务器无需迁移数据, 因此系统可以根据总负载快速调整服务器数量.

An F1 cluster has several additional components that allow for the execution of distributed SQL queries. Distributed execution is chosen over centralized execution when the query planner estimates that increased parallelism will reduce query processing latency. The shared slave pool consists of F1 processes that exist only to execute parts of distributed query plans on behalf of regular F1 servers. Slave pool membership is maintained by the F1 master, which monitors slave process health and distributes the list of available slaves to F1 servers. F1 also supports large-scale data processing through Google's MapReduce framework [10]. For performance reasons, MapReduce workers are allowed to communicate directly with Spanner servers to extract data in bulk (not shown in the figure). Other clients perform reads and writes exclusively through F1 servers.

F1 集群还包含几个支持分布式 SQL 查询的组件. 当查询规划器估计提高并行度可以降低处理延迟时, 就会选择分布式执行而非集中执行. 共享工作进程池 (slave pool) 中的 F1 进程, 专门代表常规 F1 服务器执行分布式查询计划的部分任务. F1 master 维护进程池成员信息, 监测进程健康状态, 并向 F1 服务器分发可用进程列表. F1 也通过 Google 的 MapReduce 框架 [10] 支持大规模数据处理. 为提高性能, MapReduce 工作进程可以直接与 Spanner 服务器通信, 批量提取数据, 图中未画出这一路径. 其他客户端则只能通过 F1 服务器读写.

The throughput of the entire system can be scaled up by adding more Spanner servers, F1 servers, or F1 slaves. Since F1 servers do not store data, adding new servers does not involve any data re-distribution costs. Adding new Spanner servers results in data re-distribution. This process is completely transparent to F1 servers (and therefore F1 clients).

增加 Spanner 服务器, F1 服务器或 F1 工作进程, 都可以提高整个系统的吞吐量. F1 服务器不存储数据, 增加它们不会产生重新分布数据的开销. 增加 Spanner 服务器则会触发数据重新分布, 但这个过程对 F1 服务器, 进而对 F1 客户端完全透明.

The Spanner-based remote storage model and our geographically distributed deployment leads to latency characteristics that are very different from those of regular databases. Because the data is synchronously replicated across multiple datacenters, and because we've chosen widely distributed datacenters, the commit latencies are relatively high (50-150 ms). This high latency necessitates changes to the patterns that clients use when interacting with the database. We describe these changes in Section 7.1, and we provide further detail on our deployment choices, and the resulting availability and latency, in Sections 9 and 10.

基于 Spanner 的远程存储模型和跨地域部署, 使 F1 的延迟特征与普通数据库明显不同. 数据要在多个数据中心之间同步复制, 而我们又选择了相距较远的数据中心, 因此提交延迟较高, 为 50-150 ms. 客户端必须相应调整访问数据库的方式. 原文第 7.1 节介绍这些调整, 第 9 节和第 10 节进一步讨论部署选择及其带来的可用性与延迟.

2.1 Spanner

F1 is built on top of Spanner. Both systems were developed at the same time and in close collaboration. Spanner handles lower-level storage issues like persistence, caching, replication, fault tolerance, data sharding and movement, location lookups, and transactions.

F1 构建于 Spanner 之上, 两个系统在密切协作下同期开发. Spanner 负责持久化, 缓存, 复制, 容错, 数据分片与迁移, 位置查找和事务等底层问题.

In Spanner, data rows are partitioned into clusters called directories using ancestry relationships in the schema. Each directory has at least one fragment, and large directories can have multiple fragments. Groups store a collection of directory fragments. Each group typically has one replica tablet per datacenter. Data is replicated synchronously using the Paxos algorithm [18], and all tablets for a group store the same data. One replica tablet is elected as the Paxos leader for the group, and that leader is the entry point for all transactional activity for the group. Groups may also include readonly replicas, which do not vote in the Paxos algorithm and cannot become the group leader.

Spanner 根据模式中的祖先关系, 将数据行聚集到称为 directory 的单元中. 每个 directory 至少包含一个片段, 较大的 directory 可以有多个片段. 一个组存放一批 directory 片段, 通常在每个数据中心都有一个副本 tablet. 数据通过 Paxos 算法 [18] 同步复制, 同一组的所有 tablet 存储相同的数据. 系统从中选出一个 tablet 作为该组的 Paxos leader, 所有事务活动都以它为入口. 组内也可以包含只读副本, 它们不参与 Paxos 投票, 也不能成为 leader.

Spanner provides serializable pessimistic transactions using strict two-phase locking. A transaction includes multiple reads, taking shared or exclusive locks, followed by a single write that upgrades locks and atomically commits the transaction. All commits are synchronously replicated using Paxos. Transactions are most efficient when updating data co-located in a single group. Spanner also supports transactions across multiple groups, called transaction participants, using a two-phase commit (2PC) protocol on top of Paxos. 2PC adds an extra network round trip so it usually doubles observed commit latency. 2PC scales well up to 10s of participants, but abort frequency and latency increase significantly with 100s of participants [7].

Spanner 使用严格两阶段锁提供可串行化的悲观事务. 一个事务先执行多次读取, 获取共享锁或排他锁, 最后通过一次写入升级锁并原子提交. 所有提交都使用 Paxos 同步复制. 当事务更新的数据位于同一组时, 效率最高. Spanner 也支持跨多个组的事务, 这些组称为事务参与者; 系统在 Paxos 之上使用两阶段提交 (2PC) 协议. 2PC 多一次网络往返, 因而通常使实际提交延迟翻倍. 参与者为数十个时, 2PC 的扩展性仍不错; 增至数百个时, 中止频率和延迟都会明显上升 [7].

Spanner has very strong consistency and timestamp semantics. Every transaction is assigned a commit timestamp, and these timestamps provide a global total ordering for commits. Spanner uses a novel mechanism to pick globally ordered timestamps in a scalable way using hardware clocks deployed in Google datacenters. Spanner uses these timestamps to provide multi-versioned consistent reads, including snapshot reads of current data, without taking read locks. For guaranteed non-blocking, globally consistent reads, Spanner provides a global safe timestamp, below which no in-flight or future transaction can possibly commit. The global safe timestamp typically lags current time by 5-10 seconds. Reads at this timestamp can normally run on any replica tablet, including readonly replicas, and they never block behind running transactions.

Spanner 提供很强的一致性和时间戳语义. 每个事务都获分配一个提交时间戳, 这些时间戳为全部提交建立全局全序. 它利用 Google 数据中心部署的硬件时钟, 通过一种新机制以可扩展的方式生成全局有序时间戳. 借助这些时间戳, Spanner 可以不获取读锁就执行多版本一致性读取, 包括对当前数据的快照读取. 为保证读取既不阻塞又全局一致, Spanner 提供全局安全时间戳: 任何进行中或未来的事务都不可能在该时间戳之前提交. 它通常落后于当前时间 5-10 秒. 按此时间戳读取一般可以在任意副本 tablet 上执行, 包括只读副本, 而且绝不会等待正在运行的事务.

3. 数据模型

3.1 层次化模式

The F1 data model is very similar to the Spanner data model. In fact, Spanner's original data model was more like Bigtable, but Spanner later adopted F1's data model. At the logical level, F1 has a relational schema similar to that of a traditional RDBMS, with some extensions including explicit table hierarchy and columns with Protocol Buffer data types.

F1 的数据模型与 Spanner 非常相似. 事实上, Spanner 最初的模型更接近 Bigtable, 后来采用了 F1 的数据模型. 在逻辑层面, F1 采用类似传统 RDBMS 的关系模式, 并扩展了显式表层次和 Protocol Buffer 类型的列.

Logically, tables in the F1 schema can be organized into a hierarchy. Physically, F1 stores each child table clustered with and interleaved within the rows from its parent table. Tables from the logical schema cannot be arbitrarily interleaved: the child table must have a foreign key to its parent table as a prefix of its primary key. For example, the AdWords schema contains a table Customer with primary key (CustomerId), which has a child table Campaign with primary key (CustomerId, CampaignId) , which in turn has a child table AdGroup with primary key (CustomerId, CampaignId, AdGroupId) . A row of the root table in the hierarchy is called a root row. All child table rows corresponding to a root row are clustered together with that root row in a single Spanner directory, meaning that cluster is normally stored on a single Spanner server. Child rows are stored under their parent row ordered by primary key. Figure 2 shows an example.

在逻辑上, F1 模式中的表可以组织成层次结构; 在物理上, 每张子表的数据会与父表数据聚簇存放, 并交错排列在父表行之间. 这种交错并非任意的: 子表主键必须以指向父表的外键为前缀. 例如, AdWords 的 Customer 表以 CustomerId 为主键, 子表 Campaign 以 (CustomerId, CampaignId) 为主键, 再下一级 AdGroup 以 (CustomerId, CampaignId, AdGroupId) 为主键. 层次结构中根表的一行称为根行. 某个根行对应的全部子表行, 都与该根行聚簇在同一个 Spanner directory 中, 因而通常存储在同一台 Spanner 服务器上. 子行位于父行之下, 按主键排序, 如图 2 所示.

Figure 2: The logical and physical properties of data storage in a traditional normalized relational schema compared with a clustered hierarchical schema used in an F1 database.

图 2: 传统规范化关系模式与 F1 层次化聚簇模式的数据存储: 逻辑与物理特征对比.

The hierarchically clustered physical schema has several advantages over a flat relational schema. Consider the corresponding traditional schema, also depicted in Figure 2. In this traditional schema, fetching all Campaign and AdGroup records corresponding to a given CustomerId would take two sequential steps, because there is no direct way to retrieve AdGroup records by CustomerId. In the F1 version of the schema, the hierarchical primary keys allow the fetches of Campaign and AdGroup records to be started in parallel, because both tables are keyed by CustomerId. The primary key prefix property means that reading all AdGroups for a particular Customer can be expressed as a single range read, rather than reading each row individually using an index. Furthermore, because the tables are both stored in primary key order, rows from the two tables can be joined using a simple ordered merge. Because the data is clustered into a single directory, we can read it all in a single Spanner request. All of these properties of a hierarchical schema help mitigate the latency effects of having remote data.

与扁平的关系模式相比, 层次化聚簇的物理模式有几个优点. 图 2 同时展示了相应的传统模式: 要取得某个 CustomerId 下的全部 Campaign 和 AdGroup 记录, 必须顺序执行两步, 因为无法直接按 CustomerId 查找 AdGroup. 在 F1 模式中, 两张表的主键都包含 CustomerId, 因而可以并行发起读取. 主键前缀还使某个 Customer 下的全部 AdGroup 能通过一次范围读取获得, 而不必借助索引逐行读取. 两张表都按主键存储, 因此可以通过简单的有序归并完成连接. 数据又集中在一个 directory 中, 一次 Spanner 请求即可全部读出. 这些特征共同减轻了远程数据访问带来的延迟影响.

Hierarchical clustering is especially useful for updates, since it reduces the number of Spanner groups involved in a transaction. Because each root row and all of its descendant rows are stored in a single Spanner directory, transactions restricted to a single root will usually avoid 2PC and the associated latency penalty, so most applications try to use single-root transactions as much as possible. Even when doing transactions across multiple roots, it is important to limit the number of roots involved because adding more participants generally increases latency and decreases the likelihood of a successful commit.

层次化聚簇对更新尤其有用, 因为它减少了事务涉及的 Spanner 组数. 根行及其全部后代行都在同一个 directory 中, 因而只涉及一个根行的事务通常能避开 2PC 及其延迟开销. 大多数应用因此尽量使用单根事务. 即使事务必须跨多个根行, 也应限制根行数量, 因为参与者越多, 延迟通常越高, 提交成功的概率也越低.

Hierarchical clustering is not mandatory in F1. An F1 schema often has several root tables, and in fact, a completely flat MySQL-style schema is still possible. Using hierarchy however, to the extent that it matches data semantics, is highly beneficial. In AdWords, most transactions are typically updating data for a single advertiser at a time, so we made the advertiser a root table (Customer) and clustered related tables under it. This clustering was critical to achieving acceptable latency.

F1 并不强制采用层次化聚簇. 一个模式往往包含多张根表, 也完全可以像 MySQL 那样采用扁平模式. 不过, 在符合数据语义的前提下引入层次结构, 收益很大. AdWords 的多数事务通常一次只更新一个广告主的数据, 所以我们将广告主表 Customer 作为根表, 把相关表聚簇在其下. 这种布局是将延迟降到可接受水平的关键.

3.2 Protocol Buffers

The F1 data model supports table columns that contain structured data types. These structured types use the schema and binary encoding format provided by Google's open source Protocol Buffer [16] library. Protocol Buffers have typed fields that can be required, optional, or repeated; fields can also be nested Protocol Buffers. At Google, Protocol Buffers are ubiquitous for data storage and interchange between applications. When we still had a MySQL schema, users often had to write tedious and error-prone transformations between database rows and in-memory data structures. Putting protocol buffers in the schema removes this impedance mismatch and gives users a universal data structure they can use both in the database and in application code.

F1 支持包含结构化数据的列, 使用 Google 开源 Protocol Buffer 库 [16] 提供的模式和二进制编码格式. Protocol Buffer 中的字段具有类型, 可设为必需, 可选或重复, 也能嵌套其他 Protocol Buffer. Google 广泛使用它存储数据并在应用间交换信息. 采用 MySQL 模式时, 用户往往要编写繁琐且容易出错的代码, 在数据库行与内存数据结构之间转换. 将 Protocol Buffer 直接纳入模式, 消除了这类映射差异, 使数据库与应用代码能使用同一种数据结构.

Protocol Buffers allow the use of repeated fields. In F1 schema designs, we often use repeated fields instead of child tables when the number of child records has a low upper bound. By using repeated fields, we avoid the performance overhead and complexity of storing and joining multiple child records. The entire protocol buffer is effectively treated as one blob by Spanner. Aside from performance impacts, Protocol Buffer columns are more natural and reduce semantic complexity for users, who can now read and write their logical business objects as atomic units, without having to think about materializing them using joins across several tables. The use of Protocol Buffers in F1 SQL is described in Section 8.7.

Protocol Buffer 支持重复字段. 在 F1 模式设计中, 如果子记录数量的上限较小, 我们往往用重复字段代替子表, 以避免存储和连接多条子记录的开销与复杂性. 对 Spanner 而言, 整个 Protocol Buffer 实际上就是一个二进制块. 除了性能方面的影响, 这种列类型也更符合用户的思维方式, 降低了语义复杂度: 用户可以把逻辑业务对象作为原子单位读写, 不必考虑如何连接多张表才能还原对象. 原文第 8.7 节介绍如何在 F1 SQL 中使用 Protocol Buffer.

Many tables in an F1 schema consist of just a single Protocol Buffer column. Other tables split their data across a handful of columns, partitioning the fields according to access patterns. Tables can be partitioned into columns to group together fields that are usually accessed together, to separate fields with static and frequently updated data, to allow specifying different read/write permissions per column, or to allow concurrent updates to different columns. Using fewer columns generally improves performance in Spanner where there can be high per-column overhead.

F1 模式中的许多表只有一个 Protocol Buffer 列; 另一些表则根据访问模式, 将字段分配到少量几列中. 拆列可以把常一起访问的字段放在一起, 分离静态数据和频繁更新的数据, 为不同列设置不同读写权限, 或允许并发更新不同列. Spanner 的每列开销可能较高, 因而减少列数通常有助于性能.

3.3 索引

All indexes in F1 are transactional and fully consistent. Indexes are stored as separate tables in Spanner, keyed by a concatenation of the index key and the indexed table's primary key. Index keys can be either scalar columns or fields extracted from Protocol Buffers (including repeated fields). There are two types of physical storage layout for F1 indexes: local and global.

F1 中的所有索引都具有事务性, 并保持完全一致. 索引以独立表的形式存储在 Spanner 中, 主键由索引键与被索引表的主键拼接而成. 索引键可以是标量列, 也可以是从 Protocol Buffer 中提取的字段, 包括重复字段. F1 的索引有本地和全局两种物理布局.

Local index keys must contain the root row primary key as a prefix. For example, an index on (CustomerId, Keyword) used to store unique keywords for each customer is a local index. Like child tables, local indexes are stored in the same Spanner directory as the root row. Consequently, the index entries of local indexes are stored on the same Spanner server as the rows they index, and local index updates add little additional cost to any transaction.

本地索引. 索引键必须以根行主键为前缀. 例如, 用于保存各客户唯一关键词的 (CustomerId, Keyword) 索引就是本地索引. 与子表一样, 本地索引和根行位于同一个 Spanner directory. 因此, 索引项与被索引行存储在同一台服务器上, 更新本地索引几乎不会给事务增加额外成本.

In contrast, global index keys do not include the root row primary key as a prefix and hence cannot be co-located with the rows they index. For example, an index on (Keyword) that maps from all keywords in the database to Customers that use them must be global. Global indexes are often large and can have high aggregate update rates. Consequently, they are sharded across many directories and stored on multiple Spanner servers. Writing a single row that updates a global index requires adding a single extra participant to a transaction, which means the transaction must use 2PC, but that is a reasonable cost to pay for consistent global indexes.

全局索引. 索引键不以根行主键为前缀, 因而无法与被索引行共同放置. 例如, 将数据库中的所有 Keyword 映射到使用该关键词的 Customer 的索引, 必须是全局索引. 它们通常规模较大, 总更新速率也可能很高, 因此会拆分到多个 directory 和多台 Spanner 服务器上. 如果一次单行写入需要更新一个全局索引, 事务就要增加一个参与者并使用 2PC, 但这是获得一致全局索引可以接受的代价.

Global indexes work reasonably well for single-row updates, but can cause scaling problems for large transactions. Consider a transaction that inserts 1000 rows. Each row requires adding one or more global index entries, and those index entries could be arbitrarily spread across 100s of index directories, meaning the 2PC transaction would have 100s of participants, making it slower and more error-prone. Therefore, we use global indexes sparingly in the schema, and encourage application writers to use small transactions when bulk inserting into tables with global indexes.

全局索引对单行更新表现尚可, 却可能给大事务带来扩展性问题. 假设事务插入 1000 行, 每行都要增加一个或多个全局索引项. 这些索引项可能散布在数百个索引 directory 中, 使 2PC 事务拥有数百个参与者, 从而更慢, 也更容易出错. 因此, 我们在模式中谨慎使用全局索引, 并建议应用在向带全局索引的表批量插入数据时采用小事务.

Megastore [3] makes global indexes scalable by giving up consistency and supporting only asynchronous global indexes. We are currently exploring other mechanisms to make global indexes more scalable without compromising consistency.

Megastore [3] 为扩展全局索引而放弃一致性, 只支持异步全局索引. 我们正在探索其他机制, 争取在不牺牲一致性的前提下提高全局索引的扩展能力.

4. 模式变更

The AdWords database is shared by thousands of users and is under constant development. Batches of schema changes are queued by developers and applied daily. This database is mission critical for Google and requires very high availability. Downtime or table locking during schema changes (e.g. adding indexes) is not acceptable.

AdWords 数据库由数千名用户共享, 开发工作持续不断. 开发者将模式变更分批排队, 系统每天应用这些变更. 这个数据库对 Google 业务至关重要, 要求极高的可用性. 模式变更, 例如增加索引, 不能造成停机或锁表.

We have designed F1 to make all schema changes fully non-blocking. Several aspects of the F1 system make nonblocking schema changes particularly challenging:

F1 的设计要求所有模式变更完全不阻塞业务. 以下特点使这一目标尤其难以实现:

F1 is a massively distributed system, with servers in multiple datacenters in distinct geographic regions.

F1 是大规模分布式系统, 服务器位于不同地理区域的多个数据中心.

Each F1 server has a schema locally in memory. It is not practical to make an update occur atomically across all servers.

每台 F1 服务器在本地内存中保存模式, 不可能在所有服务器上同时原子更新.

Queries and transactions must continue on all tables, even those undergoing schema changes.

查询和事务必须持续访问所有表, 包括正在变更模式的表.

System availability and latency must not be negatively impacted during schema changes.

模式变更不能损害系统可用性和延迟表现.

Because F1 is massively distributed, even if F1 had a global F1 server membership repository, synchronous schema change across all servers would be very disruptive to response times. To make changes atomic, at some point, servers would have to block transactions until confirming all other servers have received the change. To avoid this, F1 schema changes are applied asynchronously, on different F1 servers at different times. This implies that two F1 servers may update the database concurrently using different schemas.

即使 F1 存在全局服务器成员目录, 在如此大规模的分布式系统中同步变更模式, 也会严重影响响应时间. 要让变更原子生效, 服务器就必须在某一时刻阻塞事务, 直到确认其他所有服务器都已收到变更. 为避免这一点, F1 异步应用模式变更, 各服务器生效时间不同. 这也意味着, 两台 F1 服务器可能同时使用不同模式更新数据库.

If two F1 servers update the database using different schemas that are not compatible according to our schema change algorithms, this could lead to anomalies including database corruption. We illustrate the possibility of database corruption using an example. Consider a schema change from schema S1 to schema S2 that adds index I on table T . Because the schema change is applied asynchronously on different F1 servers, assume that server M1 is using schema S1 and server M2 is using schema S2. First, server M2 inserts a new row r, which also adds a new index entry I(r) for row r. Subsequently, row r is deleted by server M1. Because the server is using schema S1 and is not aware of index I, the server deletes row r, but fails to delete the index entry I(r). Hence, the database becomes corrupt. For example, an index scan on I would return spurious data corresponding to the deleted row r.

如果两台服务器使用的模式不符合模式变更算法定义的兼容条件, 就可能出现异常, 甚至破坏数据库. 例如, 模式从 S1 变为 S2, 在表 T 上增加索引 I. 由于变更异步生效, 假设服务器 M1 仍使用 S1, M2 已使用 S2. M2 先插入新行 r, 同时增加索引项 I(r). 随后 M1 删除 r, 但它不知道索引 I 的存在, 因而没有删除 I(r). 数据库因此处于不一致状态: 扫描索引 I 会返回已删除行 r 对应的错误数据.

We have implemented a schema change algorithm that prevents anomalies similar to the above by

我们实现了一种模式变更算法, 通过以下两点避免这类异常:

1. Enforcing that across all F1 servers, at most two different schemas are active. Each server uses either the current or next schema. We grant leases on the schema and ensure that no server uses a schema after lease expiry.

1. 所有 F1 服务器最多同时使用两个模式版本, 即当前版本和下一版本. 我们为模式授予租约, 并保证服务器不在租约过期后继续使用该模式.

2. Subdividing each schema change into multiple phases where consecutive pairs of phases are mutually compatible and cannot cause anomalies. In the above example, we first add index I in a mode where it only executes delete operations. This prohibits server M1 from adding I(r) into the database. Subsequently, we upgrade index I so servers perform all write operations. Then we initiate a MapReduce to backfill index entries for all rows in table T with carefully constructed transactions to handle concurrent writes. Once complete, we make index I visible for normal read operations.

2. 每项模式变更分成多个阶段, 任意相邻两阶段都彼此兼容, 不会引发异常. 在上述例子中, 先让索引 I 只执行删除操作, 这会禁止服务器 M1 向数据库加入 I(r). 随后将索引升级为执行全部写操作, 再启动 MapReduce, 为表 T 的全部行回填索引项; 回填事务经过仔细设计, 能处理并发写入. 完成后, 才让普通读取使用索引 I.

The full details of the schema change algorithms are covered in [20].

模式变更算法的完整细节见文献 [20].

5. 事务

The AdWords product ecosystem requires a data store that supports ACID transactions. We store financial data and have hard requirements on data integrity and consistency. We also have a lot of experience with eventual consistency systems at Google. In all such systems, we find developers spend a significant fraction of their time building extremely complex and error-prone mechanisms to cope with eventual consistency and handle data that may be out of date. We think this is an unacceptable burden to place on developers and that consistency problems should be solved at the database level. Full transactional consistency is one of the most important properties of F1.

AdWords 产品生态需要支持 ACID 事务的数据存储. 我们保存财务数据, 对完整性和一致性有硬性要求. Google 也积累了大量使用最终一致性系统的经验. 在这类系统中, 开发者往往花费大量时间构建极其复杂且容易出错的机制, 应对最终一致性和可能过时的数据. 我们认为, 不应让开发者承担这样的负担, 一致性问题应在数据库层解决. 完整的事务一致性是 F1 最重要的特性之一.

Each F1 transaction consists of multiple reads, optionally followed by a single write that commits the transaction. F1 implements three types of transactions, all built on top of Spanner's transaction support:

每个 F1 事务包含多次读取, 随后可以通过一次写入提交事务. F1 在 Spanner 的事务支持之上实现了三类事务:

1. Snapshot transactions. These are read-only transactions with snapshot semantics, reading repeatable data as of a fixed Spanner snapshot timestamp. By default, snapshot transactions read at Spanner's global safe timestamp, typically 5-10 seconds old, and read from a local Spanner replica. Users can also request a specific timestamp explicitly, or have Spanner pick the current timestamp to see current data. The latter option may have higher latency and require remote RPCs.

1. 快照事务. 这是一种具有快照语义的只读事务, 按固定的 Spanner 快照时间戳读取可重复的数据. 默认使用 Spanner 全局安全时间戳, 通常对应 5-10 秒前的数据, 并从本地副本读取. 用户也可以显式指定时间戳, 或让 Spanner 选择当前时间戳以读取当前数据; 后者可能延迟更高, 并需要远程 RPC.

Snapshot transactions are the default mode for SQL queries and for MapReduces. Snapshot transactions allow multiple client servers to see consistent views of the entire database at the same timestamp.

SQL 查询和 MapReduce 默认使用快照事务. 多个客户端服务器可以借此在相同时间戳上看到整个数据库的一致视图.
